title: Senior Customer Reliability Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2><ul><li>Austin, US</li></ul><h2>About the Role</h2><p>Cloudflare built its reputation helping build a better Internet, defending millions of sites, giving away SSL and DDoS mitigation when the industry charged premium prices. In an acceleratingly dangerous world, the scope of that mission has changed. We are becoming something more: critical infrastructure. Banks run their payment rails on us. Governments run public services on us. Media companies depend on us during live events. Health systems depend on us to provide care. Reliability for these customers is no longer a feature of our product. It is a mission.</p><p>Serving that customer base demands a different operating model. Traditional support organizations route tickets. Traditional engineering organizations ship features. Neither alone is enough when the stakes are this high. We are pivoting to something different: a customer-facing engineering organization, directly engaged with our customers at scale. This is work a central dev team cannot do from the inside of the network.</p><p>The Customer Reliability Engineering function is the spine of that pivot. CRE is SRE applied outward, the same engineering discipline, applied to the reliability of the systems our customers run on Cloudflare. You are the engineer who owns the problems that matter most to the customers who matter most, and you contribute directly to our products and tooling, in partnership with Product Engineering, to hold that standard across the entire customer base.</p><p>CRE is a rapid response team and a proactive engineering team. You fix things at the edge as they come up, and you help build the product capabilities that identify customer issues before they become a crisis. Both modes are equally core.</p><p><strong>Rapid response.</strong> When a customer issue surfaces that is high-severity, cross-layer and complex, you are the engineer who answers. You reproduce the defect, isolate the root cause across Cloudflare's infrastructure and the customer's stack, drive the fix with Product Engineering, and confirm resolution. You hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global shift rotation.</p><p><strong>Proactive engineering.</strong> When no fire is burning, you work with Product Engineering and our platform teams to build the capabilities that make the next fire cheaper or unnecessary: telemetry pipelines that correlate signals across the customer base, detectors that fire before a human notices, diagnostic tooling that scales across hundreds of customers, automation that reduces toil for Customer Support. Every incident you carry generates engineering output that reduces the cost of recurrence. The work compounds.</p><p>Cloudflare is building CRE as an AI-native function. You will work with and help build agents and tooling that pre-diagnose incidents, surface relevant logs and configuration, and propose fixes with cited evidence. Engineers who ship AI-assisted diagnostics are the ones defining this discipline.</p><h2>Responsibilities</h2><h3>Rapid response:</h3><ul><li>Own a Sev-1 incident where a large financial services customer sees asymmetric latency from a single POP. Trace it through BGP routing and origin configuration. Produce the fix upstream.</li><li>Diagnose a recurring WebSocket disconnect that a media customer has been fighting for weeks. Isolate it to a specific interaction between WAF and their origin load balancer. Drive the fix with Product Engineering.</li><li>Partner with a government customer's SRE team during an active DDoS event. Help them shape their Magic Transit and WAF configuration in real time.</li></ul><h3>Proactive engineering:</h3><ul><li>Build, with Product Engineering, a distributed tracing capability that correlates Cloudflare edge signals with customer origin metrics so a single query tells the story of a failing request end-to-end.</li><li>Ship a detector for a class of WAF false positives silently degrading several customers. Get it into production before the next renewal cycle.</li><li>Prototype an AI agent that takes a new customer case, pulls relevant logs and config, and proposes a root cause with linked evidence. Deploy it internally. Measure whether it makes engineers faster. Iterate.</li><li><strong>Rapid incident response and root cause analysis.</strong> Own the most complex, high-severity customer issues end-to-end, from first signal through confirmed resolution. Lead deep-dive debugging across the full stack: edge, network, DNS, transport, APIs, application, customer-side configuration. Reproduce defects, validate fixes with Engineering, and confirm customer-side resolution. Produce postmortems other engineers rely on. Hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global rotation that includes weekends.</li><li><strong>Proactive reliability engineering.</strong> Analyze support and telemetry signals across the customer base to find systemic risks before they become incidents. Contribute monitoring, detection, and diagnostic capability to the core product and the engineering systems that give Customer Support early visibility into customer-affecting issues. Define customer-facing reliability metrics (error rates, resolution times, repeat-contact rates) and drive measurable improvement. Write automation that reduces mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-resolve.</li><li><strong>Cross-functional partnership.</strong> Manage the technical escalation lifecycle with clear ownership and timely communication. Partner with Product Engineering to drive fixes, workarounds, and configuration changes that address underlying gaps. Represent the customer reliability perspective in engineering syncs, incident reviews, and post-mortem processes.</li><li><strong>Technical leadership and enablement.</strong> Raise the technical floor of Customer Support through pair-debugging, structured knowledge transfer, and shared tooling. Document diagnostic procedures and resolution patterns in runbooks, internal knowledge bases, and AI skills. Share insights from customer-facing incidents to improve product documentation and operational readiness.</li><li><strong>Product and platform depth.</strong> Maintain deep, current expertise across Cloudflare's product portfolio: edge networking, DNS, CDN, WAF, DDoS mitigation, Zero Trust, Workers, and our developer platform. Anticipate customer impact from new releases and architecture changes. Serve as a go-to subject-matter expert in one or more domains.</li></ul><h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2><ul><li>Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in site reliability engineering, escalation engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable deeply technical support / operations role, with at least 2 years in customer-facing environments.</li><li>Strong foundation in networking and security:<ul><li>TCP/IP fundamentals: OSI model, IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subnetting, routing, switching.</li><li>Core protocols: DNS, HTTP/S, TLS/SSL, SMTP, SNMP, NTP.</li><li>Routing protocols: BGP, OSPF, including path selection and route propagation.</li><li>Firewall concepts: stateful/stateless inspection, rule sets, NAT, ACLs.</li><li>VPN and encryption: IPSec, SSL/TLS tunnels, GRE.</li><li>Zero Trust architecture, network segmentation, modern security models.</li></ul></li><li>Proficiency with observability and diagnostic tooling: packet capture and analysis (Wireshark, tcpdump), log aggregation (Kibana, Elasticsearch), metrics dashboards (Grafana), distributed tracing.</li><li>Strong scripting and automation skills (Bash, Python) with a track record of shipping tooling that improves reliability and reduces toil.</li><li>Experience with incident management, postmortem culture, and SLO/SLI-based reliability practices.</li><li>Excellent written and verbal communication. Able to convey complex technical information clearly to engineers, leadership, and customers.</li><li>Comfort owning ambiguous, cross-layer problems. Composure under pressure during high-severity incidents.</li><li>SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering experience with direct customer-facing accountability.</li><li>Deep expertise at both L3/L4 (network infrastructure) and L7 (application protocols, DNS, HTTP, WebSocket).</li><li>Expert-level proficiency with Linux command-line tools: curl, dig, git, traceroute, mtr, strace, ss.</li><li>Data-at-scale analysis using SQL, PromQL, or equivalent.</li><li>Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).</li><li>Track record of building internal tooling or diagnostic utilities that measurably improved team efficiency.</li><li>Demonstrated technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving cross-team initiatives, influencing outcomes without direct authority.</li><li>Experience applying AI/ML to production engineering or operational workflows.</li><li>Comfort engaging directly with enterprise customer engineering teams, including on calls during incidents.</li></ul><h2>Bonus Points</h2><ul><li>Active Cloudflare user who understands the platform as a practitioner.</li><li>Hands-on experience with Workers, Pages, R2, D1, or other developer platform services.</li><li>Cloud networking and security experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.</li><li>Web programming (HTML, JavaScript) and regular expressions.</li><li>Chaos engineering or formal reliability frameworks (e.g., Google SRE principles).</li><li>Managing or configuring non-HTTP services: email, DNS authoritative/recursive

title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive
description: <h2><strong>Turn enterprise ambition into measurable impact with AI</strong></h2> <p>What if your next enterprise deal could transform how a global organization connects with its customers? As a Senior Enterprise Account Executive at Coveo, you’ll bring our AI-powered solutions to leading organizations, building relationships and opportunities that translate into meaningful business outcomes.</p> <p>You’ll own complex enterprise sales cycles from prospecting through close, combining industry expertise, consultative selling and a strong partner ecosystem to help customers understand the value Coveo can bring to their business.</p> <p><strong>As one of our Senior Enterprise Account Executives, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and execute creative account strategies focused on delivering measurable outcomes for enterprise customers.</li> <li>Develop relationships with key decision-makers and senior executives, creating new opportunities and building lasting partnerships.</li> <li>Partner with our alliances team to build strong relationships across Coveo’s partner ecosystem and uncover opportunities for growth.</li> <li>Develop compelling business proposals that clearly connect Coveo’s capabilities to each customer’s priorities, challenges and potential business value.</li> <li>Manage complex sales cycles end to end, assessing stakeholders, resources, timing, probability of closure and financial impact while maintaining accurate visibility into sales activity and results.</li> <li>Lead opportunities through the final stages of the sales process, securing agreements and consistently working toward quarterly and annual sales quotas.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Here is what will qualify you for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience managing complex enterprise software sales cycles, engaging stakeholders from business champions through senior executives.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience in the SaaS industry and an ability to understand customers’ business models, priorities and challenges.</li> <li>A strong track record of generating your own opportunities and meeting or exceeding sales quotas in a results-driven environment.</li> <li>A consultative and challenger-oriented sales approach, with the curiosity and discipline to understand complex technology and translate it into customer value.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What will make you stand out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience selling enterprise AI, generative AI or other sophisticated technology solutions.</li> <li>MEDDPICC certification or demonstrated experience applying the methodology to complex enterprise sales.</li> <li>Experience developing opportunities alongside strategic technology or consulting partners.</li> <li>A humble, curious and creative mindset, paired with the drive to build trusted customer relationships.</li> </ul> <p>Do you think you can bring this role to life? Send us your application, we want to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>Join the Coveolife!</strong></p> <p>We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of, for example, age, gender, disability, gaps in CV, national or ethnic background.</p> <p>This job description was written by humans, assisted by AI. We may leverage technology in our hiring process to help us see the person behind the resume.</p> <p>Coveo is committed to providing accessible employment practices. If you require accommodation due to a disability at any point during the recruitment process, please contact <a ---------- to discuss your needs.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Chief of Staff (f/m/d)
description: <p><strong>Join the team rewriting the rules in private markets.</strong></p> <p>Moonfare delivers what few others can: the highly sought-after funds and hidden-gem investments that go beyond what most private banks offer. Every opportunity is subjected to a ruthless vetting process; the bar is unforgivingly high. The result? Institutional-quality portfolios for investors who demand more.</p> <p>Our team combines finance veterans with talent from tech, consulting, law and industries you’d never expect. Headquartered in Berlin, we operate from eight offices across Europe, the US and Asia.</p> <p>If you're ready to build what's next in private markets, let's talk.</p> <p><strong>Chief of Staff (m/f/d)</strong></p> <p>At Moonfare, we are leading a new era of private equity investing. We are seeking an exceptional Chief of Staff to join our executive team at a pivotal moment in our growth. Reporting directly to the co-CEO, this highly strategic role sits at the intersection of strategy, business management, and leadership, driving Moonfare’s most critical initiatives, from embedding AI across the business to guiding our transformation into a premier Asset Manager. This is a hands-on role: you’ll move from advising on strategy to delivering it yourself, rolling up your sleeves to make things happen.</p> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and coordinate high-priority, company-wide initiatives from conception to execution</li> <li>Prepare and orchestrate the bi-weekly ExCo run and change meetings</li> <li>Drive and project manage strategic priorities including Moonfare’s evolution into an Asset Manager</li> <li>Act as a trusted advisor to the co-CEOs and ExCo, applying first-principles thinking and analytical rigor to structure complex challenges and deliver actionable insights</li> <li>Shape and manage the executive operating rhythm: leadership offsites, board preparation, and critical business reviews</li> <li>Support board, investor, and partner engagements, ensuring clear, compelling communication of Moonfare’s strategy and progress</li> <li>Serve as a connector across departments and geographies, enabling alignment and seamless execution of Moonfare’s vision</li> </ul> <p><strong>The next Moonfarian:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Minimum of 3–4 years of significant experience in a top-tier management consulting firm or senior strategic leadership role</li> <li>Proven success leading large-scale, cross-functional initiatives in dynamic, complex environments</li> <li>Exceptional problem-solving skills, combining first-principles thinking with a highly analytical, data-driven approach</li> <li>Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, with the gravitas to influence at all levels</li> <li>Background in financial services, asset management, or FinTech is advantageous but not required</li> </ul> <p><strong>If you feel you do not meet all of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply!</strong></p> <p><strong>Invest in yourself:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Ownership and Impact: </strong>You are empowered to bring ideas, make decisions, and see your work directly contribute to Moonfare's success.<br><strong>Transparent Environment: </strong>We believe in open communication. You will receive regular updates on company strategy, performance against our KPIs, and key business decisions.</li> <li><strong>Personal Growth: </strong>We support your development with an individual growth budget of €1,500 or 2% of your base salary (whichever is higher).</li> <li><strong>Invest in Your Future: </strong>We support your long-term financial goals with a company pension scheme, providing a 20% employer contribution.</li> <li><strong>Relax and Recharge: </strong>You start with 25 vacation days and you’ll receive one additional day for each year of tenure, up to a maximum of 30 days.</li> <li><strong>Daily Lunch: </strong>Enjoy a free lunch every day that you are in the Berlin office, with a weekly changing menu that includes salads, curries, pastas, and a variety of vegan and vegetarian options.</li> <li><strong>Subsidised Public Transport: </strong>We support your commute with a monthly subsidy for the Deutschland job ticket, making your travel easier and more affordable.</li> <li><strong>Fitness and Wellbeing:</strong> Stay active with a subsidised Urban Sports Club membership, giving you flexible access to a wide variety of sports and wellness activities across Germany.</li> <li><strong>A Culture of Excellence: </strong>Join a team of ambitious, smart, and committed professionals who are passionate about revolutionising private market investing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Values:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Our clients come first, Moonfare comes second, and we prioritise ourselves third - Client-Centric Focus.</strong> Putting clients first means creating value for them is essential. Placing Moonfare second signifies that our individual professional future at Moonfare depends on the company's commercial success. Prioritising ourselves third reflects our humility in putting clients and Moonfare before personal interests.</li> <li><strong>We pursue excellence and honor our promises - Commitment to Excellence.</strong> We hold ourselves to the highest standards, taking responsibility for our failures, and celebrating our successes. We commit to deadlines and stick to them and we learn from our mistakes.</li> <li><strong>We are here to win and to celebrate our collective achievements - Win together. </strong>We are mission-focused and think and act like owners. We exemplify the attitude we expect and each of us commits to do what it takes to succeed.</li> <li><strong>We foster personal growth but each of us earns our place as a Moonfarian through merit - Growth and Merit. </strong>We hire, retain, and develop exceptional people and invest in empowering them to excel. title: Senior Writer, Borrowing
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£68,000 - £88,000 +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> Benefits</a> | 12 month fixed term contract</p> <p> </p> <p>Every word we write matters. From what’s in the app, to job ads (like this one), to error messages, to emails, to internal policies, to… you get the idea.</p> <p>The Writing team isn’t responsible for writing every word though – we’re here to level up Monzo’s writing overall. We have a well-established tone of voice, and people here really care about making sure all our writing is consistently good and works hard for customers. It’ll be your job to keep that quality up through the writing you do. But you’ll also be a champion for great writing by proving the difference it makes, and helping other people to improve their own writing skills.</p> <p>Our never-ending reason to exist is to improve the overall quality of writing at Monzo. That means a culture where care for language is the norm. Everyone, in every role, should understand how important it is to write in a clear, empathetic way, and they should all have the skills to do it. The outcome of that will be world-leading writing for customers. They’ll trust us because our writing is clear, effective and works hard for them.</p> <p>You’ll get together with the other writers pretty regularly to review and showcase work, collect feedback and insights from one another and generally just raise the bar for words at Monzo. And as we hinted at already, you’ll live and breathe our tone of voice, which is propped up by 3 guiding principles: straightforward kindness, everyday magic and warm wit. </p> <p><strong>You’ll be covering our Borrowing Writer while they’re on caregiver leave</strong></p> <p>This is a 12-month fixed term contract covering for our Writer who’s based in the Borrowing collective. That means you’ll be focused on supporting teams working on things like loans, credit cards, overdrafts and other borrowing and credit related projects.</p> <p>You’ll work closely with cross-functional squads of engineers, designers, marketers, researchers and so on to make it an amazing experience for existing customers, and bring new people on board.</p> <p><strong>A typical day could see you</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>collaborating with a Product Designer on some in-app screens </li> <li>collaborating with a Product Marketer on positioning and building messaging toolkits for use across web, growth marketing or CRM</li> <li>sitting in on user research sessions led by the Research team</li> <li>writing error messages with input from engineers</li> <li>editing legal wording alongside our in-house lawyers </li> </ul> <p><strong>Your home will be in Writing<br><br></strong>Alongside the work you do in Borrowing, you’ll contribute to the Writing discipline. We’re always working on new resources, training and processes to make writing easier for everyone at Monzo.</p> <p>Writing is part of the wider Marketing team but this role isn’t only about marketing. In fact, that’s a small part of the job. Your remit will be to improve the quality of the writing that touches your part of the business, inside Monzo and out.</p> <p><strong>This is for you if</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>you understand borrowing and credit products well</li> <li>you’re a dab hand at ‘content design’, ‘UX writing’, ‘product writing’</li> <li>you’re allergic to useless jargon and over-complicated language </li> <li>you know how to use data and research to guide your approach </li> <li>you’re okay bouncing between tasks on a daily basis </li> <li>you’re comfortable questioning a brief and helping people understand why your approach is the right one </li> <li>you’ve done some training or coaching to help other people improve their writing, but this one’s not essential.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This isn’t for you if</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>it’s your first writing job – sorry, but we need someone to hit the ground running </li> <li>you’re a journalist or ad writer</li> <li>you’re only really excited by brand and marketing stuff – that isn’t the focus of this role</li> <li>you prefer to spend most of your time working solo – writing here is a team sport and you’ll need to collaborate with everyone across the company </li> <li>you like lots of top-down direction – you’ll be expected to decide which challenges you tackle with your team, and how to tackle them. </li> </ul> <p><strong>You’ll get</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>the chance to shape the role around what’s good for you, and us </li> <li>very flexible working – we care about what you do, not the minutes you work or where you do it (we love to see our teammates in the office but you don’t have to come in if you don’t want to) </li> <li>a whole load of benefits, including a personal training budget, health insurance, generous caregiving leave and more you can read about here: https://monzo.com/careers/ </li> </ul> <p><strong>Please make sure you give us both a CV and a cover letter. </strong>This is a writing job after all; you should want to show us what you can do. A cover letter also helps us understand why you want the job vs a CV which often just tells us why you might be able to do the job.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves 3 main stages (not including a recruiter call).</p> <ol> <li>Initial call with the Hiring Manager (30mins) </li> <li>Take home task (to be submitted within 7 days) </li> <li>A pair of interviews via Google Meet (each interview lasting up to 60 minutes)</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to ----- You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>£68,000 - £88,800 as a base salary</li> <li>This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK </li> <li>We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</li> <li>Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences </li> <li>And much more, see our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> <strong>here </strong></a></li> </ul> <p><strong>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</strong> <br><br>#LI-JB1 #LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Chief Science Officer
description: Chief Science Officer @ Sereact 🦾 Chief Science Officer (m/f/d) · Zurich or Stuttgart, Boston possible · Reports to the CEO · Full-time Who we are Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex , our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems, mobile manipulators and humanoids that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL. Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a $116 million Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles. Why this role, why now Our robots produce data no lab can stage. Our fleet has recorded more than 500 million manipulation interactions in live warehouse operations; Cortex 2.0 was trained on a curated 10 million of them and added a world model that plans before it acts ( arXiv 2604.20246 ). Cortex 2.5 learns a new task from a few demonstrations instead of a training run. Deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the research team is growing with them. We now want one scientific leader who owns the research behind Cortex end to end and turns what our fleet experiences every day into the next step change in what robots can do. The Real-World Learning Loop is your system Sereact is a frontier research lab and a production-grade robotics company in one. Our bet: general-purpose robotic intelligence “must be learned from live deployments” ( The Real-World Learning Loop , Feb 2026). Every stage of that loop is yours to raise: In-Situ Policy Execution. Every robot in production runs the current policy, and every shift is an experiment. You decide what the policies expose for learning. Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own interactions while they work. You decide what is worth recording and which situations the fleet should go and find. Data Curation and Learning. Novelty, uncertainty, failures and distribution shift decide what we learn from. You own the curation and the training recipe. Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies pass validation gates before they return to the fleet. You set the bar, and how fast we can clear it safely. Every deployment teaches the next one. Your job is to make that loop turn faster and teach more each time. Responsibilities Set the research agenda for Cortex: vision-language-action models, world models and planning, learning from interaction on real robots, and generalization across tasks and embodiments. Make the big bets: which directions get people and compute, and which ones we stop. Own the data strategy: the mix of deployment, teleoperation, open-source and synthetic data, and what the fleet collects next. Own the compute strategy, from large-scale training to real-time inference on the robot. Build the evaluation science: benchmarks that predict performance in a customer’s operation, not only on a leaderboard. Build and lead the research organisation in Zurich and Stuttgart: structure, leads, rhythm. Set the hiring bar and make Sereact the place the best people in robot learning want to join. Take research into production with engineering, so results reach the fleet in weeks and hold up in 24/7 operation. Decide with the founders what we publish, open-source or patent, and build our standing at CoRL, RSS, ICRA, NeurIPS and ICML. Be Sereact’s scientific voice with customers, partners, universities and investors, and build academic partnerships. Partner with the CTO, product and operations, so research, engineering and deployment pull in one direction. Not in scope, by design Software platform, hardware and field deployment engineering. They stay with the CTO and operations: the CTO owns how we build and ship, you own what we learn next. A research lab beside the business. Research at Sereact ends on a robot, ideally at a customer. Product roadmap and pricing. What makes this role hard Research and production compete for the same robots, people and compute. You make that trade-off every week, in the open. Cortex is not a blank page. It already runs in customer operations, and our founders are deeply technical. You raise the ceiling of a running system. A result counts when it holds up in a customer’s operation, not when the paper is accepted. Your first 12 months First 90 days: know the fleet, the data and the team; agree the research roadmap with the founders; one evaluation standard everyone uses. By month 6: a research organisation with clear ownership and a release rhythm from experiment to fleet. By month 12: a new generation of Cortex in customer operations with measurable gains, key senior hires made, and work that puts Sereact on the map of robot learning. What you bring You have led research in robot learning or embodied AI (VLA models, imitation or reinforcement learning, world models) and built a team around it. Your work runs on real robots, ideally outside the lab and for long stretches. You know what breaks first. Scientific standing: a strong record at the top venues and a network that great researchers want to join. You have made real calls on research bets, data and compute, and stopped what did not work. You explain science to engineers, customers and investors alike, and you enjoy it. PhD in machine learning, robotics or a related field, or an equivalent track record. Nice to have: large-scale pretraining of foundation models · fleet learning or data engines · industrial manipulation · experience in both academia and industry. Three questions we will ask you Tell us about a model you took from a paper to a robot that ran for weeks without you. What broke first? If you had our deployment data tomorrow, which bet would you make first, and what would you stop? How do you decide what to publish and what to keep? What we offer Robots in live production that learn every day, and the data that comes with them. A seat in the leadership team of a company scaling from Europe into the US, with meaningful equity. Large-scale compute and the freedom to build the research organisation you would want to work in. Teams in Stuttgart, Zurich and Boston; relocation support. How we hire Conversations with both founders, a research deep dive with the team, and a working session on a real problem from our deployments. We move fast. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Ingénieur en mécanique des fluides
company: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
description: ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr ). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA, pôle thématique de recherche « Structure Interaction Fluide (StIF) » de l’IRDL. Le recrutement s’inscrit dans le projet MULTIRIM, qui vise à développer des solutions innovantes en propulsion marine. Les propulseurs marins à entraînement circonférentiel constituent une alternative aux hélices classiques marines, en présentant plusieurs avantages : manoeuvrabilité, compacité, discrétion acoustique, amélioration de la traînée de la carène par l’absence de ligne d’arbre. Cependant, la présence d’une tuyère embarquant le moteur électrique d’entraînement pénalise le rendement. Une piste d’amélioration est d’adopter un propulseur à plusieurs étages à l’instar des moteurs d’avion, afin de regagner environ vingt points de rendement. La configuration même de l’entraînement extérieur, sans arbre, supprime la complexité mécanique rencontrée sur les hélices contrarotatives classiques. Or, il existe très peu de bancs d’essai pour les propulseurs à entraînement circonférentiel, pour une seule hélice, ainsi que très peu de données expérimentales de référence. Les difficultés sont de deux ordres. Du point de vue fonctionnement, le refroidissement du moteur électrique nécessite des échanges thermiques, et la liaison rotor/stator est assurée par un palier hydrodynamique. La mise ne eau dans une veine hydrodynamique est ainsi obligatoire. Par ailleurs, l’absence d’arbre d’entraînement empêche une mesure aisée du couple d’entraînement, valeur requise pour déterminer le rendement global du propulseur. Intégrer plusieurs étages propulsifs au sein d’un même propulseur au sein d’un banc d’essai expérimental n’a jamais été proposé au niveau international. Cependant, le mode de fonctionnement de l’entraînement circonférentiel le permet aisément. Disposer de résultats expérimentaux de référence, tant pour les efforts globaux que pour l’écoulement (champ de vitesse, de pression) présente un intérêt fort pour la communauté scientifique. En particulier, l'écoulement fortement tourbillonnaire, la présence d'éléments tournants rendent la simulation numérique particulièrement difficile et des résultats de référence permettront de valider les modèles numériques. Aussi, le premier objectif de ce projet est de développer un banc d’essais modulaire, afin de tester plusieurs configurations d’hélices, de vitesses d’entraînement différenciées, de formes de tuyère, et évaluer précisément le rendement global. D’autre part, le principe des moteurs à plusieurs étages est de récupérer la puissance perdue par le premier étage, en redressant l’écoulement, un propulseur idéal accélérant l’écoulement uniquement de manière axiale. Un second objectif du projet consiste à caractériser cette récupération d’énergie opérée par les étages supérieurs. Le projet associe les compétences en modélisation de machines électriques de l’IRENav et les compétences en modélisation hydrodynamique de l’ENSTA-IRDL (UMR CNRS 6027) et de l’IRENav. L’ENSTA met par ailleurs à disposition sa veine aérodynamique dédiée aux applications marines, et l’instrumentation associée. Ce projet s’inscrit dans un projet plus vaste financé par l’Agence Innovation Défense (Projet AID RD-PROP), visant à proposer des méthodologies de modélisation et de conception de propulseurs électriques navals intégrés à entrainement circonférentiel. La personne recrutée sera intégrée dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire de 3 enseignants-chercheurs, 1 doctorante et 2 post-doctorantes. Missions / Activités principales : La personne recrutée prendra en charge la conception et le test d’un banc d’essai multi-étages pour propulseur à entraînement circonférentiel, pour usage en veine aérodynamique. La caractérisation du rendement du propulseur sera réalisée par mesure directe des efforts, et mesure indirecte de la vorticité résiduelle dans le sillage aval à l’aide de mesures non intrusives du champ de vitesse (méthode PIV). La personne recrutée sera amenée à produire des rapports et présentations techniques, mettre en œuvre des essais (étalonnage, mesure d’efforts, velocimétrie laser), et travailler de manière collaborative avec l’ensemble des partenaires du projet RD-PROP. Les missions détaillées sont les suivantes : Tâche 1 : Conception et fabrication d’un banc moteur dédié La conception d’un banc d’essai propulseur s’appuiera sur les compétences de la plateforme de conception MASMECA de l’ENSTA, ainsi que sur l’expertise de l’IRENav sur les moteurs à entraînement circonférentiel. Le banc d’essai sera prévu pour être modulaire, et fonctionner dans une gamme de vitesses de rotation représentative d’un propulseur réel. Tâche 2 : Détermination du rendement maximal atteignable Parallèlement à la conception et la fabrication du banc moteur, un modèle semi-analytique (disque actuateur sous tuyère) sera développé, afin de proposer une estimation théorique du rendement maximal atteignable par un propulseur sous tuyère. Cette estimation prendra en compte la traînée de la tuyère, l’absence de flux transverse dans le sillage aval. La principale simplification concerne le frottement visqueux sur les pales, non pris en compte par ce type de modèle. Tâche 3 : Méthodologie de quantification de l’écoulement transverse Une méthodologie de détermination du champ de vitesses par technique PIV non intrusive dans un plan du sillage sera mise en œuvre, à l’aide d’un laser, d’une caméra rapide et d’un ensemencement de l’écoulement. L’influence de la position de la section transverse par rapport au corps étudié sera étudiée, ainsi que les paramètres numériques de l’algorithme PIV. Différents indicateurs de champ de vitesse intégré seront testés, pour qualifier au mieux la signature de perte de rendement lié à l’écoulement transverse. La méthodologie développée sera validée sur un écoulement classique de la littérature. Tâche 4 : Mise en œuvre d’un benchmark de référence dans la veine aérodynamique de l’ENSTA Le banc d’essai sera utilisé pour une première conception d’un jeu d’hélices contrarotatives (2 étages), adaptées au rim-driven, et d’une géométrie de tuyère simplifiée. Ces premiers tests exploratoires permettront de valider la chaîne complète de test (banc + instrumentation des efforts + post-traitement sillage aval) dans l’objectif de publier à terme un benchmark de référence au niveau international. Les résultats obtenus pourront mener à publication scientifique. title: Post-doctorant en hydrodynamique
company: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
description: ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr ). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA, pôle thématique de recherche « Structure Interaction Fluide (StIF) » de l’IRDL. Le recrutement s’inscrit dans le projet SUBPERF-AI, qui porte sur une démarche de réduction drastique du cycle de développement de nouveaux concepts sous-marins, en s’appuyant sur les progrès récents de l’intelligence artificielle (IA), et plus particulièrement le machine learning. Au contraire de l’existant en IA basé sur des modèles ininterprétables de type boîte noire, le projet vise à construire une méthodologie de construction de modèles physiques, de complexité adaptée à la physique sous-jacente, en ayant recours à l’expertise humaine et se plaçant comme un outil de conception complémentaire dans l’écosystème existant. Les objectifs principaux du projet sont : Développer une méthodologie de détermination automatisée du modèle d’efforts hydrodynamiques de corps sous-marin, avec utilisation de l’IA (machine learning), sur la base des données de la cinématique, des trajectoires, et des paramètres de contrôle, facilement accessibles, lors des essais maquette ou réel, ou lors d’une simulation numérique. Placer l’expert humain en capacité de contrôler la construction du modèle aux différents stades : qualité des données d’entrée, qualité de la phase d’apprentissage du modèle, et outils/règles de certification a posteriori. La personne recrutée sera intégrée dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire de 3 enseignants-chercheurs, un doctorant et un second post-doctorant. Missions / Activités principales : La personne recrutée prendra en charge la construction d’un modèle d’effort hydrodynamique « expert » et la génération de données expérimentales. Le modèle hydrodynamique expert sera déterminé en suivant la méthodologie classique de l’ITTC, à l’aide d’une campagne d’essais dans la veine aérodynamique pour la caractérisation des efforts (essais en modèle captif du type PMM (Planar Motion Mechanism)). Ce modèle sera implémenté dans un simulateur temporel, dont les résultats seront confrontés sur des manœuvres standards réalisées dans le bassin à drones de l’ENSTA. La confrontation des résultats de trajectoires expérimentales aux trajectoires simulées, obtenues sur la base des essais en modèle captif, pourra amener à questionner la méthodologie standard, en particulier lors de la présence de non-linéarités importantes ou de termes croisés non négligeables. Les essais en bassin fourniront par ailleurs les données de cinématique nécessaires au travail de thèse. Les missions détaillées sont les suivantes : Tâche 1 – conception et fabrication d’un drone sous-marin Conception d’un drone générique de géométrie simplifiée, et instrumenté. Le drone recevra un capotage extérieur, afin de tester plusieurs configurations : géométrie parallélépipédique typique d’un ROV d’exploration, et géométrie cylindrique de type drone torpille. Le drone sera instrumenté pour mesurer les paramètres de contrôle, la cinématique et les trajectoires, ainsi que les efforts propulsifs (poussée, couple) et les efforts de contrôle. Tâche 2 – essais statiques et dynamiques en modèle captif Réalisation d’essais de caractérisation dans la veine aérodynamique de l’ENSTA, en similitude complète de Reynolds, pour les vitesses envisagées d’utilisation en eau du drone. Mesure des efforts en statique, sur les 6 degrés de liberté. Caractérisation des efforts de plans porteurs et du propulseur. Mesure des efforts en dynamique, en mouvement forcé à l’aide de l’hexapode : masses et inerties ajoutées, termes liés aux vitesses angulaires. Tâche 3 – Identification dérivées hydrodynamiques Identification des dérivées hydrodynamiques (ou coefficients hydrodynamiques) à partir des essais en modèle captif. Tâche 4 – Adaptation du simulateur temporel Prise en main du simulateur temporel de l’ENSTA, et de l’environnement de développement. Adaptation du code de calcul pour intégrer des lois de commande issues de mesures expérimentales. Tâche 5 – Essais libres et standardisés, en bassin Réalisation d’essais aux trajectoires prédéfinies (zigzag horizontal ou vertical, accélération horizontale, …). Réalisation d’essais pour parcourir l’espace complet des 6 degrés de libertés. Enregistrement de l’historique des contrôles (vitesse hélice, angles plans porteurs, …), des trajectoires et des efforts des organes de contrôle. Tâche 6 – Rejeu trajectoires simulateur temporel Rejeu numérique des trajectoires, afin de valider si le modèle d’efforts est suffisamment complet pour prédire correctement les trajectoires mesurées expérimentalement. Les résultats obtenus amèneront à publication scientifique. Niveau de diplôme et formations Thèse de doctorat dans le domaine de l’hydrodynamique navale. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale. Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment. Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices. Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency. 4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties. Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments. Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases to clean anomalies and maintain a single source of truth. Performance Reporting: Build and manage real-time dashboards providing actionable insights into CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and ROI across experiments. Passionate Builder: You deeply identify with our products. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven team, and this role requires intrinsic dedication rather than a standard 9-to-5 mentality. Technical Analytics Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and data visualization tools. Automation Skills: Proficiency with automation platforms to connect API endpoints and pass payload data reliably. CRM & Automation Platforms: Direct administration experience with platforms like Zoho. Preferred Technical Skills Basic technical understanding of Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS for lightweight API scripting, data manipulation and rapid landing page iterations Mindset & Soft Skills Systems Thinking: Ability to map out complex, multi-step processes and translate business requirements into efficient technical architecture. Agile Adaptability: Comfort operating in fast-paced sprint cycles with changing priorities and a bias toward continuous shipping and learning. Obsessive Attention to Detail: An eagle eye for QA; AI speeds up production, but your judgment ensures quality control and brand alignment. Working Environment & Expectations Execution Velocity: We prioritize shipping experiments quickly, learning from real-world data, and iterating fast. Tooling Ownership & Independence: You will have complete autonomy over our stack. We expect you to proactively recommend and implement the best modern automation and AI solutions. You define the tools you need to win. title: Social Media Manager (m/w/d)
description: Die ÖDP Bayern sucht idealerweise ab Dezember 2026 einen Social Media Manager (m/w/d) für 15 Stunden pro Woche. Die Stelle ist zunächst auf zwei Jahre befristet. Bei uns geht es um Themen, die Bayern direkt betreffen: Natur und Umwelt, sauberes Wasser, Artenvielfalt, direkte Demokratie, Gemeinwohl und politische Unabhängigkeit. Und wir reden nicht nur über politische Veränderungen. Mit Volksbegehren bringen wir sie selbst auf den Weg. Die ÖDP hat „Rettet die Bienen“ initiiert, das mit rund 1,7 Millionen Unterstützerinnen und Unterstützern zum erfolgreichsten Volksbegehren in der Geschichte Bayerns wurde. Auch beim konsequenten Nichtraucherschutz und bei der Abschaffung des Bayerischen Senats spielte die ÖDP als Initiatorin von Volksbegehren eine zentrale Rolle. Aktuell läuft mit „Macht auf Zeit“ das nächste Volksbegehren zur Begrenzung der Amtszeit des bayerischen Ministerpräsidenten auf zehn Jahre. Das bedeutet für Deinen Job: starke Themen, echte Kampagnen, politische Debatten und jede Menge Stoff für guten Content. Was Du bei uns machst Du arbeitest remote oder in der Landesgeschäftsstelle in Passau und kannst bei wichtigen Terminen, Drehs und Aktionen in Bayern vor Ort sein. Du entwickelst und produzierst Content für unsere Social-Media-Kanäle, insbesondere Instagram und TikTok. Du drehst und schneidest Videos, entwickelst neue Formate und bereitest politische Themen so auf, dass sie verständlich, relevant und interessant werden. Du erkennst, welche Themen und Geschichten Potenzial haben, reagierst auf aktuelle Debatten und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Presse- und Kommunikationsteam Redaktionspläne und Kampagnen. Du betreust unsere Community, analysierst Reichweiten und Formate und nutzt die Ergebnisse, um unsere Kommunikation kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Und Du bekommst Gestaltungsspielraum: Wir suchen niemanden, der einfach nur Posts abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Ideen entwickelt, Dinge ausprobiert und unsere Social-Media-Arbeit gemeinsam mit uns weiter aufbaut. Wen wir suchen Ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist uns weniger wichtig als das, was Du kannst. Berufserfahrung, eigene Social-Media-Projekte, journalistische Arbeit, Agenturerfahrung oder ein überzeugendes Portfolio sind ausdrücklich willkommen. Du bewegst Dich sicher auf Instagram, TikTok und anderen relevanten Plattformen. Du kannst guten Content nicht nur erkennen, sondern selbst produzieren. Videoaufnahme und Videoschnitt gehören für Dich dazu. Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Sprache, Bilder, politische Themen und dafür, was Menschen im Feed tatsächlich interessiert. Du arbeitest eigenständig, zuverlässig und pragmatisch und kannst auch mit begrenzten Ressourcen gute Ideen umsetzen. Du interessierst Dich für Politik und kannst Dich mit den grundlegenden Zielen der ÖDP identifizieren. Was wir bieten 15 Stunden pro Woche, zunächst befristet auf zwei Jahre. Freie Zeiteinteilung und eine Aufgabe, die sich gut mit Studium, Familie, Selbstständigkeit oder einer weiteren beruflichen Tätigkeit verbinden lässt. Ein kleines Team, kurze Wege und viel Eigenverantwortung. Bei uns arbeitest Du nicht in einer großen Parteienbürokratie. Wir entwickeln Ideen, probieren Dinge aus und bringen politische Themen gemeinsam auf die Straße, in die sozialen Medien und in die Öffentlichkeit. 30 Tage Urlaub auf Basis einer Fünf-Tage-Woche. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Schick uns einfach ein paar Informationen zu Dir und zu dem, was Du bisher im Bereich Social Media gemacht hast. title: Senior Umwelt- und Raumplaner (m/w/d)
description: Über uns Seit über 25 Jahren stehen wir von Terra Consulting GmbH für unabhängige und innovative Ingenieurdienstleistungen in den Bereichen Verkehr/Infrastruktur, Umwelt, Lagerstätten, Geotechnik, Flächenrecycling, Gebäudeschadstoffe und Altlasten für die Privatwirtschaft und für öffentliche Auftraggeber. Einen Schwerpunkt dabei bilden Projekte der Energiewende. An unseren Standorten in Dortmund und Bonn arbeiten wir mit über 30 Mitarbeitern. Unser Bonner Büro bietet ein breites Spektrum an umwelt- und naturschutzfachlichen Planungsleistungen an, u.a. die Analyse und Bewertung umweltrelevanter Eingriffe sowie die Erstellung von Anträgen und Fachgutachten. Unsere Überzeugungen spiegeln sich in unseren Leistungen wider. Wir legen großen Wert auf einen kooperativen Führungsstil, der auf gegenseitigem Respekt und ein offenes Ohr für neue Ideen basiert. Bei uns stehen die individuellen Fähigkeiten, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven unserer Mitarbeiter im Vordergrund – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Behinderung, Weltanschauung, sexueller Orientierung oder Alter. Als Team setzen wir auf ein faires und wertschätzendes Miteinander und offene Kommunikation untereinander, aber auch gegenüber unseren Kunden. Unsere Hauptauftraggeber sind neben den Lagerstättenbetreibern die Energieversorgungsunternehmen und die Straßen- und Eisenbahninfrastrukturunternehmen. Bei der Terra Consulting GmbH nimmst du aktiv an der Energiewende und dem Infrastrukturausbau teil. Wir schätzen unsere Traditionen, sind offen für Innovationen und entwickeln uns weiter. Möchtest du mitgestalten? Zur Stelle Welche Anlagenstandorte eignen sich für die Energieinfrastruktur von morgen? In unserem Projektteam mit fünf bis sechs Kollegen vergleichst du Alternativen und führst technische Anforderungen, Umweltbelange und raumplanerische Gesichtspunkte zu einer fundierten Bewertung zusammen. Damit schaffst du belastbare Grundlagen für Standortentscheidungen und wirkst an der Genehmigungsunterlage mit. Du übernimmst fachliche Projektaufgaben und entsprechend deiner Erfahrung eigene Teilbereiche. Erfahrene Teammitglieder begleiten deine Einarbeitung und stehen dir als Ansprechpartner zur Seite. Deine Aufgaben Du vergleichst und bewertest Standortalternativen eigenständig anhand fachlicher und rechtlicher Kriterien. Dabei identifizierst Du Konfliktlagen, bewertest Genehmigungshemmnisse und leitest belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen ab. Du analysierst und beurteilst komplexe Planungsunterlagen, Fachbeiträge und Geodaten und führst umweltfachliche, raumplanerische, technische und rechtliche Erkenntnisse zu einer konsistenten Gesamtbewertung zusammen. Du verfasst, strukturierst und prüfst anspruchsvolle Gutachtentexte. Deine Bewertungen, Abwägungen und Schlussfolgerungen begründest Du fachlich fundiert, präzise und nachvollziehbar. Du beurteilst die Belastbarkeit von Quellen, Daten und fachlichen Argumentationen und stellst sicher, dass Aussagen zwischen unterschiedlichen Fachbeiträgen und über mehrere Prüfebenen hinweg konsistent sind. Du identifizierst fachliche Widersprüche, methodische Schwächen und offene Fragestellungen, entwickelst Lösungsansätze und koordinierst erforderliche Klärungen mit internen und externen Projektbeteiligten. Du verantwortest eigene Arbeitspakete und fachliche Teilbereiche, behältst Schnittstellen und Abhängigkeiten im Blick und sorgst für eine nachvollziehbare Dokumentation der Ergebnisse. Das bringst Du mit Ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in Umwelt- oder Landschaftsplanung, Geografie, Raumplanung, Bau- oder Umweltingenieurwesen oder Jura, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Analyse, Bewertung oder Begutachtung komplexer Planungs- und Genehmigungsfragen. Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen und die Fähigkeit, umfangreiche und teilweise widersprüchliche Informationen zu strukturieren, kritisch zu bewerten und zu belastbaren Schlussfolgerungen zusammenzuführen. Sehr gute Fähigkeiten in der fachlichen Textarbeit sowie Erfahrung darin, komplexe Sachverhalte und anspruchsvolle Abwägungen präzise, verständlich und überzeugend zu begründen. Eine eigenständige, systematische und qualitätsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie einen sicheren Umgang mit fachlichen Unsicherheiten, Datenlücken und unterschiedlichen Interessenlagen. Souveräne Kommunikation und die Fähigkeit, fachliche Fragestellungen mit unterschiedlichen Disziplinen und Projektbeteiligten konstruktiv zu klären. Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift - mindestens B1 Niveau Das ist darüber hinaus von Vorteil Vertiefte Kenntnisse im Planungs- und Umweltrecht sowie Erfahrung mit komplexen Genehmigungsverfahren. Erfahrung mit Projekten im Bereich der Energieinfrastruktur und der Bewertung von Standortalternativen. Sichere Anwendung von GIS und Erfahrung in der Auswertung und Interpretation räumlicher Daten. Erfahrung in der fachlichen Koordination von Projektbeteiligten oder in der Qualitätssicherung von Gutachten und Fachbeiträgen. Kenntnisse planungs- und umweltrechtlicher Rahmenbedingungen, Erfahrung mit Energieinfrastruktur sowie GIS-Kenntnisse. Das bieten wir Dir Eine unbefristete Anstellung in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit mit einer attraktiven Vergütung Benefits – Jobticket und monatlich 50 Euro steuerfrei als Debit Card Zusätzliche Absicherung durch eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersversorgung und zu Vermögenswirksamen Leistungen Spannende, abwechslungsreiche Projekte mit echter gesellschaftlicher Wirkung Ein motiviertes, wertschätzendes Team, das Wert auf vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit und gemeinsame Teamentwicklung legt Moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit hochwertiger Ausstattung – inklusive höhenverstellbarer Schreibtische Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten Individuelle Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten für Deine persönliche und fachliche Zukunft Gemeinsame Erlebnisse bei Firmen-Events Du hast den Freiraum, dich einzubringen, zu gestalten und Herausforderungen anzunehmen. So bewirbst du dich Fühlst du dich angesprochen und konnten wir dein Interesse wecken? Dann freuen wir uns über deine vollständigen und aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe deines gewünschten Arbeitszeitumfangs, deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins über den Button auf dieser Seite.
