We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.</p></div><p> </p> <p><strong>THE ROLE</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are looking for a Principal Engineer QA as a senior individual contributor. You will define how quality risk is assessed, measured, and gated across the full streaming </span>path - and embed that craft into engineering teams, who own day-to-day tests and suite health.<span style="font-weight: 400;"><br><br></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Quality strategy & risk </strong>- Build and maintain a living risk model for the streaming chain. Raise effort where failure hurts most. Make coverage vs. speed and pre-release vs. production trade-offs explicit with product and eng.</li> <li><strong>Release constraints & quality gates</strong> - Define what “releasable” means for backend, middleware, and clients - including how continuous backend/middleware delivery is gated relative to client store cadences (web/TV/mobile). Keep gates fast, trustworthy, and hard to bypass.</li> <li><strong>Rollout practice (build with the teams)</strong> - Define and establish staged rollout, canary, and rollback strategies together with eng and SRE/ops. Own the definition; establish and operate them collaboratively.</li> <li><strong>Test architecture</strong> - Set the pyramid and ownership boundaries (unit through E2E, performance, playback/stream validation) so each layer has a clear home inside eng. Drive cross-stack design that exercises real policy and format decisions.</li> <li><strong>Incident & reliability partnership</strong> - Join major quality incidents with a quality lens; strengthen production feedback for streaming health; turn escapes into durable tests, monitors, gate changes, and rollout improvements.</li> <li><strong>Tooling & automation standards </strong>- Set practical standards for frameworks, CI integration, test data, environments, and reporting so teams share patterns with clear ownership and measurable ROI.</li> <li><strong>AI-enabled quality engineering</strong> - Define where AI raises quality leverage: test generation and maintenance, risk-based test selection, failure triage, and incident analysis. Set standards for AI-assisted testing and shape quality expectations for AI-authored code as delivery speed and change volume increase.</li> <li><strong>Mentoring & influence</strong> - Embed quality craft into eng: risk-based testing, quality in PRs, middleware policy and multi-platform client testing. Socialize lightweight, strong-default standards (definition of done, flake policy, critical-path coverage). Influence design reviews when quality risk is material.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL OWN</strong></p> <ul> <li>Org-wide quality strategy, risk model, and whole-stack standards</li> <li>Release constraints and quality gates; definition of “releasable”</li> <li>Definition of staged rollout/canary/rollback strategies (to be established with partners)</li> <li>Test architecture principles and automation norms</li> <li>Cross-stack escape analysis and quality debt for gates and tooling</li> <li>Embedding quality craft in engineering; influencing high-risk designs</li> <li>Standards for AI-assisted testing and quality expectations for AI-authored code</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHO YOU’LL PARTNER WITH</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Engineering</strong> - They implement and own tests/suites in services and clients; you set architecture, gates, and standards, and build quality practice into delivery.</li> <li><strong>Product</strong> - Journey and tenant/feature priority; acceptance of residual risk within the gates you define.</li> <li><strong>SRE / Ops</strong> - Establish and operate rollout strategies together; production signals, incident response, capacity/reliability.</li> <li><strong>Platform/tooling</strong> - CI, environments, shared frameworks, observability for quality signals.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL BRING</strong></p> <ul> <li>Track record as a senior IC in quality engineering (or equivalent) for complex, multi-service products - ideally streaming, media, or similarly high-availability consumer platforms</li> <li>Experience designing whole-stack quality strategy: backend services, configuration/policy layers, and multi-platform clients</li> <li>Ability to define and land <strong>test architecture</strong> (pyramid, ownership, cross-stack integration/contract/playback-style validation) that engineering teams can run and own</li> <li>Strong influence without authority: you raise the bar inside eng teams, socialize standards, and hold the line on gates without managing a QA org</li> <li>Strong software engineering skills at senior level or above; you write production-quality code, not just test scripts</li> <li>Designing and coding for testability, and building automation as a first-class engineering product</li> <li>Deep familiarity with CI/CD, with a track record of making pipelines faster and more reliable</li> <li>Hands-on experience applying AI to quality engineering, with judgment on where it reduces risk and where it adds noise</li> <li>Comfort partnering on incidents and turning production failure modes into durable quality improvements</li> <li>Practical judgment on automation: enough to protect risk, not so much that brittle suites block the org</li> <li>Bonus:<br> <ul> <li>Hands-on engineering background with video ingest, encoding/packaging, playback, or multi-tenant config/policy surfaces</li> <li>Work across web, TV, and mobile client quality risk (device/OS/store constraints)</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong><br>WHY JOIN US? </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.<br><br></span></p> <p><strong>WHAT WE OFFER YOU</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Reward</strong>: strong market competitive salary</li> <li><strong>Recharge</strong>: 30 days vacation plus public holidays</li> <li><strong>Regulate</strong>:<span style="font-weight: 400;">trust based flexible working hours and the option for remote work worldwide for up to 8 weeks per year</span><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></em></li> </ul> <p><strong>Plus:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>We’re </strong><strong>sharing: </strong>Free access to the best streaming experience on the market</li> <li><strong>We're developing: </strong>Your own development budget, German classes and Zattoo all-company hack days</li> <li><strong>We’re inclusive: ‘</strong>Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities</li> <li><strong>We’re healthy:</strong> Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more!</li> <li><strong>We’re responsible:</strong> We are carbon neutral, an active employee Green team, discounted BVG tickets and free bike rentals</li> <li><strong>We’re sociable: </strong>A calendar of events with fireside chats, lunches, in-house bar, BBQ’s, monthly socials, summer party and an annual off-site event</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Zattoo enables our users to view indiscriminately and we reflect that in our team too. Regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law we encourage everyone to apply and will give everyone equal consideration. We are an equal opportunities employer — join us and help build a diverse team dedicated to revolutionising the way you watch TV.</p> <p>We are committed to ensuring fair, open, and equitable hiring practices and are happy to answer any questions you may have about us or the role throughout the whole process. In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we share the applicable compensation range with you before your first interview.</p> <p class="text-justify">You can learn more about us at: <a href="https://zattoo.com/company/jobs/">https://zattoo.com</a></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Commercial Graduate Trainee
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>The opportunity:</strong></h3> <p>You just graduated and you know you want a commercial career, but you're not sure which lane yet. Sales? Account management? Something else?</p> <p>12 months inside Flexport's commercial engine. Four rotations, four mentors, one goal: find where you fit.</p> <ul> <li>Months 1–3: Open doors as an SDR</li> <li>Months 4–6: Manage clients as an Account Manager</li> <li>Months 7–9: Close deals alongside a top salesperson</li> <li>Months 10–12: Go deep in Operations, Marketing, or Customs — your pick</li> </ul> <p>You'll have a named 1:1 mentor each block, plus one programme-wide buddy who stays with you the entire year. You'll also build with low-code tools alongside our engineering team. Global trade runs on tech now, not just relationships. </p> <p>The payoff: after a successful completion of the program you will get a permanent Account Executive, Business Development Rep, or Account Manager role by month 12, plus a company-wide network most new hires take years to build.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong><br>Block 1 – Sales Development: generate pipeline through outbound outreach, qualify leads, and keep Salesforce updated.<br>Block 2 – Account Management: support client meetings, identify upsell/renewal opportunities, and learn the customer lifecycle.<br>Block 3 – Sales: support a full sales cycle from discovery to close, including deal structuring and negotiation.<br>Block 4 – Elective: complete a project in Operations, Marketing, or Customs of your choice.</p> <p>Alongside all four blocks, you'll also join Engineering sessions every two weeks, learn low-code/no-code tools, and build your own capstone project by year-end.</p> <p><strong>Is this you?</strong><br>• A recent graduate (Bachelor's or Master's) — any discipline<br>• Fluent in German and English<br>• Willing to relocate to Hamburg or Frankfurt<br>• Strong affinity with commercial roles but unsure which exact direction<br>• Comfortable learning new tools and systems<br>• No sales experience required<br>• Solution-oriented, self-motivated, detail-oriented and organised</p> <p><strong>Please note that fluency in both German and English is required. We kindly ask our candidates to apply with a CV in English! :-) </strong></p> <p><strong>What's in there for you: </strong></p> <ul> <li>An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment</li> <li>Lunch food delivery 4 days a week incl. vegetarian options, a salad bar and special menu options, plus breakfast options, snacks, soft drinks and barista coffee.</li> <li>Health insurance:  employee contribution part is covered by Flexport</li> <li>25 paid vacation days</li> <li>Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members</li> <li>Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="1704749847.557549" class="c-virtual_list__item" data-qa="virtual-list-item" data-item-key="1704749847.557549"> <div class="c-message_kit__background p-message_pane_message__message c-message_kit__message" data-qa="message_container" data-qa-unprocessed="false" data-qa-placeholder="false"> <div class="c-message_kit__hover" data-qa-hover="true"> <div class="c-message_kit__actions c-message_kit__actions--default"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter__right" data-qa="message_content"> <div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <h4>Commitment to Equal Opportunity</h4> <p>At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <h4>Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants</h4> <p>Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at <a href="http://www.flexport.com/privacy" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=http://www.flexport.com/privacy&source=gmail&ust=1613840050053000&usg=AFQjCNHD63svlkD-hWHlGuGOM_bSYVrnpw">www.flexport.com/privacy</a> for additional information.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Demand Generation
description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. 🌟 Your main goal will be to own and scale the end-to-end demand engine that turns our builder community and PLG motion into a high-performance pipeline engine for Mid-Market & Enterprise. To do so, you’ll design and lead acquisition, activation, and expansion programs across all channels, backed by strong analytics, experimentation, and cross-functional collaboration. PIPELINE CREATION & OWNERSHIP Drive pipeline creation targets across paid media, SEO, content, events, ABM, and partner/community co-marketing Define and manage full-funnel experiences from website/CRO to trial activation and enterprise nurture Build and run ABM programs for top accounts with AEs, SDRs, and SEs EXPERIMENTATION & FUNNEL OPTIMIZATION Run a high-cadence experimentation program on messaging, pricing, conversion flows, and more Improve PQL to MQA to SAL conversion through clear stage definitions and sales alignment Instrument lifecycle journeys with onboarding, trial nurturing, and PQL warming TEAM LEADERSHIP & OPERATING RHYTHM Act as a player-coach for a growing team of 2–4 FTEs and agencies, scaling to 6–8 in 12–18 months Set the operating cadence: weekly title: Product
description: About Atira Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, to orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, to generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP. We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us! Why Product is the only role that sees the whole thing "If I had asked people what they wanted, they would have said faster horses.” - Henry Ford Our FDEs go deeper into a single customer than anyone else at Atira. What nobody can see from inside one account is the shape that all the accounts share. You hold the version of the problem that is bigger than any single customer's description of it, and you break it into steps small enough to ship every month. Then you defend it. Every deployment produces requests: A few are the next platform feature, most are a customer-specific detour that should never be touched. You are the person who cares the most about consolidating solutions and has the technical depth to do something about it, which means you decide what comes in and what does not. As Atira scales we build industry-specific pods: FDE, AE, BDR and Product Marketer, led by a GTM Engineer. Pods go deep. Product goes wide. Everything a pod learns has to end up in one platform, and you are the reason it does. Make sure we do not chase faster horses. What you will do Own the problem, not the request. You understand which customer's ask is part of which bigger problem and you hold the maximum version of where this goes. Then you do the more challenging half: turning it into opinionated steps that ship, each one compounding into the next, so what we build becomes a staircase instead of a pile of features Decide what scales and what doesn't. You sit at the boundary between customer work and the core engineering team. You turn recurring patterns into features and you kill the rest. In an ideal world you are opinioonated on every FDE PR that touches shared code or introduces a customer-specific path Build the agents that make Atira work. You go deep on each customer's technical sales process, understanding it in all its details. You extend our harness to solve the most complex job functions of our users: how to configure machines according to the engineering experts, how to price large service agreements for billion dollar infrastructure projects, or how to automate the multi-stakeholder internal communication. And you can translate that into code Ship the platform end to end. Full-stack feature conceptualization and execution, from the harness through the UI a sales engineer actually uses Collect Feedback in front of the users that ultimately are your sounding board What we are looking for Taste, ownership, and systems thinking. You can build almost anything now, which makes judgment about what to build the bottleneck. You see the problem behind the request, you decide in the absence of a brief, you say no to founders and to customers with reasoning that survives the room, and you own the outcome including the downside. Your profile Systems thinking, in both directions. Upward: you find the problem behind the request and can hold a version of it bigger than what any single customer describes. Downward: you see the second-order effects, that one per-customer config field means a migration on every future deployment and one more thing every FDE explains in onboarding. Taste you can point at. You can show us things you have built and shipped that you are proud of, and a clear opinion on what you deliberately left out. Deep software engineering fundamentals underneath a native use of agents. Strong Python, TypeScript or a related language. You judge and ship production-grade code, and you can review someone else's. Practical exposure to AI engineering (agents, harnesses, evals, RAG), deeper system design understanding or infra knowledge Demonstrated ownership and initiative: a company you started, a leading role in a student initiative, an open-source project, a serious side build, or a role where you owned an outcome others would have delegated You get excited by complex hardware. You can explain in your own words why an agentic sales engineer at an ETO manufacturer is a business worth building, and what Atira is trying to become What you'll get Real ownership: you'll be one of the early team members and shape both product and architecture as well as work closely with customers Strong peers: work with people who have built and shipped AI systems in industrial environments at scale before, and the chance to learn directly from them Impactful work: your code is deployed all across Europe's and US industrial backbone, affecting how complex products and services are sold and configured worldwide Competitive salary & equity package and additional benefits including Wellpass, JobRad and company dinners Most importantly: collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function, but we will do so with modesty and integrity What success looks like after a few months Someone new can hear you describe what we are building and walk away with the same picture the founders have, plus a clear view of which step comes next You have contributed your own thoughts to our general product vision and conceptualized a clear path forward to implement high prio features You have shipped full-stack features and agents into production that are used across multiple accounts, and every one of them came from a request that showed up at more than one customer The FDEs say the platform got easier to deploy, not harder Your no's carry as much weight as your yes's, with the founders and with customers Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

This is made possible by our revolutionary Patronus watch: At first glance, it doesn’t look like an emergency watch, yet it allows users to easily call for help anytime, anywhere. Now we're going from prototype to product, and we need exceptional engineers to make it happen. This is a rare chance to join at the ground floor of a deep tech startup solving one of the hardest problems in autonomous systems. You'll write code that flies (literally) and see it tested on real hardware within days, not quarters. If you're excited by computer vision, robotics, and building things that matter, keep reading. You'll own core parts of the navigation stack from computer vision pipelines to real flight tests. No abstraction layers, no waiting. You write code and watch it fly on hardware you helped build, within days, not quarters. Computer vision: visual inertial odometry, SLAM, and OpenCV pipelines AI object detection and segmentation on NVIDIA Jetson (CUDA) ROS 2 autonomy stack integrated with ArduPilot via MAVLink Embedded Linux deployment with Docker on real UAV platforms and handhelds Simulation in Gazebo and NVIDIA Isaac Sim, plus real flight testing near Dresden What you need to succeed Strong software engineering skills in C++ and Python; comfortable with Git Background in computer science, electrical engineering, robotics, or a related field Friendly, open communicator who thrives in small, collaborative teams Highly self motivated: you take ownership and drive things forward Solid English skills (German is a plus but not required) What we offer Early stage equity: meaningful ownership in a company at the very beginning Direct, daily collaboration with the founders. No layers, no politics. Real hardware, real flights, real users. Your code ships on drones, not dashboards. title: Junior Supply Chain Engineer - Operations (H/F)
description: Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé. Nous avons l’obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd’hui utilisés par des millions d’utilisateurs. Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l’accompagnement d’un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé . Au sein de l'équipe Supply Chain basée à Issy-les-Moulineaux, nous recherchons un·e Junior Supply Chain Engineer – Opérations en CDI. Vous serez le point de contact de nos entrepôts en France et aux États-Unis, et le référent des opérations physiques : rework, reconditionnement, opérations à valeur ajoutée et retours B2B et B2C. En collaboration avec les équipes ADV, Planning, Qualité et Service Client, ainsi qu'avec nos collègues aux États-Unis et en Chine, vous veillerez à la fiabilisation de ces flux, à l'évaluation de leur performance et de leurs coûts. Vos missions principales : 1. Entrepôts et stocks Être le point de contact de nos entrepôts en France, aux États-Unis et en Asie, et veiller au respect des process. Garantir la fiabilité des stocks : inventaires tournants et trimestriels, réconciliation 3PL / ERP, traitement du stock dormant. Mettre en place les opérations à valeur ajoutée : rework, kitting, personnalisation. 2. Retours et reconditionnement Gérer les retours B2B et B2C, et harmoniser les process entre l'Europe, les États-Unis et l'Asie. Piloter la chaîne de refurb (diagnostic, tests qualité, remise en stock) et le suivi des pièces détachées. 3. Performance et coûts Suivre les KPIs opérationnels (stocks, délais, retours, transporteurs) et produire le reporting mensuel. Analyser les coûts logistiques, contrôler la facturation des prestataires et identifier des leviers d'économie. 4. title: Software Engineer (Threat Intelligence), Cloudforce One
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>London, UK</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudforce One is Cloudflare’s threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs).  Cloudforce One works in close partnership with external organizations and internal Cloudflare teams, continuously developing operational tradecraft and expanding ever-growing sources of threat intelligence to enable expedited threat hunting and remediation.  Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world’s largest global networks can provide.  The team is able to analyze these unique data points, at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.</p> <p>As a Software Engineer on this team, you will own the entire software development lifecycle—from design and architecture to deployment and monitoring—for systems that serve both threat disruption and legal response efforts. You will be responsible for translating complex legal and security requirements into robust, scalable, and high-performance applications that have a direct impact on making the internet better, safer, and more powerful every day.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>While the majority of our services are now written in Golang and TypeScript, you will also work with technologies such as Rust, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, Terraform, Temporal and PostgresSQL. We are looking for great engineers regardless of experience with any of these specific technologies.</li> <li>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</li> <li>Design, build, run, and scale distributed tools and services that support both cyber threat disruption and platform abuse efforts.</li> <li>Develop critical data pipelines and services to collect, analyze, and expose threat intelligence data for Cloudforce One analysts and Cloudflare customers, helping to identify Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) and Indicators of Compromise (IOCs).</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Threat Intelligence, Trust & Safety, Legal, and Product teams to understand goals and translate complex technical requirements into elegant, scalable solutions.</li> <li>Improve system design and architecture to ensure stability, performance, and maintainability of both internal and customer-facing compliance and security services.</li> <li>Analyze, communicate, and help prioritize complex technical concepts across teams.</li> <li>Ongoing monitoring and maintenance of production services, including participation in on-call rotations.</li> <li>Mentor and guide other developers in the team, helping to build collective technical expertise and promote best practices for writing well-tested, modular, and reusable code.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with AI-assisted development and agentic AI workflows</li> <li>At least 5 years of experience building large-scale software applications, preferably distributed systems</li> <li>At least 3 years of experience working with Threat Intelligence or in support of a Threat Intelligence platform</li> <li>Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs and/or gRPC services</li> <li>Knowledge of SQL and common relational database systems such as PostgreSQL</li> <li>Prior <li>Interest in opportunities to be a technical mentor for teammates</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Deep understanding of DNS, TLS/SSL and HTTP</li> <li>Expertise in web security issues and industry standards for access control</li> <li>Experience with Kafka</li> <li>Experience building web applications using React</li> <li>Experience with Kubernetes</li> <li>Experience with Redis</li> </ul> <h3>Equity:</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? title: Website Growth & CRO Manager
description: Berlin, Deutschland · Vollzeit Wichtig: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1 oder C2) ist für diese Position zwingend erforderlich , da die Optimierung von Website-Texten ein zentraler Teil der Aufgabe ist. Bewerbungen mit einem niedrigeren Deutschniveau können leider nicht berücksichtigt werden. Die Rolle Wir suchen einen analytisch starken, umsetzungsorientierten und unternehmerisch denkenden Website Growth & CRO Manager (m/w/d), der die Verantwortung für unsere Websites übernimmt und sie zu leistungsstarken digitalen Vertriebskanälen weiterentwickelt. In dieser Rolle treibst du Verbesserungen auf unseren Websites, Landingpages und Conversion-Funnels voran. Dabei verbindest du datengetriebenes Experimentieren mit einem guten Gespür für UX/UI, überzeugenden Texten und einem tiefen Verständnis für das Verhalten unserer Kund:innen. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Conversion-Rates, erkennst Wachstumspotenziale und setzt Erkenntnisse in konkrete Verbesserungen um. Außerdem wirkst du an der Entwicklung eines neuen Produktkonfigurators mit und gestaltest intuitive digitale Erlebnisse, die es unseren Kund:innen leichter machen, unsere Produkte zu entdecken, zu individualisieren und zu kaufen. Wir suchen jemanden, der analytisch denkt, schnell handelt und Freude daran hat, Ideen von der Erkenntnis bis zur Umsetzung zu bringen. Auch Berufseinsteiger:innen mit außergewöhnlichen analytischen Fähigkeiten, viel Eigeninitiative und großem Potenzial sind herzlich eingeladen, sich zu bewerben. Deine Aufgaben Website-Verantwortung: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für bestehende Websites, Landingpages und Conversion-Funnels und erkennst kontinuierlich Möglichkeiten, die Performance und die Customer Journey zu verbessern. Conversion-Rate-Optimierung (CRO): Du konzipierst und setzt A/B-Tests für ganze Seiten und einzelne Bereiche um, um die Conversion-Rates zu steigern und messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen. UX/UI & Web-Erlebnis: Gemeinsam mit Designer:innen und mithilfe von KI-Tools gestaltest du intuitive, visuell ansprechende und konversionsstarke Web-Erlebnisse. Copywriting & Messaging: Du entwickelst überzeugende Headlines, Alleinstellungsmerkmale (USPs), Calls-to-Action (CTAs) und Website-Texte auf Deutsch, die unser Wertversprechen klar vermitteln und zum Handeln motivieren. Growth-Experimente & User Research: Du übersetzt Daten und Kundeneinblicke in konkrete Verbesserungen. Eigenständig führst du Kundenbefragungen und User Research durch, um Reibungspunkte und Wachstumschancen zu identifizieren. Produktentwicklung: Du wirkst am Aufbau eines neuen Produktkonfigurators mit und gestaltest das digitale Erlebnis rund um unsere Produkte. Bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit: Du treibst Umsetzung und Verbesserungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams Performance Marketing, Content, Design und Tech voran. KI-gestützte Umsetzung: Du setzt KI-Tools proaktiv ein, um Abläufe zu beschleunigen, Lösungen zu entwickeln sowie Qualität und Tempo der Umsetzung zu steigern. Dein Profil MUSS: Deutsch auf C1- oder C2-Niveau. Du schreibst und optimierst Website-Texte auf Deutsch als zentralen Teil deiner Arbeit. Profile mit einem niedrigeren Deutschniveau können nicht berücksichtigt werden. Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denken und kaufmännisches Verständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, aus Daten klare Prioritäten und messbare Verbesserungen abzuleiten. Erfahrung oder nachweisbares Potenzial in Digital Product Management, Growth, Conversion-Rate-Optimierung (CRO), Growth Design oder E-Commerce. Sehr gutes Verständnis von UX/UI-Prinzipien und ein ausgeprägtes ästhetisches Gespür für intuitive, ansprechende digitale Erlebnisse. Talent für klare, überzeugende Website-Texte und kommerzielle Botschaften, einschließlich Headlines, USPs und CTAs. Unternehmerisches Denken, ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein sowie die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen, Initiative zu ergreifen und Ideen bis zur Umsetzung voranzutreiben. Sicherer Umgang mit KI-Tools als fester Bestandteil deines Arbeitsalltags, um Produktivität und Problemlösung zu verbessern. Starke Problemlösungskompetenz, Neugier und die Bereitschaft, zu experimentieren, zu lernen und dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Berufserfahrung: Wir freuen uns über Kandidat:innen mit etwa 3–5 Jahren relevanter Berufserfahrung. Außergewöhnliche Berufseinsteiger:innen mit 1–2 Jahren Erfahrung, einem starken analytischen Mindset, viel Eigeninitiative und herausragendem Potenzial sind ebenfalls herzlich eingeladen, sich zu bewerben. Warum wir? Ein internationales und unternehmerisches Umfeld: Du arbeitest mit Kolleg:innen in Berlin, Breslau und Helsingborg zusammen. Echte Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du hast direkten Einfluss auf das digitale Kundenerlebnis, die Conversion-Rates und das Unternehmenswachstum. Eine Kultur des Vertrauens und der Entwicklung: Du ergreifst Initiative, gestaltest Ideen und wächst gemeinsam mit einem kollegialen, ambitionierten Team. Ambitioniertes Wachstum auf starkem Fundament: Du wirst Teil eines etablierten, gründergeführten Unternehmens, das auf langfristiges Wachstum, Qualität und den Aufbau einer skalierbaren Organisation setzt. Ein besonderes Produkt in einer besonderen Branche: Du gestaltest die Zukunft der Beschilderung mit, indem du physische Produkte, Technologie und digitale Kundenerlebnisse verbindest. Standort & Arbeitsmodell Standort: Berlin, Deutschland Beschäftigungsart: Vollzeit Vertragsart: Unbefristete Festanstellung Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description: <h3>🧡 About Alma</h3> <p>At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place, serving merchants and consumers.</p> <p>Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.</p> <p>As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered more than 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.</p> <p>With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!</p> <p> </p> <h3>👐 About the team</h3> <p>Growth is part of the Revenue team. We build Alma's merchant acquisition engine: which merchants we target, how we find, identify and qualify them, how fast a qualified merchant reaches the right salesperson and, with lifecycle, how we convert, activate and retain them, in France and in our international markets.</p> <p><strong>We work AI-native, by design.</strong> Everyone in Growth works in Claude Code with a shared library of skills and connectors, a common repository that holds our workflow spec, our decision log and our merchant context, and a simple delivery lifecycle (Research → Spec → Plan → Build) where each stage ends with a human decision. Claude does the legwork; a person decides. Correctness comes from automated verification (tests, adversarial agent review, live validation), and every production change goes through a pull request with a named reviewer from DevX or SRE.</p> <p><strong>We are rebuilding our GTM system</strong> around five layers: market definition, signals, data & enrichment, decision & routing, and activation. As part of it, we are moving our merchant lifecycle off HubSpot to a modern customer engagement platform. Braze leads, <a href="http://Customer.io">Customer.io</a> is in the running, and we want your view. You will lead that migration and the lifecycle programme built on top of it.</p> <p><strong>You will join a team of 6</strong> with a Growth Ops, a Growth Engineer, a Paid Acquisition Manager, a Senior GTM Engineer (hiring) and an Experimentation & Tracking Engineer (hiring), and you will report to Julian, Team Lead Growth.</p> <p> </p> <p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">This position is a permanent contract (CDI) based in Paris, hybrid.</span></p> <h3>💼 About the job</h3> <p><strong>Own the B2B lifecycle, from lead to active merchant</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and run the journeys that drive revenue: lead nurturing, onboarding, activating signed merchants who haven't taken a first payment, retention and win-back.</li> <li>Reach the right merchants at the right moment with the right message, using segments built on live data (industry, size, country, TPV, product usage).</li> <li>Run a yearly campaign calendar (seasonal moments, product launches, credit upsell) next to the always-on journeys, with clear pressure rules. Start with email, then add in-app, POS materials for in-store merchants, and new channels when the data supports them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Help drive Alma's move towards consumers</strong></p> <ul> <li>Alma is opening up to B2C, with new consumer products on the way. You'll be the first lifecycle person to work on it, and you'll get to invent how Alma talks to consumers.</li> <li>It starts small next to the merchant work and is set to grow fast.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Lead the migration off HubSpot</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help pick the platform. Braze is the front-runner, and if you think <a href="http://Customer.io">Customer.io</a> or another tool fits better, make the case.</li> <li>Audit what runs today, decide what to rebuild, improve or drop, and plan the switch so no key communication stops along the way.</li> <li>With the Growth Engineer and Data, define the data model, consent management and deliverability setup, then switch off HubSpot marketing on schedule.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Measure what you ship</strong></p> <ul> <li>Use control groups and A/B tests by default. Report on activations, reactivations and influenced TPV rather than open rates.</li> <li>Build your own segments and analyses, and share what works with Sales, Account Management and Revenue Marketing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Be the CRM project lead across Revenue</strong></p> <ul> <li>Align Sales, Account Management, Ops, Product Marketing, Brand and Legal on shared campaigns: you own the brief-to-delivery workflow, set the pace and arbitrate.</li> <li>Make other teams autonomous on simple communications (templates, tone of voice, golden rules), so you can focus on the programmes that move revenue.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>🗓️ Your first months</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Months 1–3:</strong> you audit our current lifecycle (HubSpot workflows, onboarding emails, scattered tools), give your recommendation on the target platform and define its setup with the Growth Engineer, and keep priority campaigns running while you prepare the switch.</li> <li><strong>By month 6:</strong> onboarding, activation and retention journeys run on the new platform with control groups; HubSpot marketing is switched off; a yearly campaign calendar is shared with Sales, Account Management and Product Marketing.</li> </ul> <h3>🧰 You will work with</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Lifecycle:</strong> Braze, <a href="http://Customer.io">Customer.io</a> or equivalent (decision in progress). HubSpot until we switch it off.</li> <li><strong>Revenue systems & data:</strong> Salesforce (system of record), BigQuery, Looker</li> <li><strong>AI & delivery:</strong> Claude Code (skills, connectors), Notion, Linear</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>🧩 About you</h3> <p><strong>To succeed in this job</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years in lifecycle, CRM or marketing automation, across both B2B and B2C. On the B2B side, you have run programmes hand in hand with Sales or Account Management on large portfolios (1,000+ accounts). On the B2C side, you have built consumer activation and engagement journeys at scale.</li> <li>A campaign manager first: you turn a business goal into a segment, a timing and a message, and you can show the revenue impact of your past programmes.</li> <li>Hands-on with a modern customer engagement platform: Braze, <a href="http://Customer.io">Customer.io</a>, Iterable or equivalent. You build journeys, segments and personalisation yourself, and you have opinions on what each tool does well and where it falls short. Having led or contributed to a platform migration is a strong asset.</li> <li>Data autonomy: you pull your own segments and results from a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), design tests with control groups, and understand how data flows between a CRM, a warehouse and a marketing platform.</li> <li>Cross-functional leadership: you have owned projects involving several teams without formal authority, and you know how to prioritise when everyone needs your time.</li> <li>Excellent writing in native-level French (mandatory) and fluent English.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>And it will be nice if you also</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have set up Braze, <a href="http://Customer.io">Customer.io</a> or a similar platform from scratch, or helped choose one.</li> <li>Have set up email deliverability (sending domains, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, IP warm-up).</li> <li>Already use AI in your daily work for copy, QA or analysis.</li> <li>Have worked in fintech, payments, a card launch, or with retail merchant networks.</li> <li>Speak Spanish, Italian or German.</li> </ul> <p><em>Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.</em></p> <p> </p> <h3>🧘 What's in it for you</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Impact</strong>: 26,000 merchants in 10 countries, thousands of signed merchants still to activate, and a consumer audience to build. Every journey you ship shows up in TPV.</li> <li><strong>A clean start</strong>: you join in time to weigh in on the platform and set it up properly (data model, deliverability, governance) instead of inheriting years of workflow debt.</li> <li><strong>Leverage</strong>: an AI-native team and engineers next to you for the data plumbing, so you spend your time on segments, messages and results.</li> <li><strong>Team</strong>: a Team Lead Growth who designed this way of working, and close partners in Sales, Account Management, Ops and Product Marketing.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>🤑 Compensation & Benefits</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Competitive salary</strong> based on 12 months</li> <li><strong>Profit sharing and employee savings plan</strong></li> <li><strong>Health insurance</strong>: <strong>100%</strong> covered by Alma including family package</li> <li><strong>Disability insurance</strong>: <strong>100%</strong> covered by Alma</li> <li><strong>Sport</strong>: partnerships with <strong>Gymlib</strong> and <strong>Classpass</strong>, or <strong>€30/month</strong> reimbursement for your sports activities</li> <li><strong>Maternity/paternity leave</strong>: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.</li> <li><strong>Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD)</strong>: <strong>€544.80/year</strong> (excluding full remote contracts)</li> <li><strong>Meal vouchers</strong>: <strong>€10/day</strong>, 50% covered by Alma</li> <li><strong>Mental health</strong>: free access to MindDay platform</li> <li><strong>Paid time off</strong>: 25 days/year (+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)</li> <li>Access to our <strong>Learning & Development Platform</strong></li> <li><strong>2 weeks of full remote possible</strong> per year in summer</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>🎯 Interview Process</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member</strong> to understand your path, motivation & present you the role.</li> <li><strong>Video call with your future manager</strong> to deep dive the role, the team, your profile and answer all your questions.&lt

title: Senior Software Engineer - Distributed Systems (ODP Governance)
description: <p><strong>Senior Software Engineer - Distributed Systems (ODP Governance)</strong></p> <p>ODP Governance is a cross platform team working in the biggest Datadog products (Metrics, Logs, APM) with the mission of giving customers governance tools to control costs and data hygiene of their telemetry.</p> <p>Our team builds cost controls and governance tools that help Datadog’s enterprise customers manage data ingestion, reduce unwanted data, and prioritize the telemetry that delivers the most value.</p> <p>Our scope spans multiple Datadog products, including Metrics, Events, Logs, and APM. As a backend engineering team, we partner with these product teams to address recurring customer challenges that create operational friction, increase costs, and contribute to churn.</p> <p>We also identify opportunities to extend successful capabilities across products—for example, adapting a control developed for Logs to support APM.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.</em></p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Build performant high scale distributed systems to handle the load of Datadog’s biggest products</li> <li>Build relationships across teams and independently seek out the information needed to move work forward.</li> <li>Become productive in unfamiliar systems and navigate ambiguity.</li> <li>Anticipate technical dependencies and integration challenges early.</li> <li>Recognize when a solution could benefit another product and take the initiative to explore it.</li> <li>Connect engineering decisions to customer value, cost efficiency, and usability.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 6+ years of experience</li> <li>You have significant backend programming experience in one or more languages (Go, Java, Rust, C++) </li> <li>Distributed systems engineer with experience building high performance large scale systems. </li> <li>Excellent communication skills (English).</li> <li>High proactivity and cross-team collaboration experience</li> <li>You’re excited about leveraging AI tools to enhance how you code, solve problems, and build – or eager to learn how</li> <li>You have demonstrated ability to use AI coding tools in day-to-day workflows and validate, critique, and refine AI-generated output</li> <li>Bonus: You’re motivated to push the boundaries of how AI can improve software engineering best practices and contribute to building AI-enabled products</li> </ul> <p><em>Datadog values people from all walks of life. title: Agentic AI Principal
description: <div class="description content"> <p>We are looking for an Agentic AI Principal to act as a senior technical authority and trusted client advisor for complex agentic AI transformation in Germany, the Netherlands and the wider DACH region.</p> <p>Operating at Principal level, you will shape enterprise AI strategy, define agentic architecture blueprints, lead high-value C-suite engagements and guide complex programmes from opportunity through delivery. You will bring deep hands-on credibility in multi-agent systems, governance and safeguards, while setting reusable patterns and raising capability across teams.</p> <p>The role has particular focus on sovereign, compliant and production-grade agentic AI for regulated German, Dutch and European enterprises, with a primary focus on healthcare and life sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech and healthcare providers). Experience from other regulated sectors, such as financial services and insurance, automotive and manufacturing, energy and telecommunications, is equally welcome.</p> <p>Our delivery model is moving from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first, multidisciplinary pods accountable to a business outcome. You will anchor the agentic side of that work, pairing with our data, tech advisory and industry domain leads from presale through delivery.</p> <p>This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation.</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <p><strong>Shaping and winning</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Agentic AI advisory and strategy:</strong> shape and solution complex German, Dutch and DACH pursuits with account, commercial and delivery leaders, translating client needs into differentiated propositions, credible architectures and executable delivery approaches that support regional pipeline conversion.</li> <li>Independently drive complex pursuits with technical and executive stakeholders, including shaping the commercial model (fixed-price, outcome-linked), trade-offs and risk.</li> <li>Act as a sparring partner to C-suite buyers (CEO, CIO, CDO, CISO, COO): frame business-outcome hypotheses, challenge assumptions and define a thin slice of agentic delivery that proves value quickly.</li> <li>Lead AI maturity assessments, identify and prioritise processes for agentisation, and connect architecture choices to measurable business value and ROI.</li> <li>Represent Thoughtworks' agentic AI expertise in strategic client conversations, industry forums, partnerships and thought leadership where appropriate.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Designing and building</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Design and build engineering:</strong> set the architecture direction for complex, production-grade agentic AI systems, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, memory, context strategy, retrieval, evaluation, observability and enterprise integration.</li> <li>Integrate agents with the German enterprise core: SAP (S/4HANA, BTP), LIMS, QMS and clinical systems, MES/PLM and industrial systems, and legacy back-office platforms, using open protocols such as MCP and A2A where they fit.</li> <li>Ensure agents run on trustworthy data foundations, working with data engineering and data product teams on data quality, semantics and access.</li> <li>Design solutions for regulated German and EU environments, with strong consideration of data sovereignty (EU and German sovereign cloud, open-weight or self-hosted models where required), privacy, security, responsible AI and applicable regulation, including the EU AI Act and GDPR; for healthcare and life sciences GxP, EU MDR/IVDR and the European Health Data Space; and for other sectors DORA, NIS2 and BaFin requirements where relevant.</li> <li>Guide teams in balancing rapid experimentation with robust production engineering, including evaluation-driven development, testing, CI/CD, reliability, cost and performance optimisation.</li> <li>Provide technical and delivery leadership for complex programmes, staying hands-on enough to validate architecture, unblock teams, manage technical risk and ensure successful execution.</li> <li>Partner with product, data, software engineering, enterprise architecture, governance and change specialists to design end-to-end solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Governance and safeguards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Establish reusable patterns for observability, auditability, traceability and control of agentic systems, enabling teams to demonstrate safe and reliable behaviour in production.</li> <li>Translate EU AI Act obligations (risk classification, human oversight, logging, technical documentation, GPAI-provider responsibilities) into concrete engineering controls and evidence.</li> <li>Engage early with works councils (Betriebsrat, ondernemingsraad), data protection officers and information security, supporting DPIAs and co-determination processes so agentic solutions that touch employee workflows can go live.</li> <li>Anticipate technical, organisational and governance challenges in enterprise AI adoption and define practical approaches to address them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Principal-level leadership and growing capability </strong></p> <ul> <li>Set reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards and governance practices across multiple teams and engagements, influencing the evolution of Thoughtworks' agentic AI capability beyond an individual programme.</li> <li>Set technical direction across multiple teams and initiatives, defining reusable patterns, frameworks and engineering standards for agentic AI delivery.</li> <li>Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, build the next generation of the German team, and raise AI fluency and agentic engineering standards across specialists and generalists.</li> <li>Evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and frameworks and guide their responsible adoption based on client context, engineering quality and business value.</li> <li>Build our German and Dutch market presence through local-language points of view, ecosystem and partner initiatives (hyperscalers, SAP, European model providers) and community events.</li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li>Deep expertise in modern software engineering and Python, with a strong track record of setting standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, maintainability and production reliability.</li> <li>Recognised experience architecting and delivering complex GenAI and agentic AI systems at enterprise scale, from early discovery through production deployment.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of agentic architectures and frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex or equivalent, including tool use, orchestration, memory, multi-agent coordination and interoperability protocols (MCP, A2A).</li> <li>Strong expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation, advanced information retrieval, vector databases and enterprise knowledge integration.</li> <li>Experience designing evaluation strategies for GenAI and agentic systems, including quality, safety, reliability, latency and cost measures.</li> <li>Strong understanding of AI governance and safeguards, including guardrails, red-teaming, observability, responsible AI and secure deployment practices (prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse).</li> <li>Significant experience deploying AI systems on major cloud platforms using containers, orchestration and production-grade infrastructure patterns, including EU sovereign cloud, hybrid or on-premises setups and self-hosted open-weight models.</li> <li>Experience with model adaptation and optimisation techniques, including prompt/context engineering, fine-tuning where appropriate, and application-level performance optimisation.</li> <li>Ability to make sound architecture trade-offs across model capability, reliability, security, compliance, performance and cost.</li> <li>Working knowledge of the EU AI Act, GDPR and sector rules (for healthcare and life sciences: GxP and GAMP 5 computerised-system validation, EU MDR/IVDR, EHDS; for other sectors: DORA, NIS2, BaFin) and how they shape agentic system design.</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Strongly preferred: delivering AI in healthcare or life sciences (e.g. R&D, clinical, regulatory, manufacturing quality, commercial).</strong></li> <li>Nice to have: integrating agents with SAP and industrial or manufacturing systems; data product and data platform foundations for AI.</li> </ul> </div> <h3>Consulting and Commercial Track Record</h3> <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>Proven ability to lead C-suite and senior client engagements, rapidly establish credibility and advise on both business and technical choices.</li> <li>Strong consulting and commercial judgement: you can point to data and AI (ideally agentic or GenAI) pursuits you helped shape, sell and deliver in the last three to five years, from around €3M–5M upwards, including fixed-price or outcome-linked elements.</li> <li>Experience shaping, solutioning, selling and delivering complex deals of €5M+ in the last few years. Annual target of solutioning, selling and delivering €10M+ TCV in Data & AI deals with an AI-first delivery focus.</li> <li>Comfortable discussing P&L, business cases and ROI with executive buyers, not just architecture.</li> <li>Consultancy or professional-services experience within the last five years, ideally with German, Dutch or DACH enterprise clients.</li> <li>You have grown a practice, capability or go-to-market asset (e.g. a reusable accelerator).</li> </ul> <h3>Professional Skills</h3> <ul> <li>Executive presence and communication skills, making complex agentic AI concepts, risks and trade-offs clear to technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Proven leadership of complex delivery across multidisciplinary teams, moving fluidly between strategy, architecture, governance and hands-on technical leadership.</li> <li>Ability to influence across organisations without formal authority, align diverse stakeholders and navigate ambiguity in high-value or high-risk programmes.</li> <li>Proven ability to mentor senior engineers and technical leaders and raise standards across a wider engineering community.</li> <li>Self-directed, prioritisation-led working style, with creative problem-solving in fixed-scope, outcome-driven work.</li> <li>Experience navigating German and Dutch stakeholder structures, including works councils, data protection officers and procurement.</li> <li><strong>German B2 minimum</strong>, C1 strongly preferred; fluent English. Dutch is a plus for Netherlands-based candidates.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h2 id="imp

title: Partner Account Manager, Intégrateurs de solutions de gestion
description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Localisation et déplacements Poste basé à Paris , selon la politique hybride de Pennylane, avec des déplacements réguliers en France auprès des partenaires, de leurs équipes et lors d’événements professionnels. Le portefeuille pourra inclure des partenaires franciliens et nationaux ; son allocation définitive sera précisée avec le manager. Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ? Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant. Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action : Développer les comptes partenaires , en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell , en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence , grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant , en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain , en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes. Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur. Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes. Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes. Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles. Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu. 2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire. Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable. Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane. Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés. Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion. 3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires. Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe. Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau. Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation. Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats. 4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes. Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités. Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs. Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux. Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire. 5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales. Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires. Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat. Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage. Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence. 6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées. Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales. Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires. Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective. Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires. Profil recherché : Compétences incontournables : Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs; Tu as idéalement au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS B2B ; une expérience plus senior sera appréciée pour gérer des partenaires stratégiques et des cycles complexes; Tu sais élaborer et piloter des plans de croissance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction et des équipes opérationnelles; Tu as une approche commerciale orientée résultats, sais piloter un pipeline et transformer les analyses en actions concrètes; Tu es à l’aise dans les rendez-vous terrain, les négociations, les présentations et les démonstrations produit; Tu sais engager plusieurs parties prenantes chez un partenaire et construire une relation de confiance dans la durée; Tu es proactif, créatif et résilient : tu sais prendre des initiatives et maintenir une dynamique même lorsque les résultats prennent du temps; Tu es rigoureux dans le suivi des opportunités, le forecast et l’utilisation du CRM; Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des fonctions commerciales, marketing, produit et opérations; Tu maîtrises le français et peux participer à des échanges professionnels en anglais. Atouts appréciés Une connaissance des solutions de comptabilité, finance, gestion, ERP ou logiciels de gestion pour les PME; Une expérience auprès d’intégrateurs, de revendeurs, de VAR ou d’éditeurs logiciels B2B. Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de distribution logicielle et des enjeux de déploiement chez les clients; Une expérience de gestion de grands comptes partenaires, de plans de migration de parc ou de cycles Resell et Cosell. Ce que nous recherchons surtout : Au-delà de ton expérience, nous recherchons une personne qui : Sait créer rapidement de la confiance et de la crédibilité auprès de dirigeants et d’équipes terrain; Aime être au contact des partenaires et transforme cette proximité en actions commerciales mesurables; Sait conjuguer vision stratégique du compte et exécution opérationnelle au quotidien; Est à la fois autonome, coachable et généreuse dans le partage de ses apprentissages avec l’équipe; A envie de contribuer à la croissance d’un réseau historique tout en faisant évoluer ses pratiques. Process de recrutement : Screening Talent Acquisition — 45 min : motivation, expérience en partenariats logiciels, connaissance de l’écosystème et disponibilité pour les déplacements. Entretien Hiring Manager — 45 min : réalisations concrètes, gestion de portefeuille, activation et développement de partenaires, approche terrain et collaboration. Étude de cas — environ 1 h : analyse d’un portefeuille d’intégrateurs, proposition d’un plan de croissance, priorisation du pipeline Resell/Cosell et présentation d’une approche de démonstration ou d’enablement. Entretien final — environ 45 min : vision du canal, contribution stratégique, collaboration transverse et adéquation avec les ambitions de Pennylane. 🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir : 🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind) 🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile) 🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés 🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking 🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris 💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE 🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib 💻 Un Mac 🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’en
