title: AI Engineer (Agentic AI)
description: Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves. HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day. As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you. You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together. You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date. You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence. You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law. You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter. You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like. You have several years of experience in software or ML engineering. Depth in recent projects counts for more than years. Strong experience in agentic AI. You have good knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries. You have helped build an LLM application that runs in production. Not just prototypes, notebooks or courses. You have hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or comparable orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer (RAG) setup is not enough. You have measured the quality of an LLM system with evaluation sets or observability, and can give a concrete example. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus. You have back-end experience, including building REST APIs. You have experience in Kubernetes. Experience with Postgres is useful. Experience in a legal, tax or other knowledge-intensive domain is a plus. WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck. A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction. Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet. Base salary between €4,477 and €5,793 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below). A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%. 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it. A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance. A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance. Collective insurance plans. A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement. Two days a week in the office in The Hague, within walking distance of Voorburg station. The rest of the week, wherever you work best. Room to grow: in your craft, in your role, in the organization. WANT TO KNOW MORE? We'd love to tell you everything about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you'll hear from us within 2 working days. Any questions first? Text or call Nadine at 0628556265. A reference check and a VOG (certificate of good behaviour) are part of the selection process. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Owner Clinical Registries
description: Our mission We turn data into better healthcare. With our insights, we make healthcare more affordable and better, and we improve the patients’ and clinicians’ experience. Our mission We turn data into better healthcare. With our insights, we make healthcare more affordable and better, and we improve the patients' and clinicians' experience. Your impact Dutch clinical registries are among the richest sources of outcome data in Europe. At LOGEX, that data reaches clinicians and hospitals through applications such as Codman and Data Entry, and reaches researchers and healthcare professionals through data requests and exports. As Senior Product Owner you own that portfolio end to end: the applications that clinicians use every day, and the data pipelines that power them. You also make sure that what we build strengthens the wider LOGEX platform wherever possible. title: Software Engineer, Agentic Commerce
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon, or London (Hybrid)</strong></h3> <div class="container"> <div id="model-response-message-contentr_ccb59069932b9a6f" class="markdown markdown-main-panel md-content enable-luminous-fast-follows enable-updated-hr-color stronger tutor-markdown-rendering"> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>We build the infrastructure that makes the web <strong>Payable</strong>, powering the future of machine-to-machine commerce.</p> <p>Here at Cloudflare, agentic commerce is a core part of our vision for the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/the-agentic-internet/">Agentic Internet</a>. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We build tools that make the new internet payable by giving our users the ability to monetize access to their content, data, services, products, and outcomes across the Internet, regardless of where they are hosted.</p> <p>Building these capabilities requires solving complex engineering problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, usage metering, outcome verification, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols (such as x402, WBA, ACP, and UCP). We bridge mainstream fiat commerce rails with decentralized protocols, enabling micro-payments at Internet scale.</p> <p>We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Agentic Commerce team to build the core systems, protocols, and customer-facing tools powering machine-to-machine payments, metering, and monetization.</p> <p>In this role, you will design and ship scalable software across edge infrastructure, transaction engines, protocol layers, and developer tooling (such as our Monetization Gateway). You will work on cutting-edge standards, cryptographic authentication, and commerce controls that enable businesses to define pricing terms, authenticate agents, verify outcomes, and manage agent-generated revenue streams.</p> <h3>What you'll do</h3> <ul> <li>Design and ship production-ready, low-latency services that make web resources <strong>Payable</strong> for autonomous agents using emerging standards (x402, WBA, ACP, UCP).</li> <li>Build high-precision systems for usage metering, pricing definition, outcome verification, and value attribution tailored for agentic workflows.</li> <li>Build secure protocols and capabilities for authenticating and authorizing buyers, sellers, and autonomous agents across host-agnostic endpoints.</li> <li>Develop capabilities and APIs that give businesses granular visibility, telemetry, and control over agent-generated revenue, billing, and settlement.</li> <li>Build resilient bridges between mainstream fiat commerce rails, digital wallets, and decentralized/cryptographic payment protocols for Internet-scale micropayments.</li> <li>Write clean, secure, well-tested code, maintain strict accounting/financial precision, and advocate for high reliability, security, and low-latency performance.</li> <li>Partner with software engineers, researchers, product managers, design engineers, and cross-Cloudflare stakeholders to take capabilities from concept to production.</li> </ul> <h3>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Strong software engineering and distributed systems fundamentals.</li> <li>Experience building and operating reliable, high-throughput, low-latency production services.</li> <li>Solid understanding of HTTP, APIs, payment protocols/rails, web security, or cryptographic authorization.</li> <li>Hands-on experience or deep interest in payment systems, usage metering, billing engines, digital wallets, or machine-to-machine interaction protocols.</li> <li>Ability to rapidly prototype, evaluate architectural trade-offs, and ship solutions in a fast-moving, emerging technical domain.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Fluency in Rust (with a big plus for experience in async Rust) or TypeScript/JavaScript edge runtimes (e.g., Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, KV).</li> <li>Experience with emerging agentic payment protocols (x402, A2P, ACP, UCP, Web Bot Auth) or digital wallet architectures.</li> <li>Experience building high-precision event metering pipelines, usage-based billing engines, outcome verification systems, or revenue attribution tools.</li> <li>Experience with smart contract bridges, cryptography (public-key encryption, signatures, hashes), or hybrid fiat/crypto payment infrastructure.</li> <li>Open-source contributions to payment systems, agent protocols, web standards, or distributed systems projects.</li> <li>Proven track record of debugging and resolving performance, concurrency, or transactional correctness bottlenecks.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h3><strong>Compensation</strong></h3> <p><strong>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="1">● For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €54,000 - €75,000.</p> <ul data-path-to-node="2"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">The final offer will be inclusive of time exemption, in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="3"><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment

title: CRM & Marketing Intelligence Manager (m/w/d)
description: Jobbeschreibung Für den Maschinenraum suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen CRM & Marketing Intelligence Manager (m/w/d) mit einer starken Analysefähigkeit für Daten und der Entwicklung sowie Umsetzung von konkreten Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Engagement und Loyalität unserer Mitgliedsunternehmen. Über den Maschinenraum Der Maschinenraum ist das geteilte Innovationsökosystem deutscher Mittelstands- und Familienunternehmen, um gemeinsam Zukunftsthemen besser zu verstehen und mutiger zu gestalten. Gemeinsam mit rund 80 Mitgliedsunternehmen – darunter Fiege, Sennheiser, Vorwerk und Viessmann – bietet der Maschinenraum Formate und Strukturen, um Transformation systematisch anzugehen: durch den Austausch von Erfahrungen, den Aufbau von Kompetenzen und die Entwicklung konkreter Lösungen. Das Team aus rund 40 Mitarbeitenden betreut die Mitgliedsunternehmen, entwickelt Trainings- und Beratungsformate und betreibt einen Co-Innovation-Space im Herzen Berlins. Als CRM & Marketing Intelligence Manager (m/w/d) bist du die datengetriebene Kraft hinter unserer Mitgliederkommunikation. Du analysierst, wie sich unsere Mitglieder verhalten – welche Formate sie nutzen, wo sie aktiv sind und wo sie abspringen – und übersetzt diese Erkenntnisse in gezielte Maßnahmen, die Engagement und Bindung stärken. Du konzipierst zusätzlich Strategien zur Identifizierung und Ansprache von neuen Zielgruppen und Kontaktpersonen im Netzwerk. Was du bewirkst CRM-Management & Datenstruktur Du verantwortest die Pflege und Weiterentwicklung unserer CRM-Struktur in Salesforce und stellst sicher, dass Daten vollständig, aktuell und auswertbar sind. Du baust ein KPI-Framework auf, das dem Team eine datenbasierte Steuerung ermöglicht und erstellst regelmäßige Reportings, aus denen du Optimierungsmaßnahmen ableitest. Zielgruppen- & Verhaltensanalyse Du analysierst das Verhalten unserer Mitglieder systematisch – auf Basis von CRM- und Analytics-Daten – und entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis dafür, was verschiedene Zielgruppen antreibt und was sie zurückhält. Du bist verantwortlich für die Segmentierung unserer bestehenden Mitgliederbasis und erstellst Strategien für und mit unseren Teams, wie sie diese zielführend identifizieren und ansprechen. Growth & Retention Maßnahmen Auf Basis deiner Analysen entwickelst und steuerst du gezielte Handlungen sowie automatisierte Marketingmaßnahmen zur Steigerung von Awareness, Engagement und Loyalität. Du arbeitest dabei eng mit den anderen Teams des Maschinenraum zusammen und unterstützt sie mit Handlungsempfehlungen für die Weiterentwicklung sowie Vermarktung von Angeboten. Stellenanforderungen Das bist du Du denkst in Daten, aber handelst in Maßnahmen. Du weißt, dass Zahlen allein nichts verändern – und verstehst es, Insights in überzeugende Empfehlungen und konkrete Umsetzung zu übersetzen. Du bringst 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im CRM, Growth Marketing oder einer vergleichbaren datengetriebenen Rolle mit – idealerweise in einem B2B-Umfeld, einem E-Commerce oder einer mitgliederbasierten Organisation. Du hast nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Zielgruppensegmentierung und Verhaltensanalyse sowie in der Ableitung konkreter Kommunikations- und Marketingmaßnahmen. Du arbeitest sicher mit Salesforce (Sales/Marketing Cloud) – alternativ bringst du tiefes Know-how in vergleichbaren B2B-CRMs (z. B. HubSpot) mit und hast keine Scheu vor Salesforce Du bringst Erfahrung mit relevanten KI-Tools in den Bereichen Analyse und Marketing Automation mit. Du denkst strukturiert, arbeitest präzise und kannst komplexe Datenzusammenhänge klar und verständlich kommunizieren. Du bist eigeninitiativ und verlierst dich nicht in der Analyse – du willst Dinge bewegen. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau ist Voraussetzung; gute Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Was dich erwartet Verantwortung & Freiraum: Die Möglichkeit, datenbasiertes Marketing in einer der spannendsten Netzwerkorganisationen im deutschsprachigen Mittelstand von Grund auf aufzubauen. Teamwork: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Member Success und Kommunikationsteam. Hybrid Work: Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit einer ausgewogenen Mischung aus Präsenz in unserem Büro und der Möglichkeit, nach Bedarf mobil zu arbeiten Arbeitsplatz & Lage: Ein moderner Space im Herzen Berlins mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung Impact & Ökosystem: Ein purpose-getriebenes Unternehmen mit einer klaren Vision und einer inspirierenden Community aus Mittelstand, Start-ups und VCs Teamkultur: Eine wertschätzende Feedback-Kultur mit Mut zu neuen Ideen, regelmäßigen Teamevents (z.B. title: Product Manager - Field Service Management (SaaS)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>The Joblogic Story</strong></h3> <p>Established in 1998, <strong>Joblogic</strong> is the UK’s #1 <strong>Field Service Management</strong> (FSM) software platform. We are a global business with offices in the <strong>UK</strong>, <strong>Pakistan</strong>, and <strong>Vietnam</strong>. Since our management buy-out in 2013, we have grown from <strong>~£500K </strong>ARR to <strong>~£35M+ </strong>ARR and expanded our team from 11 to 500+ people.</p> <p>Recently, we secured a strategic growth investment from <strong>Vista Equity Partners </strong>— a global technology investor specialising in enterprise software. This investment includes over <strong>£100</strong> million in new primary capital and will fuel our next phase of growth by accelerating our <strong>AI-first roadmap</strong>, expanding our platform into CAFM (Computer-Aided Facilities Management) capabilities, and supporting our expansion across Europe and beyond.</p> <p>With <strong>Vista’s </strong>backing, we’re transforming from a successful UK business into a global scaling SaaS rocket ship, and we’d love for you to join us on our journey to <strong>£100M </strong>ARR across international markets.</p> <p><strong>Joblogic </strong>provides software to service contractors who install and maintain the built environment. Our platform helps businesses streamline operations, improve profitability, ensure compliance, and achieve rapid growth. With over <strong>100,000</strong> users across industries including HVAC, plumbing, electrical maintenance, facilities management, and building fabric maintenance, we are entering a new era of intelligent automation, predictive maintenance, and data-driven decision-making for service firms.</p></div><p> </p> <h2 id="about_the_role_0">About the role</h2> <p>We are looking for a Product Manager with strong experience in Field Service Management (FSM), Facility Management, or operational workflow-driven SaaS products.</p> <p>As a Product Manager at Joblogic, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our platform by deeply understanding how service contractors operate and translating complex operational workflows into intuitive product solutions.</p> <p>You will work closely with engineering, UX, customer-facing teams, and customers themselves to identify real-world operational challenges and build solutions that simplify the daily work of engineers, planners, helpdesk teams, and operations managers.</p> <p>This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving real operational problems, working closely with users, and building workflow-driven B2B SaaS products.</p> <h2 id="what_your_main_focus_will_be_1">What your main focus will be</h2> <p>Lead discovery with customers across <strong>field service and facilities management operations</strong>.</p> <p>Understand and map operational workflows including:</p> <ul> <li>Reactive maintenance jobs</li> <li>Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM)</li> <li>Scheduling and dispatch</li> <li>Field engineer mobile workflows</li> <li>Asset lifecycle management</li> <li>Quote → job → invoicing journeys</li> </ul> <h2>You will be expected to:</h2> <ol> <li>Translate complex operational problems into clear product requirements and solution design.</li> <li>Work closely with UX designers to create intuitive workflows and product experiences.</li> <li>Define and prioritise roadmap initiatives aligned with product strategy and customer value.</li> <li>Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and deliver real operational impact.</li> <li>Validate product ideas title: Netzwerkingenieur (m/w/d)
description: Bei FlixTrain gestaltest du die Zukunft der Mobilität aktiv mit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben. Als Netzwerkingenieur (m/w/d) bei FlixTrain verantwortest du die Technologie, die bestimmt, wie unsere Fahrgäste an Bord verbunden sind, navigieren und jede Reise erleben - von WLAN und Netzwerk-Infrastruktur über On-Board-Units bis hin zu mobilen Endgeräten für unser Zugpersonal. In einer Bahnwelt, in der Konnektivität zum entscheidenden Differenzierungsmerkmal wird und Technologien wie Starlink neu definieren, was möglich ist, prägst du unmittelbar, wie FlixTrain vorne bleibt und weiterhin hochwertige, unvergessliche Reisen bietet. Als Teil des Product-Development-Teams im Bereich Rolling-Stock & Maintenance sorgst du dafür, dass unsere On-Board-Hardware ein herausragendes Reiseerlebnis für unsere Fahrgäste, einen reibungslosen Betrieb und eine gute Arbeitsumgebung für unser Zugpersonal ermöglicht. Deine Arbeit beeinflusst direkt, wie FlixTrain im Wettbewerb um Konnektivität an Bord die Nase vorn behält und verlässliche, hochwertige Reiseerlebnisse liefert. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Operations, Customer Product und FlixTech sowie mit externen Partnern wie Talgo, ECMs und Lieferanten (z. B. Icomera, Advantech) zusammen. Über die Rolle Du verantwortest das gesamte On-Board-Technologie-Ökosystem von FlixTrain - WLAN, Netzwerke, On-Board-Units und mobile Endgeräte - und gibst dich nie mit dem Status quo zufrieden Als zentrale technische Ansprechperson für alle On-Board-Systeme bewertest du Spezifikationen, wägst Trade-offs ab und triffst fundierte, gut begründete Entscheidungen Kontinuierlich überwachst du die Performance unserer On-Board-Technologie, erkennst Probleme frühzeitig und treibst Verbesserungen voran, die jede Reise reibungsloser machen Cross-funktionale Projekte rund um Konnektivität, Netzwerk-Performance und die Integration mobiler Endgeräte in die Fahrzeugflotte leitest du eigenverantwortlich und mit klarem Fokus auf Wirkung Technische Spezifikationen und Netzwerkarchitekturen definierst du so, dass sie ambitioniert und zugleich umsetzbar sind und nahtlose Schnittstellen zu unserer Fahrzeugflotte gewährleisten Testszenarien und funktionale Validierungen entwickelst du - besonders an der kritischen Schnittstelle zu Kund*innen und Zertifizierungsstellen – und stellst so sicher, dass unsere Lösungen im echten Betrieb funktionieren Neue Technologien wie 5G, IoT und Starlink behältst du im Blick und übersetzt deine Erkenntnisse in konkrete Empfehlungen für die Technologie-Roadmap von FlixTrain Über Dich Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Telekommunikation, Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich Mit mehr als zwei Jahren praktischer Erfahrung in Netzwerkarchitektur, WLAN-Systemen oder Mobile Device Management überzeugst du - idealerweise im Umfeld von Schienenfahrzeugen oder einer vergleichbar komplexen technischen Umgebung Ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz zeichnet dich aus, ebenso wie nachweisliche Erfahrung im Troubleshooting komplexer Netzwerksysteme unter Zeitdruck Verantwortung übernimmst du gern: Du bringst Themen eigenständig zum Abschluss und leitest cross-funktionale Initiativen mit Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Teams und Disziplinen souverän Klar und überzeugend kommunizierst du mit technischen Expert*innen wie auch mit nicht-technischen Stakeholdern, ohne dabei an Präzision zu verlieren Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse bringst du mit, da du in einem internationalen Team arbeitest und mit deutschsprachigen Lieferanten und Behörden zusammenarbeitest Von Vorteil ist Erfahrung mit Lieferanten von Schienenfahrzeugsystemen sowie Vertrautheit mit dem vertraglichen, technischen und regulatorischen Umfeld der Bahnbranche Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Was Wir Bieten Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie. Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten. Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen. Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige. Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen. Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen. Warum Teil von Flix werden? Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. title: Senior Manager Tax Planning & Strategy
description: SumUp's tax function is scaling to match a business that now spans more than 40 entities. This role is a senior partner to the Head of Tax across the Group's tax agenda. You'll bring your own judgement to the most important topics, from how Pillar Two, CbCR, and ATAD III affect our structure to how we manage tax risk in audits, and you'll help the Head of Tax turn those views into a clear Group direction. This role reports to the Global Head of Tax and will have an impact on SumUp's IPO readiness. What you'll do Lead delivery of SumUp's tax agenda across corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and indirect tax, within the Group tax strategy set by the Head of Tax Oversee the transfer pricing framework and its implementation, and propose improvements to both substance and automation Draft and maintain tax policies, controls, and governance documentation for Group entities, for sign-off by the Head of Tax Act as the first point of contact for tax authority audits and controversies, keeping the Head of Tax aligned on positions and exposure Provide independent technical judgement on high-stakes tax positions, challenging assumptions and bringing options and recommendations to the Head of Tax Partner with Tax Compliance and Tax Operations to keep strategic positions compliant and operationally workable Lead the Pillar Two and CbCR implementation, turning requirements into practical plans for affected markets Lead, develop, and prioritise the tax team, and deputise for the Head of Tax when required You'll be great for this role if… Senior tax experience across corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and indirect tax in a multinational, combining strategic leadership with hands-on technical delivery. A track record of building in-house tax expertise, with a preference for developing capability internally and using external advisers selectively, for specialist opinions and peer review rather than day-to-day analysis. Proven track record developing senior tax team members, including people leadership, prioritisation, and performance development. Strong knowledge of European corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and cross-border structuring, along with Pillar Two, CbCR, and EU Directives. Experience leading tax audits and controversies, including extensive direct engagement with tax authorities. title: International Expansion
description: About Us At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the Dutch market. Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen. This role will assess Axle’s participation in Dutch markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace. You speak Dutch and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset. What you will be doing Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue. High-level strategy development, defining and executing Axle’s international expansion plans, and assessing the commercial value of Dutch markets and business models. Diving deep into policy and regulations, understanding how market access works and what needs doing to achieve it. Developing the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships with key stakeholders. You’ll be jumping on the phone (and eventually, getting on the ground) with grid operators, utilities/retailers and potential clients to create and disprove hypotheses as quickly as possible. Acting as a conduit between partners and engineering teams creating fast, structured feedback loops that help translate field insights into meaningful product enhancements. As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets. You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments. This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification. What’s in it for you This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience. We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. You’ll be based in the Netherlands. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. title: Staff Software Engineer, Payments
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. You’ll design and build scalable backend services, REST APIs, event-driven systems and integration components within a microservices architecture, connecting with our React frontend. You’ll drive complex initiatives across payment gateways, acquiring, issuing, card networks and local payment methods, while partnering with product, business, infrastructure and external engineering teams to turn merchant needs into technical solutions. Strong experience designing and operating high-volume distributed systems, preferably in payments, fintech, commerce or financial infrastructure. Recent hands-on experience with Java or Kotlin and Spring or Spring Boot. Expert experience building REST APIs, backend microservices, Kafka-based event streams and distributed data stores such as Cassandra, Hazelcast, Oracle Coherence or similar. Experience with cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS, plus Docker and Kubernetes. Strong familiarity with observability and operational tooling such as New Relic, StatsD, ELK, Datadog, Prometheus or similar. A proven ability to lead projects from concept to production, with a focus on quality, testing, reliability and maintainability. Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence across engineering, product and business stakeholders. Preferred Experience building payment gateways, acquiring platforms, issuing platforms or payment acceptance infrastructure. Experience integrating major card networks such as Visa and Mastercard. Experience with local payment methods such as iDEAL, Klarna, Trustly or similar. Familiarity with authorisation, capture, refunds, chargebacks, settlement, reconciliation, fraud, risk or PCI/compliance workflows. Experience mentoring senior engineers and leading cross-team technical initiatives. You'll thrive here if You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself. You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you’re thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders. You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA. The challenge is balancing performance, reliability, local complexity, and commercial outcomes in the same system, where small improvements can materially affect conversion and failures are immediately visible. You speak German and fluent English. Other European languages are also be an asset. What you will be doing Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue High-level strategy development, defining and executing Axle’s international expansion plans, and assessing the commercial value of German markets and business models Diving deep into policy and regulations, understanding how market access works and what needs doing to achieve it Developing the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships with key stakeholders. title: Director of Customer Programs
description: SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution! As Director of Customer Programs , you will serve as a high-impact, hands-on strategic leader responsible for designing, scaling, and executing global customer engagement and educational initiatives. We are looking for an impact-seeker—someone driven by the scope of customer outcomes and revenue expansion. Leading a global team of individual contributors across international markets, you will bridge the gap between high-level strategy and direct execution. You build the engine, not just run it: scaled, AI-native programs that lift GRR/NRR across the long tail without scaling headcount linearly. You will take personal ownership of defining, launching, and scaling our strategic flagship initiative: the SoSafe Education Program. You will treat this initiative as a business you’re launching: define the case, the targets, the pilots, and fine tune to what moves the needle. Here's how you'll make a difference: Strategic Leadership and execution Develop and directly execute a strategy to drive product adoption, user engagement, and lifetime customer value across a long-tail, multi-region customer segment. Take full strategic and operational ownership of the new SoSafe Education Program , defining its roadmap, curriculum strategy, and rollout execution, supported by 1 fully dedicated individual Personally design and deploy program-driven retention strategies that directly impact GRR and NRR performance targets across global accounts. Team Leadership, Coaching & Operations Lead, mentor, and actively coach a multilingual, global team of individual contributors, maintaining proximity to the work and leading by example. Foster a high-bar culture focused on individual accountability, coachability, data-driven decisions, and operational excellence. Build scalable frameworks, workflows, and automated processes to ensure consistent program quality across global regions. AI, Technology & Cross-Functional Alignment Leverage AI tools, automation technologies, and customer analytics to streamline workflows, optimize program efficiency, and scale output. Partner closely with the broader Customer Success team, Marketing, Product, and Sales to eliminate friction in customer journeys and align strategic priorities. Collaborate with Marketing to manage clear handoffs between community/advocacy initiatives and education programs. Own program-level KPIs such as adoption, engagement and retention impact. Add experiments and a clear link from program activity to GRR/NRR movement. What makes you a great fit: Proven Leadership: 5+ years of direct leadership experience managing customer success, customer education, or customer programs teams in a SaaS environment with a demonstrated track record of success Revenue Ownership: Proven experience holding accountability for or directly driving GRR and NRR metrics through scalable program execution. "Doing" Manager Mindset: Strong balance of strategic vision and active execution—you enjoy getting into the details, building from scratch, and solving complex problems yourself. Technological Edge: Redesign programs from first principles with AI and automation, and question what should still be manual. Coachability & Resilience: High degree of self-awareness, openness to real-time feedback, and a history of working through complex challenges in fast-paced environments. Written Precision & Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex strategies into clear plans of action. Nice to Have Experience scaling customer programs in a fast-growing, mid-stage SaaS environment ($75M+ ARR). Experience in the Cybersecurity industry Fluency in German or additional European languages What we offer* Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days, and parental leave support Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, Corporate Discounts, Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, an individual development budget, dog-friendly HQ *Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Connectivity
description: About Us Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world. The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone. Role Summary We are seeking a highly skilled Backend Cloud Engineer proficient in Java and Kotlin to join the Connectivity team. The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of cloud-native architecture and the ability to write resilient, concurrent code. In this role, you will work on cutting-edge systems—managing a diverse ecosystem of both container-orchestrated workloads on Kubernetes and event-driven serverless functions—to build robust microservices that handle complex, high-throughput data streams at scale. This position is based in our Berlin office and operates on a hybrid model, requiring at least three days per week on-site. Responsibilities Build, optimize, and maintain highly reliable, scalable, and distributed microservices from prototype to production. Leverage automation to reduce roadblocks, streamline deployment pipelines, and achieve consistent deliverables. Design, implement, and maintain robust, secure, and performant APIs using REST and gRPC, optimizing for both internal microservice communication and external consumption. Work with data serialization technologies such as Protocol Buffers (Protobuf). Ensure backend technical feasibility, optimize applications for maximum performance, and handle high-throughput asynchronous processing. Implement and champion engineering best practices, including comprehensive code reviews and rigorous testing. Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 3+ years of professional experience in backend development, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work on complex, scalable cloud services. Experience deploying backend services across both serverless (AWS Lambda) and Kubernetes environments, including containerizing apps (Docker), familiarity with GitOps tools like ArgoCD and Helm is a strong plus. Strong proficiency in Java and Kotlin (experience with TypeScript for backend/serverless environments is a plus). Hands-on experience developing within the AWS Cloud platform (e.g., EC2, Lambda, MSK, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, Secrets Manager, Parameter Store) and a strong understanding of how backend applications interact with these managed services. Deep understanding of asynchronous programming, message queues (e.g., Kafka, SQS, NATS), and event-driven architecture. Experience with NoSQL (DynamoDB) and caching (ElastiCache); ability to evaluate trade-offs between relational (SQL) and non-relational solutions. Strong knowledge of Git for version control and collaboration. Experience in systematic troubleshooting and monitoring ( tools such as Datadog and Amazon CloudWatch) in production environment. Total Rewards We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program. Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements. In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs . title: Account Manager II (German Speaking)
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We're looking for a commercially-minded Account Manager to join our Mid-Market Account Management Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help grow and expand our existing customer base and be part of the Customer Growth & Expansion team as we scale. If you're excited about strategic account management, obsessed with customer outcomes, know how to unlock expansion across complex organisation, you love nurturing relationships, identifying growth levers, proving ROI, and are passionate about spend management, then this is the opportunity for you! Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our Senior Sales Manager, Account Management and work closely with teams in Customer Success, Deal Desk, Pricing and Enablement. Our team of 16 is highly collaborative and dedicated to delivering value and growing our existing customer base. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Sales, Support, Product and Marketing to ensure success. What you’ll be doing As an Account Manager, you will: Identify and close opportunities within your book of business to grow accounts through upsells, new entities, teams, and product capabilities aligned to evolving customer needs. Build deep relationships with key stakeholders to understand their strategic initiatives, and uncover whitespace opportunities. Use MEDDICC (or similar) to rigorously qualify upsell and cross-sell opportunities to ensure forecast accuracy and deal velocity. Showcase new product features, integrations, and advanced workflows that drive stronger adoption and platform value for upsells. Create custom proposals and business cases that quantify value, align with commercial goals, and support customer budgeting cycles. Work across senior finance, procurement, and operations stakeholders to land multi-threaded expansions. Lead commercial conversations ensuring terms reflect the value Pleo delivers. Use customer success stories, usage data, and ROI metrics to proactively pitch new functionality and deepen platform adoption. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: A solid understanding of value-based selling and consultative approach Skilled in contract negotiations and building business cases linking features to value Strong understanding of qualification methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC) A passion for solving problems with a solution-oriented approach Data-driven, goal-oriented, and accurate forecasting ability Strong commercial acumen and ability to navigate senior stakeholders A background in SaaS Account Management or Customer Growth with a proven track record of expansion revenue and high net revenue retention Complete fluency in English Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You are naturally curious and driven to map out complex organisations, identifying white space where Pleo can solve a genuine business need. You get a rush from closing upsells by proving ROI and prefer driving proactive growth over simply waiting for a renewal. You use frameworks like MEDDICC to keep deals on track and can easily show a CFO how tech features translate into financial value. This role is not a good fit for you if: You view Account Management solely as responding to support tickets or handling administrative renewals rather than proactively hunting for expansion opportunities and driving revenue. You require a rigid, unchanging playbook to succeed. We are scaling fast, which means processes evolve and you’ll need to be comfortable building the plane while flying it. You prefer simple, single-point-of-contact relationships. This role requires multi-threading across Finance, IT, and Procurement in mid-market organizations. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 to 12 months at Pleo, you’ll: Lead targeted account whitespace analysis to drive impact in your assigned market segment. Collaborate with Product and Marketing to improve feedback loops that influence our mid-market product roadmap. Grow your skills in complex commercial negotiation and value engineering, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale The location [Delete this for critical/hard to fill role where VISA sponsorship can be an option] Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work . We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations. Show me the benefits! 💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) 🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office 🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis 🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays 🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options 🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice ❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far 👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role Bar Raiser : A final interview with a senior leader Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! Last time we hired for this role, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background! Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: ALD Lab - Working Student
description: Your Role As an ALD Lab Working Student, you will support the daily operation of our Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) tool and the relevant metrology tools in the FabONE cleanroom in Aachen. Working alongside our ALD process engineers, you will prepare samples, perform routine thin-film characterization, and maintain accurate laboratory records. title: Stage Software Development
description: Stage Software Development Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende (afstudeer) stage, waarbij je in aanraking komt met de nieuwste ontwikkelmethodes? Wil je ervaren hoe het is om mee te bouwen aan een platform dat wereldwijd wordt gebruikt door duizenden gebruikers? Dan is een stage bij IXON wellicht iets voor jou! Bij IXON connecten wij machinebouwers met hun klanten en machines. Door machinebouwers wereldwijd toegang te geven tot hun machines en data zorgen wij voor een revolutie in industrial automation. Met onze end-to-end oplossing, bestaande uit een cloudplatform met geïntegreerde remote access, geven wij machinebouwers de tools en technologie in handen om hun businessmodellen te transformeren en daarmee toekomstbestendig te blijven. Dit alles met als doel: Efficiëntere productie met de laagst mogelijke impact op de wereld. Bouw jij mee? Verdeeld over verschillende SCRUM-teams is ons R&D-team verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen en ontwikkelen van het IXON Cloud-platform. Elk aspect van onze oplossing, dan de robuuste backend tot de gebruiksvriendelijke frontend, geavanceerde hardware en onze wereldwijde DevOps-infrastructuur, wordt met passie en expertise binnen onze muren ontwikkeld. Ons R&D-team, dat inmiddels bestaat uit meer dan 30 technische specialisten, staat altijd open voor jonge talenten die willen groeien en zich verder willen ontwikkelen. Tijdens elke stageperiode bieden we meerdere plekken aan voor studenten in de volgende deelgebieden: Backend development; Frontend development; Embedded Software Development; DevOps; Security; Software testing. Hierbij kom je aanraking met onze tech-stack, bestaande uit: Python; C++; Rust; Angular; Typescript; Playwright; Zabbix; Linux; MariaDB; Kubernetes; SALT. Uiteraard staan we altijd open voor inbreng van studenten op het gebied van nieuwe tooling, frameworks en technieken. Welke opdrachten kan je verwachten? Studio for e-mail Door de aanhoudende groei van het aantal IXON Cloud-gebruikers neemt de diversiteit aan specifieke wensen toe. Een veelgehoorde behoefte is het personaliseren van e-mailberichten die vanuit het platform naar de eindgebruikers worden verstuurd. Momenteel zijn de aanpassingsmogelijkheden beperkt tot enkel de kleuren en logo's. Het doel van deze opdracht is om klanten volledige controle te bieden over de vormgeving en inhoud van hun e-mails. Om dit te realiseren, wordt een intuïtieve e-mailstudio ontwikkeld waarmee de gebruiker eenvoudig en naar eigen inzicht berichten kan opstellen en beheren. Support Beckhoff ADS via pull application (Embedded Software Development) Implementeer ondersteuning voor het Beckhoff ADS-protocol in C++ om de compatibiliteit van de IXON data pipeline te vergroten. Je realiseert de volledige koppeling op de gateway en maakt data-logging eenvoudig configureerbaar in de fleet manager. Het versnellen van End-to-End (E2E) testen (Software testing) Optimaliseer de End-to-End testomgeving van de IXON Cloud om de feedbackcyclus en release-snelheid voor ontwikkelaars te verhogen. Je identificeert knelpunten en implementeert versnellingsoplossingen binnen de GitLab CI/CD-pipeline. Hier herken jij jezelf in Je bent een HBO student in de richting van (Embedded) Software Development, Security of aanverwant en bent op zoek naar een (afstudeer)stage met impact. Je hebt een passie voor het ontwikkelen van toffe softwareoplossingen en krijgt graag de vrijheid om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. title: Post-doctorant(e) :  Problèmes publics des centres de données - Chaire SHS TerrAINs  - CDD de 18 mois
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en problèmes publics des centres de données pour rejoindre le département de recherche Sciences Économiques et Sociales (SES) et plus particulièrement la chaire SHS TerraAINs. Contexte scientifique : La Chaire SHS TerrAINs s’intéresse aux enjeux territoriaux du développement des infrastructures numériques et plus particulièrement des centres de données en France. Elle est portée par Pauline Gourlet et financée par la Région Ile de France (2026-2029). Longtemps demeurés une infrastructure invisible, les centres de données ( data centers ) se trouvent désormais au cœur des problématiques des politiques publiques et industrielles et la Région Ile de France concentre aujourd’hui ces infrastructures (plus de 165 en 2024), avec de nombreux projets de data centers hyperscale à l’étude. Vecteurs d’innovation, objets de spéculation, instruments de réaffirmation de puissance nationale, leur développement rapide génère aussi de nombreuses inquiétudes, voire du rejet, en France (comme à l’étranger), et ne fait pas à ce jour l’objet d’une planification concertée, mais relève encore largement d’opportunités isolées. Or, ces projets d’infrastructure se trouvent à la croisée d’enjeux locaux, voire hyper-locaux — de l’aménagement territorial aux effets sur l’environnement — et d’enjeux nationaux et internationaux — de la tension sur les réseaux d’électricité aux questions de souveraineté technologique et d’investissement. Au sein de la Chaire, le ou la post-doctorant(e) étudiera la manière dont les centres de données, objets clés de l’infrastructure numérique, se développent et organisent différents problèmes publics relatifs aux « territoires » à différentes échelles territoriales. Comment en retour, la définition et la hiérarchisation de ces problèmes peuvent permettent des arbitrages concertés pour planifier leur déploiement ? Les modalités de participation à la construction de ces problèmes publics, autant que la fabrique des données nécessaires pour nourrir les positions des acteurs, sont autant un enjeu de démocratie technique qu’une manière de retrouver prise sur l’aménagement des milieux de vie. En articulant sociologie des sciences et des techniques et études urbaines avec une méthodologie innovante de recherche-action , TerrAINs contribue à rendre visibles et discutables les infrastructures numériques, tout en expérimentant des outils de représentation des problèmes et de participation, adaptées aux enjeux infrastructurels contemporains. La Chaire est organisée selon trois axes principaux : Analyse des discours sur les centres de données, et notamment les discours médiatiques régionaux, nationaux et étrangers ; Description des modalités du « faire infrastructure » : pratiques situées, relations aux milieux, frictions. Cet axe investira trois sites franciliens concernés par des projets de centres hyperscale. la chaire est conçue comme un laboratoire de recherche-action qui expérimente de nouvelles modalités de représentation et de participation autour des infrastructures numériques. Vos missions principales seront de : Assurer des missions de recherche dans le cadre de la Chaire Terrains Participer à l’animation de la chaire et contribuer aux projets menés par les autres membres de l’équipe Participer à des actions de valorisation des travaux menés au sein de la chaire Assurer des missions d’encadrement (stagiaires, workshops étudiant) Consulter la description des missions complètes dans la fiche de poste détaillée. Nous recherchons une personne avec un profil SHS – interdisciplinaire ( humanités environnementales, Science and Technology Studies (STS) ou anthropologie expérimentale, géographie sociale, architecture / design…) avec une solide maîtrise théorique et empirique des transformations socio-environnementales, des savoirs situés, des problèmes publics, de l’enquête collective et des relations entre sciences / société. Niveau de diplôme exigé : doctorat ou équivalent Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers). Vous bénéficierez de : 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT) flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service) télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75% Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne... A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé Découvrez notre environnement de travail, nos engagements en image et en vidéo sur notre page dédiée . Dossier de candidature à envoyer avant le 20 novembre : un CV détaillé une lettre (2-3 pages max) qui esquisse les contributions que le ou la candidat·e souhaiterait apporter au sein de la Chaire ainsi que sa motivation à y prendre part; deux publications significatives au regard de cette intention (au-delà des critères académiques classiques) une lettre de recommandation Informations diverses : Date limite de candidature : 22 novembre 2026 Type d'emploi : CDD de 18 mois Description de poste détaillée ici Rémunération : 36 000 euros brut/an En fonction du statut du profil retenu et du nombre d’années après la thèse, un contrat d’ingénieur de recherche pourra être envisagé. Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuel et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: <span class="collapsed-field-text">Austin, TX, New York, NY, San Francisco, CA</span>  </strong></p> <p>About Engineering at Cloudflare</p> <p>Cloudflare’s Engineers build and operate the software that helps power 25+ million Internet properties and millions of businesses around the world. Across our engineering organizations, we have opportunities for high caliber, curious and empathetic people to take on big challenges and build some of the best skills in the industry. We’re looking for talented team members to help build high-growth products, help scale our expanding network, build tools to improve availability, performance, uptime, and response times, and make systems failure-resistant and ready-to-scale.</p> <p>Cloudflare is a system spanning the globe, on a mission to make the Internet better, safer, and more powerful every day. security, network engineering, SRE, and product management, to design scalable solutions to difficult technical problems.</li> <li>Review work from your peers throughout all stages of the development lifecycle to ensure high-quality, maintainable code.</li> <li>Mentor team members and work with support teams to ensure customer delight and bring out the best in everyone.</li> <li>Debug issues in complex systems and contribute to the maintenance and improvement of operational health.</li> <li>Work with a wide range of technologies and programming languages, including Go, Rust, and Typescript, as well as various databases (SQL and No-SQL), Docker, and Kubernetes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Requirements </strong></p> <ul> <li>First and foremost curiosity and critical thinking</li> <li>5+ years of relevant professional experience with a technology company</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Go, Rust, C++, or a similar systems-level language</li> <li>Experience building and operating distributed systems</li> <li>Experience with modern Unix/Linux development and runtime environments</li> <li>Experience with monitoring, alerting and debugging high volume production systems</li> <li>Experience with databases (we use PostgreSQL and Clickhouse)</li> <li>Experience with monitoring and logging tools like Prometheus and Grafana.</li> <li>Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal and communication skills, demonstrating empathy, teamwork and a sense of ownership.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level.</p> <p>San Francisco Estimated Base salary $194,000 - $266,000.</p> <p>New York Estimated Base salary $185,000 - $254,000.</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. title: Data Engineer – Healthcare
description: About PAICON PAICON is a Heidelberg-based health data intelligence company building the global health data foundation through its PaiX ecosystem, working to close the representation gap in medical data so personalised medicine works for everyone. We harmonise ethically approved, GDPR compliant real-world health data from providers around the world into a global dataset. The data covers multiple modalities on various disease entities. Our flagship product, PaiX Navigator, generates actionable insights for pharma, biotech and AI companies worldwide. The role We are looking for a hands-on data engineer to integrate data from our global partners into our platform. Data integration is the core of the role, and agentic AI tooling is part of how we do it. This is an on-site position in our Heidelberg office. You will work closely with medical, engineering and commercialization colleagues in a small, pragmatic team with short decision paths and direct access to the founders. What you'll do Onboard new data partners, from first assessment of their data through to reliable production ingestion Map partner data to our internal data model and work with providers to close gaps Build and maintain robust, well-tested data pipelines Ensure high standards in data quality and help evolve our database and data infrastructure Document data and transformations so that every step is transparent and traceable Ensure data is handled securely, de-identified and in line with healthcare data regulations Help us apply AI-assisted methods to data integration, with appropriate quality checks What you bring Several years of hands-on data engineering, including building and running production data pipelines Strong SQL and relational database design skills R and Python skills on Linux systems Familiarity with healthcare data standards such as HL7 FHIR and common clinical coding systems Understanding of data privacy and security in a regulated environment, including GDPR Day-to-day use of AI-assisted development tools and curiosity to go further with them A pragmatic mindset: you choose the simplest solution that works Ability to turn messy, real-world data into clear findings and next steps Good communication with technical and non-technical colleagues Independent, hands-on working style with agile mindset Fluent English, our primary working language Nice-to-have skills Experience with genomics/clinical & pathology data/digital histopathology data Experience with graph databases or ontologies Experience with containers, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure on hyperscalers. What you get from joining PAICON Hybrid working, with core office days to help organise how you do your best work An inclusive team where different backgrounds and perspectives are part of the point A friendly, motivated and agile environment where things move quickly and you see the impact of your work Flat hierarchies and short decision paths, with direct access to founders and medical, engineering and commercial colleagues Real ownership of your ideas: propose something good and you will be the one building it You will join a team solving a problem that matters, in a company where your voice carries weight from day one. There are no long approval chains between a good idea and a production system, and no layers between you and the people who depend on the data you integrate. If you want to shape how global health data is built rather than inherit someone else’s architecture, this is the place to do it! Cheers! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
