Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Remote, US</strong></p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>Cloudflare’s Americas Marketing Team is searching for Demand & Field Marketing Leader to partner directly with our US Major Accounts segment. Aligning with sales leadership, sales operations, partner marketing and GTM counterparts you will design and drive high-impact pipeline generation programs, events and account focused marketing leading to pipeline creation and closed-won bookings across Global 2000 accounts.</p> <p>In this role, you will lead Majors Demand Marketing utilizing historical performance, data analytics, and intent intelligence to inform quarterly strategies and drive growth. You will hold end-to-end responsibility for developing and coordinating a comprehensive, omnichannel marketing approach for US Major Accounts. Your scope will encompass hosted field events, Account-Based Marketing (ABM), VIP and executive C-level events while providing strategic inputs for full-funnel digital programs (paid search/social, webinars, web strategy).</p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Planning & Execution:</strong> Develop and execute multi-channel marketing plans that align directly with US Major Accounts sales and pipeline targets, holding ownership of budget management, execution, and reporting.</li> <li><strong>Sales & BDR Partnership:</strong> Partner closely with enterprise sales leaders, account executives, and Business Development Rep (BDR) leadership to establish shared SLAs, conduct joint pipeline reviews, and enable sellers with high-converting account engagement programs.</li> <li><strong>Full-Funnel Digital Demand Generation:</strong> Direct enterprise-focused digital marketing strategy working with our Digital Marketing team—ie. LinkedIn advertising, programmatic display, executive webinar series—to capture, engage, and nurture high-intent enterprise accounts.</li> <li><strong>ABM:</strong> 1:1 ABM strategies opportunistically for our strategic accounts segment within Majors.</li> <li><strong>VIP Field Events & Executive Experiences:</strong> lead the strategy, budget, vendor management, and execution for high-touch field programs, including C-suite dinners, regional roundtables.</li> <li><strong>Partner & Ecosystem Marketing:</strong> Coordinate with the Partner Marketing team to align efforts as required for co-marketing initiatives, and alignment for strategic partner marketing plans.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <h2><strong>Qualifications & Requirements</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Minimum 10 years in enterprise B2B field marketing, demand generation, or account-based marketing in a $1B+ technology organization (cybersecurity, cloud, or networking preferred); minimum 5 years field marketing experience.</li> <li>Location Requirement: Remote - $165,000.</li> <li>For New York City, Washington, Washington D.C. and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $132,000 - $182,000.</li> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $138,000 - $190,000</li> <li>Application Deadline: ~January 2027</li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Senior Software Engineer - Digital Workplace
description: <h3> </h3> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <h3>The role</h3> <p>We build internal systems to the same standard as our public products: specified, tested, reviewed and observable. We want engineers who enjoy that rigour and take full ownership of what they ship.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design and deliver systems and platforms, including intuitive UIs</li> <li>Build Go services and APIs that connect many data sources</li> <li>Design data models and architecture for connected systems</li> <li>Turn data into clear dashboards and visualisations</li> <li>Build LLM-powered features into everyday workflows</li> <li>Write specs, estimate work and deliver to agreed criteria</li> <li>Set a high bar in code review, testing and documentation</li> <li>Partner with non-technical colleagues to turn needs into tools</li> <li>Mentor engineers and improve how the team works</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Who you are</strong></h3> <p>You have deep expertise in at least two of:</p> <ul> <li>Back-end services in Go</li> <li>Modern front-end engineering [React/Svelte/TypeScript]</li> <li>Data engineering and analytics</li> <li>Data visualisation</li> <li>Applied LLM/ML in production workflows</li> </ul> <p>You also:</p> <ul> <li>Treat testing, security, performance and accessibility as part of the job</li> <li>Handle sensitive people data with care</li> <li>Write clearly and work well in a distributed team</li> <li>Own your work from first spec to production</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong>: Python, Go, React, Svelte, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, a history of building tools for HR, finance or operations.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The ideal candidate will use their passion for experimentation and analytics to build tomorrow’s tech organisation. This team will help us gain insights into the business and our talent pool, and use those insights to improve the experience of working at Canonical.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As a Workplace Engineer at Canonical, you need an analytical, data-driven mind and a passion to connect and make sense of interesting data from APIs. We focus heavily on the collection of metrics, optimising processes, and ways of working across Canonical.  You need to demonstrate leadership, excellence, and consistency and will mentor others in the team.</span></p> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Annual compensation review</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Recognition rewards</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Annual holiday leave</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Maternity and paternity leave</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</span></p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.</span><a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</span></a></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-remote</span></p> <p> </p>

Proactively identify and build on your strengths and improvement areas, turn failures into positive learning lessons (for you and for others)</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p> <p><strong>Why join the In-Store adventure?</strong></p> <p>Here are a few challenges you may tackle if you join the In-Store adventure</p> <ul> <li>Enhance the human bound - Simplifying complexity and leveraging store teams and management, building more and more quality time spaces between our customer and our teammate</li> <li>Improve Store efficiency - Empower our teammates on the field, understand their pain-points and provide strong, efficient and scalable solutions</li> <li>Reinforce the end-to-end, omni experience - description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Zone & Company Software Consulting LLC (“Zone”) is the ERP-native AI platform for financial operations, purpose-built for organizations running on Oracle NetSuite. an advanced degree is a plus.</li> <li>10+ years of experience in product management, with deep expertise in Accounts Payable (AP) automation and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) solutions.</li> <li>Strong understanding of end-to-end AP workflows, including the day-to-day needs of AP teams and the strategic priorities of CFOs.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building AI-powered products and successfully bringing them to market.</li> <li>Strong ownership and initiative, with the ability to drive outcomes end to end, act proactively, and identify and address challenges early.</li> <li>Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, adapt quickly, and adjust priorities based on customer feedback, data, and market insights.</li> <li>Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to balance customer needs, business objectives, and market opportunities.</li> <li>Proven experience leading and developing product teams, with excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with peers and executive leadership.</li> </ul> <p>The base salary range for this position is £100,000 – £108,000 GBP + bonus + equity. title: Senior AI Engineer, Agents & Applications
description: <h3 class="p1"><strong>Firmus Technologies</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.</p> <p class="p1">Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. </p> <p class="p1">At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Firmus AI Cloud</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.</p> <p class="p1">It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Why Firmus?</strong></h3> <p class="p1">As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.</p> <p class="p1">We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap. </p> <p class="p1">Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.</p> <p class="p1">What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.</p> <p class="p1">Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Role Summary</strong></h3> <p>The Senior AI Engineer (Agents & Applications) will design, build, and operate production-grade agentic systems that coordinate, optimize, and automate decision-making across the  design-build-operate lifecycle of AI factories. The role is a core contributor to the AI & Applications team’s Model-to-Grid product, connecting models, inference endpoints, benchmark intelligence, validated workload recipes, job-scheduler decisions, infrastructure telemetry, AI-factory operations, and grid-related constraints into safe, explainable, and measurable workflows.</p> <p>The role will build more than conversational co-pilots. It will create agentic applications that ingest and reason over time-series telemetry, logs, traces, events, scheduler state, benchmark results, configuration data, operational documentation, incident records, and multimodal sources where appropriate. These applications will help engineers, operators, and customers move from observation to diagnosis, recommendation, planning, simulation, controlled execution, verification, and continuous improvement.</p> <p>The engineer will define and implement the underlying agent architecture and engineering framework: orchestration, state and memory management, retrieval, tool use, specialized sub-agents, evaluation, safety controls, human approvals, observability, and deployment. The role will use fit-for-purpose self-hosted and external model endpoints, with close integration to the team’s inference platform.</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li class="p1">Design, build, and operate agentic applications supporting AI-factory planning, commissioning, validation, workload onboarding, benchmark analysis, model and recipe optimisation, scheduling, operations, maintenance, incident response, and continuous improvement.</li> <li class="p1">Define reference architectures for single-agent, multi-agent, workflow-based, eventdriven, and human-in-the-loop agentic systems.</li> <li class="p1">Build orchestration workflows using appropriate agent frameworks and libraries, such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Microsoft AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, PydanticAI, Haystack, DSPy, or equivalent custom-built frameworks.</li> <li class="p1">Select the appropriate architecture for each use case rather than applying multi-agent <br>patterns by default: <ul> <li class="p1">Deterministic workflow and state-machine architectures for repeatable, high-confidence operational processes.</li> <li class="p1">Planner-executor architectures for decomposing complex investigation, planning, and remediation tasks.</li> <li class="p1">Supervisor-worker or manager-worker architectures for coordinating specialist domain agents.</li> <li class="p1">Router architectures for selecting the right model, tool, knowledge source, workflow, or specialist agent.</li> <li class="p1">Reflection, critic, verifier, or judge patterns for quality assurance, validation, and safety checks.</li> <li class="p1">Event-driven architectures for responding to telemetry anomalies, workload failures, scheduler events, benchmark regressions, and operational alerts.</li> <li class="p1">Human-in-the-loop architectures for high-impact recommendations, privileged actions, or changes to production environments.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Build specialist agents for relevant Model-to-Grid and AI-factory domains, such as: <ul> <li>Benchmark-analysis and performance-diagnosis agents.</li> <li>Workload recipe and runtime-configuration recommendation agents.</li> <li>Inference-endpoint selection, capacity, and optimization agents.</li> <li>Kubernetes and job-scheduler diagnostic agents.</li> <li>GPU-topology, network, RDMA, storage, and utilization-analysis agents.</li> <li>AI-factory health, capacity, maintenance, and operational-triage agents.</li> <li>Documentation, knowledge, incident-review, and runbook-execution assistants.</li> <li>Thermal domain specific monitoring and optimization agents.</li> <li>Power domain specific monitoring and optimization agents.</li> <li>Grid-integration specific monitoring and optimization agents.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Develop the intelligent coordination layer for Model-to-Grid, enabling agents to reason across model characteristics, inference and training configuration, validated recipes, GPU resources, topology, scheduling policies, network and storage performance, capacity, power, thermal conditions, health signals, and operational constraints.</li> <li>Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using a combination of vector retrieval, hybrid search, metadata filtering, reranking, structured-data queries, graphbased retrieval where valuable, source attribution, and permission-aware access controls.</li> <li>Use tools such as pgvector, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Milvus, Weaviate, Pinecone, Qdrant, Neo4j, or equivalent data and retrieval platforms as appropriate to the product architecture and deployment environment.</li> <li>Design knowledge-ingestion pipelines for documentation, runbooks, ticketing systems, configuration repositories, benchmark reports, experiment records, cluster state, telemetry catalogues, incident reports, and approved internal knowledge sources.</li> <li>Build data and context pipelines that combine unstructured knowledge with structured operational data, including metrics, logs, traces, events, time-series databases, scheduler queues, job states, resource inventories, and configuration-management data.</li> <li>Integrate agents with governed tools and APIs, including Kubernetes, proprietary scheduler services, observability platforms, benchmark services, inference endpoints, configuration repositories, CI/CD pipelines, ticketing systems, workflow engines, <br>databases, and operational tooling.</li> <li>Define tool contracts using structured input and output schemas, typed interfaces, validation, retries, idempotency controls, rate limits, timeouts, circuit breakers, approval requirements, and detailed audit logging.</li> <li>Build robust agent harnesses that provide context assembly, model routing, prompt and policy versioning, structured output handling, memory management, state persistence, retries, failure handling, task recovery, escalation, and end-to-end tracing.</li> <li>Implement short-term task memory, long-term user or operational memory where permitted, episodic memory for prior investigations or incidents, and semantic memory based on approved knowledge stores; apply retention, access-control, and datagovernance requirements to each.</li> <li>Implement model-routing and fallback strategies across self-hosted inference endpoints and approved external models, selecting models according to task complexity, latency, cost, context-window requirement, tool-use capability, privacy needs, and reliability targets.</li> <li>Partner with the Self-Hosted Inference Platform & Optimization team to ensure that agentic applications have suitable endpoint profiles for planning, reasoning, embeddings, reranking, summarization, classification, tool use, multimodal analysis, and high-throughput operational workflows.</li> <li>Build agent workflows for detection, diagnosis, recommendation, planning, action simulation, controlled execution, verification, and learning loops.</li> <li>Develop offline replay, simulation, shadow-mode, and what-if evaluation capabilities to validate recommendations before allowing actions in production—especially for scheduler policies, workload placement, runtime changes, capacity decisions, and operational remediation.</li> <li>Design human approval and policy enforcement workflows that clearly present an agent’s evidence, recommendation, expected impact, proposed action, confidence, risk classification, authorization scope, and rollback option.</li> <li>Work with the Security Engineer to implement defense-in-depth controls against direct and indirect prompt injection, insecure output handling, excessive agency, unsafe tool use, data leakage, cross-tenant exposure, privilege escalation, credential misuse, unauthorized actions, and insufficient auditability.</li> <li>Use policy engines, guardrail frameworks, structured output validation, content and tool filters, permission checks, sandboxing, and allowlisted action patterns to ensure that agent behavior remains bounded and title: Principal Engineer - Core Cloud Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About AlphaSense: </strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit <span><a href="http://www.alpha-sense.com" target="_blank">www.alpha-sense.com</a></span>. Come join us.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the Role: </strong></p> <p>The Core Cloud Platform team is responsible for AlphaSense's entire cloud infrastructure, including AWS account management, networking, data storages, and Kubernetes clusters. We build the underlying platform that supports hundreds of services and is used by over 400 globally distributed engineers.</p> <p>We're scaling into a cell-based architecture, and the number of cells we run is growing fast, taking our Kubernetes footprint from dozens of clusters toward hundreds. That takes the platform in three directions at once: infrastructure configuration becomes a first-class layer with its own lifecycle, independent of application code; provisioning a new cell becomes a days-long automated operation rather than a multi-week effort; and cross-cell control points become standard, reusable, and consistent everywhere.</p> <p>This is a Principal Engineer role with real breadth within the cloud platform. You'll set the architectural roadmap for our cloud, Kubernetes, and storage platform as it scales with AlphaSense's growth, and take dedicated ownership of the cloud-side configuration and Helm chart layer that every service depends on. Data storages are a critical part of this surface, and we're looking for genuine depth there.</p> <p>It requires a deep cloud of both operational and software development skills, the ability to lead ambitious technical programmes, and the credibility to set direction with Engineering leaders and very senior engineers across dozens of teams.</p> <p>We're looking for someone who genuinely embraces AI tooling in their day-to-day work, appreciates the productivity value it brings, and is motivated to make our infrastructure ever-more AI friendly.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></p> <ul> <li>Own the architectural roadmap for our cloud, Kubernetes, and storage platform</li> <li>Own cloud-side configuration and the Helm chart layer for Cloud Core</li> <li>Build the cell registry and automate provisioning to take new cell setup from weeks to days</li> <li>Design the cross-cell gate mechanism as the reusable standard checkpoint across every cell</li> <li>Own, operate and evolve our Cloud and Kubernetes platform, including our data storage layers</li> <li>Make operations (upgrades, patching, lifecycle management) routine across hundreds of clusters</li> <li>Continuously improve the security, reliability, cost efficiency and performance of our infrastructure</li> <li>Champion standards and drive initiatives to promote uniformisation and eliminate duplication</li> <li>Enable truly self-service and agentic workflow patterns that support a Build it - Own it model</li> <li>Build tooling and AI powered integrations that reduce the cognitive load in cloud </li> <li>Architect, design and implement simple and maintainable solutions</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Extremely experienced in Kubernetes and its various components, containerisation and AWS cloud</li> <li>Proven track record of running Kubernetes and Cloud based production SaaS systems at scale</li> <li>Experience operating Kubernetes as a large fleet with hundreds of clusters</li> <li>Strong knowledge of data storages across SQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch</li> <li>Strong operational and troubleshooting skill with Kubernetes, databases and messaging systems</li> <li>Deep understanding of networking and production level usage of service meshes and gateways</li> <li>Experience separating infrastructure configuration from application code at scale</li> <li>Experience with cell-based, multi-tenant or multi-region architectures </li> <li>Proficiency in Python and Golang</li> <li>Evangelist of highly performant CI/CD practices that are supportive of agentic workflows</li> <li>Ability and desire to design, lead, influence and deliver on ambitious technical roadmaps</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with Vespa</li> <li>Automated provisioning of new environments, regions or cells end-to-end</li> <li>Management of large fleets of Kubernetes clusters with lifecycle management tools </li> <li>Production usage of Hashicorp Vault or similar secret management systems</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. title: People ops - M&A and International Expansion
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. The M&A and International Expansion role Alan is diversifying its activities in the fields of healthcare, prevention and insurance through mergers and acquisitions, and is actively expanding internationally. In addition, Alan recruits talent worldwide and enables its employees to work remotely in complete safety. “Alaner, everywhere”. The role makes sure each acquisition and each country opening is legally secure, fast and humane: from HR due diligence, to transferring employment contracts, to fully integrating the people who join us. You'll join the Expansion crew inside the People team. You'll work closely with the crew owner, and with Corporate, Finance, team Leads and General Managers involved in each deal. The People team The People team is made up of 13 people who work in an environment shaped by Alan's Leadership Principles. Every one of them is a genuine fan of our products (Culture being one of them) and deeply committed to Alan's Prevention and Health mission. The team covers Learning and Development, Payroll and Admin, Employee Experience and Operational Efficiency, Compliance and Employment Law, Comp and Ben, and now M&A and International Expansion. It is a generalist team: everyone shares three core missions, namely People on-call (answering the day to day questions from Alaners, which is now AI-powered), individual situation management, and HRBP responsibilities. This represents roughly 50% of our time. Then each person owns one or more cross-functional topics depending on their flavour. In your case: M&A and expansion. Your missions On top of the core missions shared across the People team, you will work on a very diverse range of high-impact topics: You will own to the People workstream of M&A transactions from due diligence to integration, alongside the crew and in close collaboration with the Corporate team, Legal, Finance and the business owners of each deal. Depending on the nature of the deal, you will own: HR due diligence: reviewing headcount, employment contracts, collective agreements, compensation & benefits, liabilities and risks of target companies, and flagging red flags clearly to the deal team; Transferring employment contracts in France and abroad, and choosing the right path for each deal and country; Integrating acquired teams: day-1 and first-months plans, harmonising contracts and benefits, communicating with acquired employees, onboarding them into Alan's way of working; You will support the people transition of acquired teams, working with the crew and leads on team set-up, keeping key talents, and supporting every individual situation with care; Working with external advisors (law firms, HR advisory, relocation and EoR providers): writing clear briefs and challenging their advice. Also: Opening new countries on the People side : entity vs employer of record, compliant local contracts, benefits and payroll partners You will handle international relocations and cross-border situations for Alaners moving or working between countries (visas, social security, tax, type of contract); Building reusable playbooks (HR due diligence checklist, integration playbook, "country opening – People" checklist) so each new deal is faster than the last Taking on global and cross-border individual situations (mobility, work from anywhere, sensitive cases) Raising the team's expertise : sharing your knowledge of employment law and M&A practices with the crew and the wider People team Leveraging AI and automation to multiply the impact of your work Outcomes within your first months in the team By 2.5 months: You are autonomous on day-to-day People on-call requests; You have mapped our current M&A and country-opening practices and shared a first list of gaps and quick wins; You have contributed to the People workstream of at least one live deal or country opening (due diligence, contract transfer or integration); You have contributed to our reusable playbook (e.g. HR due diligence checklist); You have shadowed and been reverse-shadowed on individual situation management. By 5 months: Depending on the ongoing projects, you own the People workstream of a deal end to end, from due diligence to integration, with the crew as a sounding board; You have run, or co-run, one talent density assessment and the parting ways cases that came with it; You handle cross-border individual situations without supervision; Your playbooks are used by the crew and by Legal / Finance on new deals; Leads and crew members come to you as the go-to expert on these topics. Is this what you are looking for? You may be a great fit for this role if: You have around 5 years of experience focused on HR M&A and integration topics, for example in a reputable HR advisory firm or in an HR team that focuses on these topics. You have worked on acquisitions in the Tech industry, not only on very large corporate groups, and you know the method is not the same. You master HR due diligence and the transfer of employment contracts. You have worked on post-merger integration, including talent density and parting ways, not only on the pre-signing side. You have international exposure: you have worked on deals or entities outside France. You are fluent in English, written and spoken (all of our internal processes, documentation and communications are in English). You are adaptable and creative: you adjust your method to each type of company and deal instead of copy-pasting one process. You are very organised: you run several confidential workstreams in parallel without dropping balls. You are a strong communicator, with very different audiences (founders, acquired employees, leads, lawyers), in writing and orally. You are strong technically and can teach us things. You show judgement and discretion with confidential information and sensitive human situations. Nice-to-have We are not looking for all of the below. Any one of these can be a strong signal. You have a legal background, ideally in employment law. You have worked in or with a Tech scale-up that made several acquisitions. You have opened entities or set-up employers of record in new countries. You speak another language relevant to our expansion (e.g. Spanish, Portuguese; Arabic). You are AI-enthusiastic and actively use tools to multiply your impact. Level range For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

You dig deep into client needs, define the best onboarding strategy, and lead change inside the customer's organisation. You bridge platform capabilities and client expectations, delivering a 7-star experience from first contact through long-term success. You are the in-depth expert on the Perk Travel platform and its configuration options, and you understand integrations and open APIs well enough to guide clients and their IT teams through marketplace partner and custom-built setups. You can troubleshoot issues, translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences, and recommend the most effective mix of automations, integrations and platform features for each client. You also learn new tools and concepts quickly as the product evolves. You are also a mentor for the Implementation team and the wider Revenue organisation, trusted as a source of expertise both internally and externally. Responsibilities Be the first impression of Perk and the first point of contact for clients and escalations throughout implementation, always delivering 7-star service. Hold consultative conversations to gather client requirements, and answer them with experience and data-driven best-practice recommendations. Own the timeline, rollout plan and account while it is in implementation, preparing and executing onboarding plans with strong project management and directing work across the internal team. Act as the subject matter expert in change management and adoption, leading customers through introducing a new travel tool and policies, and providing guides, templates and recommendations to support long-term success. Act as a technical solutions expert: identify the best solutions for each client's needs, prioritising automations, integrations and the full range of platform functionality. Configure client accounts to their specifications and provide technical support and troubleshooting, including setting up integrations with marketplace partners or custom-built API solutions. Plan and deliver tailored training sessions for newly onboarded customers, including executive-level stakeholders and company-wide training. Lead cross-functional projects, keeping all internal stakeholders aligned on the goal of full customer ramp-up. Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, Product, Engineering and Finance. Prioritise accounts based on client and business needs. Simplify complex technical information for all audiences. Support Pre-Sales by explaining what an implementation will look like and how the platform can meet prospects' needs. Validate configuration and account satisfaction by monitoring client booking behaviour after launch, and proactively offering support or recommendations. Review completed implementations to improve your own process and the team's, following a cycle of execute, assess, improve, repeat. Mentor colleagues and set an example for the Implementation team and the wider Revenue organisation. What we look for A customer-first mindset, focused on a smooth onboarding and on what clients need to be happy in the long term. A proven track record as a high achiever in an Implementation Specialist role, with previous experience working with Enterprise clients. Success managing and delivering complex, international projects in a fast-paced environment, including defining scope and handling changing requirements while keeping the project on course. Demonstrated ability to work with C-level stakeholders to clarify their requirements and concerns clearly and professionally. Superb communication skills, and the ability to build relationships at all levels internally and externally, adapting your approach as needed. A thoughtful, consultative approach to making recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders. Organised, structured and analytical, with strong problem-solving skills, creativity in solutions and keen attention to detail. Tech-savvy, with an understanding of basic technical concepts around integrations and open APIs, and the ability to learn and adapt quickly. A solution-oriented, proactive mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement, spotting opportunities to improve things for clients and the team. Excitement for challenges and a personal drive to make a difference. AI at Perk AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes. How We Work At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work. For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume. Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you. Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. title: Account Executive Nordics
description: Who is Litmus Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI. AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap. We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production. Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing. Why join Litmus Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments. Work on problems where software meets the real world Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable. Have real impact, fast You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale. Join a high-performance team We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers. Our culture At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other. We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here. About the role Litmus is hiring an Account Executive to own and grow new business with industrial manufacturers across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Iceland and Finland. Litmus is an industrial DataOps and edge AI platform. We help manufacturers connect, normalize and use data from their plants, from shop-floor assets up to the cloud. Our customers use Litmus to break down OT data silos and scale analytics and AI across sites. You will be the face of Litmus in the Nordics. You will build pipeline, run complex enterprise sales cycles end to end, and work closely with our pre-sales team, hyperscaler partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Databricks) and system integrators. You report to the EMEA sales lead. What you will do • Own a Nordic territory and its revenue target, from prospecting to signed contract and expansion. • Build and qualify pipeline through outbound, events, partners and inbound leads. • Run discovery with plant, operations, OT and IT stakeholders up to C-level, and map their business case for change. • Lead structured, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles, including proofs of value, commercial proposals and negotiation. • Work hand in hand with pre-sales on demos, solution design and technical validation. • Co-sell with hyperscalers and system integrators, and develop partner-sourced opportunities in your region. • Keep forecasts and opportunity data accurate in Salesforce. • Expand existing accounts from first site to multi-site and global rollouts. • Bring market feedback back to product, marketing and leadership. What you bring Segment experience (required) • 5+ years of B2B enterprise software sales, with a proven record of meeting or beating quota. • Direct sales experience in industrial software: IIoT, industrial DataOps, data historians, MES, SCADA, edge computing or manufacturing analytics. • A solid grasp of the OT/IT landscape in manufacturing, and of how plant data flows from machines to the cloud. • Experience selling into manufacturing, process industries, energy or similar industrial sectors. Nordic market knowledge (required) • An established network among industrial manufacturers in the Nordics. • A working understanding of Nordic buying culture, decision-making and procurement. • Familiarity with the regional partner and system integrator landscape. • Fluency in English and at least one Nordic language (Swedish, Norwegian, Danish or Finnish). How you work • Comfortable running long, complex deals with many stakeholders. • Disciplined in qualification and forecasting (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC or similar). • Self-driven and at ease building a territory in a growing team. Nice to have • Experience selling alongside Microsoft, AWS, Google or Databricks. • Track record of displacing incumbent industrial software, such as historians or legacy integration tools. • Experience in an early-stage or scale-up team in a new region. Travel and location • Up to 40% travel within the Nordics and to EMEA team and partner events. • Based in the Nordics, ideally near Stockholm, Oslo, Copenhagen or Helsinki. title: Solutions Architect
description: About Plane Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together. Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship. Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules. Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work. Humans and agents We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's. Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives. This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that. About the role Our largest customers do not buy Plane off the shelf. A bank wants it behind their firewall with SSO tied to their identity provider; a defense contractor wants it air-gapped with a migration plan from three legacy tools at once. You will own the technical architecture for these deployments before the contract is signed and after, translating what a customer's infrastructure and compliance team requires into a Plane deployment that actually holds up. You will work directly with sales on the largest deals we run and with engineering when a customer's requirements push past what we support today. This role exists because our regulated-industry customers ask questions our sales team cannot answer alone, and our engineers should not have to answer on every call. What you'll do Own the technical architecture for enterprise and regulated-industry deployments, from the first discovery call through a signed statement of work. Design self-hosted and air-gapped Plane deployments that satisfy a specific customer's security review, not a generic best-practice checklist. Run technical discovery with customers whose infrastructure and compliance teams will pick apart every answer you give, and be right often enough that they trust the next one. Define the migration path when a customer moves off two or three existing tools at once, including what data does not survive the move and saying so up front. Work daily with sales on live deals and with engineering when a customer's requirements expose a real gap in the product, carrying that gap back as a specific, scoped request rather than a vague one. Answer the same security questionnaire in a slightly different format for the fourth time this month, because every regulated buyer's procurement process is its own small bureaucracy and none of them read each other's paperwork. What you'll bring You have designed and defended a technical architecture to a skeptical buyer , and you can walk us through one deal where the customer's own security or infrastructure team changed your design. You understand self-hosted and on-premises deployment beyond a docker-compose file , including networking, SSO and identity federation, and what changes when a customer runs the software instead of you. You can read a security questionnaire or compliance requirement and translate it into an actual deployment decision , not a reassurance. You are comfortable being the technical voice on a sales call , including the parts where the answer is no or not yet. You write technical documentation a customer's own engineers will actually follow , because you will not be in the room when they run it. Nice to haves You have worked pre-sales or post-sales in a solutions architecture, sales engineering, or technical account management role selling to regulated industries. You have contributed to Plane, run it self-hosted, or maintained another open project people rely on. You have shipped or supported deployments into banking, defense, healthcare, or air-gapped environments specifically. You have opinions about how AI agents should be permissioned and audited in an enterprise environment, and can defend them. Tech Backend : Python/Django, Golang, Node.js, Postgres, Redis Messaging : RabbitMQ, Kafka Infrastructure : AWS, Kubernetes, Rancher, self-hosted deployment via Docker and Helm Identity : SAML, OIDC, SCIM Everyday tools : GitHub, Plane (yes, we run on it), Figma, Slack Why Plane? Every company says it is different. We will try evidence instead. The scope is real. We are a passion team serving companies of every size, including some of the largest in the world. Something you ship this month will run inside a Fortune 500 company and a 50-person startup in the same week, and you will hear from both. The constraints make you better. Plane runs in our cloud, in customers' clouds, and on machines that will never touch the internet. Much of the work happens in the open, where the issues, the fixes, and the roadmap conversations are public. Building software that survives all of that is harder than building an ordinary SaaS product, and it is a better education than most companies can offer. The people-and-agents future is being built here, in production. We think humans and AI agents will share one system of action for work. We are building that system now, for customers who already depend on it, and you will work on that problem directly whatever your role. Your name is on the work. The teams are deeply connected enough that credit and responsibility both find you fast. That is some pressure. Mostly it is the fun part. If that sounds like your kind of place, we would like to meet you. Plane is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. description: Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. About Enpal's Innovation Subsidiary At Enpal's Innovation Subsidiary Omniwatt, we're building the future of smart energy for European households. Our vision is a Europe where every household manages its energy intelligently and everyone benefits. Our mission is to bring innovative energy products directly to consumers, including smart meters, electricity tariffs, and Virtual Power Plant (VPP) solutions. As part of our Commercial Team, we're building our B2C growth engine from the ground up. We're launching new customer acquisition channels, experimenting with new products, and continuously working towards product-market fit. We are looking for a Product Engineer who works at the intersection of product, engineering, and growth. In this role, you will develop and launch digital products, build and test MVPs, and implement technical solutions that improve customer acquisition. What you’ll do 1. Build & Launch Digital Products Build customer-facing applications, landing pages and conversion funnels to support B2C growth. Rapidly develop, launch, and iterate on MVPs to test hypotheses and validate new product ideas. Design and run data-driven experiments to measure performance and continuously improve customer acquisition. 2. Drive Product & Growth Work closely with C-Level Members and the Commercial Team to identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and increase conversion rates. Translate commercial needs into product requirements and prioritize initiatives based on business impact. Leverage AI-powered tools and develop custom solutions to automate workflows and improve commercial performance. 3. Work close with both, the Engineering & Commercial Team Collaborate with central engineering teams on API integrations, customer handovers, and data consistency across systems. Take end-to-end ownership of technical initiatives, proactively managing dependencies and balancing speed with quality and scalability. Act as the technical interface between Commercial and Engineering, aligning business requirements with technical implementation. What you’ll bring Educational background: An excellent academic track record, ideally with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related quantitative field. Relevant experience: Initial professional experience in software engineering, product development, technical product management, or as a startup founder, ideally in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment. Hands-on engineering skills: Strong proficiency in modern web technologies such as JavaScript , React/Next.js, and HTML/CSS. Experience with tools such as Vercel, Supabase, and PostHog or comparable alternatives. Will to win: A strong drive to achieve ambitious goals, take ownership, and consistently deliver results, even with limited resources. You set high standards, move fast, and proactively overcome challenges. Builder mindset: A proven track record of independently developing and shipping products, tools, or automations that have created measurable business impact. Analytical approach: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-informed decisions and measure the impact of your work. Languages: Full professional proficiency in German and English. End-to-end ownership: Own the full product lifecycle, from identifying an opportunity to shipping a solution and measuring its commercial impact. title: Legal Engineer, Tax & Audit
description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. What you’ll be doing Let’s get the tricky part out of the way: this role doesn’t fit neatly into a traditional box. It combines tax or audit expertise, product knowledge, client relationships and practical implementation. As a Legal Engineer in our Paris team, you’ll help tax and audit professionals put AI to work in their day-to-day practice. You’ll work with clients from the first demonstration through pilots, onboarding and wider adoption, understanding what they need and building workflows that hold up in real engagements. Some of what you’ll be doing: Understand the work. Work with tax partners, audit leaders and their teams to identify where Legora can make a meaningful difference, from tax research and advisory to evidence review and audit documentation. Build and test workflows. Translate client needs into working use cases, check outputs against source material and professional standards, and refine the approach with the people using it. Run demonstrations and training. Lead clear, practical sessions grounded in the client’s own work, adapting your approach for practitioners, partners and innovation teams. Own pilots and rollouts. Agree what success looks like, keep stakeholders and timelines aligned, and help teams move from initial experimentation to regular use. Support commercial conversations. Work alongside Go-to-Market and Customer Success colleagues to demonstrate value, address objections and identify opportunities to expand adoption across teams and service lines. Help improve the product. Bring client needs and product gaps back to Product and Engineering with clear examples and enough evidence to act on. Make good work reusable. Turn successful engagements into templates, guides and playbooks that colleagues and clients can use again. What you bring You come from tax, audit, assurance or a closely related advisory practice. You may have trained at a Big Four firm, worked at another professional services firm, or built your experience in an in-house function. Perhaps you’ve already moved into innovation, technology implementation or consulting. You understand the pressure of client deadlines, the importance of defensible conclusions and how much work sits behind a finished report or piece of advice. You also have ideas about how that work could be done better. You’ll thrive in this role if you: Have practical experience in tax or audit and can discuss the work credibly with experienced practitioners. You don’t need to be a specialist in both. Are genuinely curious about generative AI and enjoy learning new tools. You don’t need to be a software engineer or have held a Legal Engineering role before. Communicate clearly, whether you’re explaining a technical concept, leading a workshop or handling a difficult question from a partner. Can organize a engagement, keep commitments, and flag problems early Understand the commercial realities of professional services, including engagement economics, client expectations and the balance between speed and quality. Take initiative, respond well to feedback and learn quickly when faced with an unfamiliar problem. Communicate fluently in French and English. Are based in Paris, or willing to relocate, and able to work from the office five days per week. A few more things You’ll join a growing Tax & Audit team with room to shape how we work. There is real autonomy and responsibility, alongside colleagues who will challenge your thinking and help you develop. We’re hiring across seniority levels. Whether you’re earlier in your career or bring substantial experience, we’d like to hear from you. Your title and scope will reflect your experience and what you demonstrate during the hiring process. If you know tax or audit and want to help build how technology is used in the profession, we’d like to meet you. title: Chief Engineer Operations H/F
description: 📍 Paris / Île-de-France | Environnement Data Center | CDI | Périmètre multisite Rejoignez mon client au cœur des infrastructures critiques. Dans un contexte de forte croissance et de développement de ses infrastructures, mon client renforce son organisation Operations en France et crée un poste de Chief Engineer . Au sein d'un nouvel pôle d'expertise technique transverse , vous devenez le référent technique des opérations sur plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, avec un périmètre prioritaire couvrant notamment deux sites. Votre mission : apporter votre expertise, sécuriser les opérations et contribuer à faire progresser l'ensemble de l'organisation vers davantage de standardisation, de rigueur opérationnelle et d'excellence technique . Ce poste s'adresse à un profil expérimenté qui souhaite aller au-delà de l'expertise technique pure et jouer un rôle central dans la structuration des opérations d'un acteur Data Center en pleine croissance . Vos missions Votre rôle Le Chief Engineer intervient comme référent technique et opérationnel multisite . Vous êtes à la fois : un expert technique capable de challenger les équipes et les prestataires ; un référent opérationnel garant de la sécurisation des opérations ; un acteur transverse capable de fédérer des équipes aux profils et niveaux d'expérience différents. Vous disposez d'une véritable autorité technique : lorsque les conditions de sécurité ou de maîtrise des risques ne sont pas réunies, vous êtes capable de challenger une opération et, si nécessaire, de prononcer un NO GO sur un mode opératoire ou une intervention. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de site, qui conservent la responsabilité opérationnelle de leur périmètre. Vos principales missions 1 - Être le référent technique des infrastructures critiques Vous apportez votre expertise sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et êtes capable d'en comprendre les interactions et les impacts opérationnels. Votre périmètre couvre notamment : les infrastructures électriques HT/BT ; les systèmes de secours électrique ; les UPS / onduleurs ; les groupes électrogènes ; les infrastructures CVC / HVAC ; les systèmes de refroidissement ; la protection et la sécurité incendie ; les systèmes de contrôle-commande et infrastructures associées. Vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des responsables de site et des équipes Operations , et êtes capable de challenger les différents interlocuteurs internes ou externes sur leurs choix et leurs pratiques. 2 - Sécuriser les opérations L'une de vos responsabilités majeures sera de garantir que les opérations réalisées sur les infrastructures critiques sont préparées et exécutées dans les meilleures conditions de sécurité et de maîtrise des risques. À ce titre, vous : challengez les modes opératoires (MOP) ; vérifiez la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des procédures ; identifiez les risques et leurs impacts potentiels ; sécurisez les opérations avant leur réalisation ; challengez les premières analyses et propositions d'intervention ; pouvez émettre un NO GO lorsqu'une opération ne présente pas les garanties nécessaires ; accompagnez les responsables de site dans la prise de décision technique ; contribuez à la mise en place de mécanismes de double vérification. Vous êtes en quelque sorte le garde-fou technique de l'organisation , avec pour objectif de sécuriser les opérations sans perdre de vue les impératifs de continuité de service. 3- Structurer et harmoniser les pratiques L'un des enjeux majeurs du poste est de contribuer à l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les différents sites. Aujourd'hui, les niveaux de maturité et les pratiques peuvent varier d'un site à l'autre. Votre rôle sera de contribuer à construire un socle commun de méthodes et de standards opérationnels . Vous serez notamment amené(e) à : structurer les processus d'exploitation ; définir et harmoniser les standards techniques ; rédiger et améliorer les procédures et modes opératoires ; mettre en place des workflows opérationnels ; contrôler leur bonne application ; identifier les écarts entre les sites ; proposer et suivre les plans d'amélioration ; partager les bonnes pratiques ; réaliser des REX multisites ; accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouveaux standards. La capacité à construire et faire vivre des process sera donc aussi importante que votre expertise technique. 4- Apporter votre expertise lors des incidents critiques En cas d'incident technique complexe, vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des équipes Facility et Operations. Vous êtes notamment amené(e) à : analyser techniquement l'incident ; identifier les causes et les impacts potentiels ; apporter votre expertise aux responsables de site ; challenger les analyses proposées ; accompagner les équipes internes et les prestataires ; contribuer à la définition des actions correctives ; participer à la résolution de l'incident ; organiser et partager les retours d'expérience à l'échelle des différents sites. Votre capacité à prendre du recul, analyser rapidement une situation complexe et apporter une réponse techniquement robuste sera essentielle. 5 - Développer une culture d'excellence opérationnelle Vous ne vous contentez pas de définir les standards : vous accompagnez les équipes dans leur appropriation. Vous serez ainsi amené(e) à : former et accompagner les équipes ; expliquer les exigences techniques et opérationnelles ; faire progresser les pratiques ; fédérer autour d'objectifs communs ; accompagner la conduite du changement ; favoriser le partage de connaissances entre les sites. Vous disposez d'une forte capacité d'influence et savez faire avancer les sujets sans nécessairement disposer d'un lien hiérarchique direct . 6 - Être l'interlocuteur technique des clients majeurs Vous serez capable de : représenter la société sur les sujets techniques ; expliquer une situation ou un incident complexe ; présenter les actions mises en œuvre ; répondre aux interrogations techniques des clients ; apporter un discours structuré et crédible sur les enjeux d'exploitation et de sécurité des infrastructures. Une organisation en construction Vous rejoindrez un pôle d'expertise technique transverse nouvellement structuré , regroupant différentes compétences destinées à accompagner les opérations et les projets. L'objectif est de créer une véritable communauté d'experts capable d'apporter son expertise à l'ensemble des sites et de faire progresser collectivement les standards d'exploitation. Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec : les responsables de site ; les équipes Facility et Operations ; les équipes projets ; les experts techniques ; les prestataires et partenaires externes ; les fonctions transverses ; les clients majeurs. Le poste est donc particulièrement transverse et nécessite une forte capacité à créer du lien entre les différentes parties prenantes . Vos compétences Votre profil Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans un environnement Data Center ou infrastructure critique fortement structurée . Vous avez idéalement évolué dans un environnement où les exigences en matière de procédures, de sécurité opérationnelle, de maintenance et de continuité de service sont particulièrement élevées. Une expérience dans un environnement critique comparable serait particulièrement appréciée. Votre expertise technique Vous disposez d'une excellente connaissance des infrastructures critiques et notamment : électricité HT/BT ; systèmes de secours électrique ; UPS / groupes électrogènes ; CVC / HVAC ; refroidissement ; protection incendie ; contrôle-commande ; maintenance des infrastructures critiques. Vous êtes capable de comprendre l'intégralité de l'infrastructure et les interactions entre les différents systèmes , et pas uniquement votre domaine d'expertise initial. Vous savez également analyser une problématique technique complexe, identifier les risques et challenger les solutions proposées. Votre expérience opérationnelle Vous avez déjà évolué dans un environnement où les procédures et les standards opérationnels occupent une place importante. Vous êtes à l'aise avec : les modes opératoires (MOP) ; la gestion des changements ; l'analyse de risques ; la maintenance préventive et corrective ; la gestion d'incidents critiques ; les audits et contrôles opérationnels ; les REX ; la standardisation des pratiques ; la gestion de prestataires techniques. Vous avez surtout envie de faire progresser une organisation , de structurer les pratiques et d'améliorer durablement les opérations. Vos qualités Pour réussir dans ce rôle, nous recherchons une personne : dotée d'une forte expertise technique ; structurée et rigoureuse ; capable d'analyse et de prise de recul ; pédagogue et capable de transmettre son expertise ; à l'aise pour challenger ses interlocuteurs ; capable de prendre des décisions et de défendre une position technique ; dotée d'une forte intelligence relationnelle ; capable de s'adapter à différents profils et différents niveaux de maturité ; fédératrice et à l'aise dans un rôle transverse ; capable d'accompagner la conduite du changement. Votre capacité à adapter votre communication à votre interlocuteur tout en maintenant un haut niveau d'exigence technique sera déterminante. Avantages Bonus : 2 mois de salaire Déplacements : indemnité de véhicule forfaitaire sur 12 mois de 1 500 € De la participation équivalent à 1-1.5 mois de salaire Astreinte : Poste soumis à l'astreinte (à validation période d'essai) Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
