title: Territory Account Executive, Montreal
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: This is a Remote Role for candidates based in Montreal, Quebec</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.  Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. </span></p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">You'll drive new business by identifying and qualifying target commercial accounts for Cloudflare’s Enterprise service plan. This is a great opportunity for a Sales Professional to help build the business in Eastern Canada. You will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams.  </span></p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Develop and execute against a comprehensive account/territory plan</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Increase sales in a defined territory and/or account list to achieve revenue targets</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Create and articulate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Manage contract negotiations</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Maintain a robust sales pipeline</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ensure customer satisfaction</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Develop and maintain partner relationships as it relates to customer base</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Bilingual</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Minimum 3 years of direct technical sales experience </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience selling solutions related to Cyber Security, Networking, Cloud Solutions, SaaS, IaaS, PaaS is a plus  </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Mid to advanced understanding of computer networking and “how the internet works”</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Aptitude for learning complex technical concepts/terms (technical background in engineering, computer science, or IT strongly desired)</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Strong interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Comfortable working in a fast paced, dynamic environment</span></li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Responsable Réadaptation en Urgence
description: Handicap International / Humanité & Inclusion (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et vulnérabilisées, elle agit et témoigne pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels et améliorer leurs conditions de vie. Elle s’engage à promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Depuis sa création en 1982, HI a mis en place des programmes de développement dans plus de 60 pays et intervient dans de nombreuses situations d’urgence. Aujourd'hui, nous avons un budget d'environ 255 millions d'euros, avec 4794 employés dans le monde. Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens. CONTEXTE : La Direction des Programmes Internationaux (DPI) de Humanité & Inclusion comprend entre autres 5 Directions Géographiques, 4 Directions Techniques, 1 Direction Atlas Logistique et 1 Direction Urgence. La Direction Urgence est composée de 15 personnes: une équipe en charge de la veille, de l'alerte et de la préparation aux urgences et une équipe en charge des interventions d'urgence au niveau du siège et sur le terrain. C’est au sein de cette dernière, composée de 6 spécialistes des urgences et prêts à être déployés sous 72 heures que nous recrutons un ou une Responsable Réadaptation physique et Fonctionnelle en Urgence dans le cadre d’un remplacement temporaire. OBJECTIFS DU POSTE : Sous la responsabilité du responsable du pool d'urgence et en étroite coordination avec les Spécialistes en Réadaptation Physique et Fonctionnelle du siège, le responsable Réadaptation Physique et Fonctionnelle d'urgence aura la charge de : Participer au diagnostic initial des opérations de réponse d'urgence, à la suite d’une crise humanitaire ; · Contribuer à la définition de la stratégie, de la méthodologie et du dimensionnement du diagnostic initial, y compris la création et/ou l'adaptation des outils d'évaluation des besoins ; · Participer aux évaluations des besoins ; · Contribuer à l'analyse des résultats et à la définition de la stratégie de réponse immédiate en anticipant le nexus urgence-réhabilitation-développement ; · Contribuer à l'élaboration du projet et à la rédaction des propositions ; Diriger et coordonner : Piloter le déploiement des activités de réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle lors de l’ouverture de nouveaux programmes d’urgence, en assurant la définition du cadre opérationnel, le management des équipes, la coordination avec les autres secteurs d’intervention et les partenaires, ainsi que le suivi de la qualité, du budget, des résultats et du reporting. Le poste contribue également à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie d’intervention d’urgence, au renforcement des capacités des équipes et partenaires, et à la capitalisation des retours d’expérience. Représenter et promouvoir le mandat d’Humanité & Inclusion dans le cadre des réponses d’urgence dans votre domaine d’expertise ; · Promouvoir le mandat et son positionnement en coordination avec les partenaires de mise en œuvre ; · Représenter et participer aux mécanismes de coordination des réponses liées à la Réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle d’urgence (groupe de travail santé, groupe de travail traumatologie etc…) · Participer, sur demande de la hiérarchie, aux actions liées aux campagnes de plaidoyer et institutionnelles mises en œuvre par Humanité & Inclusion au siège et/ou sur le terrain ; · Contribuer à la mobilisation des acteurs publics et privés pour assurer l’inclusion de la vulnérabilité et du handicap dans leurs programmes et initiatives. Contribuer à la capitalisation institutionnelle et participer au développement et à la mise à jour des méthodologies, procédures, outils et formations d'urgence d’Humanité & Inclusion. · Participer aux travaux de formalisation et de capitalisation dans son domaine d'expertise en étroite collaboration avec le responsable de secteur et le spécialiste technique du siège ; · Participer à la stratégie Direction Urgence et autres, si nécessaire ; · Contribuer de façon proactive et constructive à la conception des processus et méthodologies de réponse aux urgences ; · Contribuer au développement et/ou à l'optimisation des outils, procédures et ressources utilisés par Humanité & Inclusion pour la réponse aux urgences en étroite collaboration avec le spécialiste technique du siège. · Contribuer au renforcement des capacités de réponse aux urgences du personnel et/ou des partenaires d'Humanité & Inclusion en fonction des besoins identifiés ; · Contribuer à l'amélioration des outils et modules de formation dans ses domaines d'expertise ; · Participer activement aux ateliers organisés au sein de l'Equipe de Réponse aux Urgences ou par d'autres départements au sein d'Humanité & Inclusion, en relation avec les réponses aux urgences · Apporter un support au spécialiste technique du siège sur des sujets spécifiques et transversaux. Requirements Vous avez une expérience d’au moins trois ans en réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle en contexte d’urgence et votre situation personnelle actuelle vous permet d’être déployé sous 72 heures ? Voici plus en détail le profil requis pour ce poste passionnant ouvert dans le cadre d’un remplacement temporaire : Formation / Connaissances - Un diplôme de kinésithérapeute ou ergothérapeute - Une formation complémentaire en gestion et développement de projets / opérations humanitaires ou équivalent de préférence dans le domaine de l’action humanitaire internationale - Bonne connaissance des réglementations et processus des bailleurs d’urgence - Langues : anglais et français maitrisés. La maitrise de l’espagnol ou l’arabe serait un plus. - Informatique : maitrise du Pack Office Profil recherché Expérience confirmée d’au moins 2 ans dans des fonctions de coordination ou de management de projets en réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle. Solide expérience clinique récente en réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle, notamment dans les domaines de l’orthopédie, de la traumatologie, de la rééducation respiratoire et/ou des brûlés. Expérience significative dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de cadres d’intervention en réadaptation d’urgence (processus, méthodologies, outils et protocoles). Connaissance et/ou expérience complémentaire dans les domaines de la santé mentale et du soutien psychosocial (SMSPS) ainsi que de l’ inclusion . Expérience avérée en management, encadrement et représentation d’équipes pluridisciplinaires . Bonne maîtrise des mécanismes, réglementations et exigences des bailleurs de fonds humanitaires d’urgence . Expérience dans le développement et le pilotage de stratégies d’intervention humanitaire . · Une expérience en évaluation initiale des besoins , ainsi qu’en missions d’ouverture ou de lancement de programmes d’urgence , constitue un atout majeur. · Excellente maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (oral et écrit) indispensable. L'espagnol ou l'arabe est un plus. Soft skills - Votre réactivité, votre grande capacité d’organisation et votre gestion du stress vous permettent de gérer une charge de travail importante dans un contexte sous pression - Grâce à votre capacité d’analyse, de synthèse et à votre flexibilité vous savez vous adapter rapidement à de nouveaux contextes - Bon communiquant et pédagogue vous aimez animer une équipe ou une formation. Vous êtes un bon « team player » Benefits ACCESSIBILITE DU LIEU DE TRAVAIL : Les locaux sont facilement accessibles en transports en commun (bus, métro). Un parking voitures et un parc à vélos sont également à disposition. Au sein du bâtiment, des rampes d'accès et ascenseurs garantissent une meilleure circulation. Tous les postes de travail sont situés en Open Space mais des box sont disponibles à chaque étage pour travailler dans le calme si nécessaire. L’espace de travail est très lumineux. Une référente handicap est présente pour répondre aux éventuelles questions et vous accompagner dans vos démarches. En fonction de vos besoins, le poste peut être aménagé. Wir glauben an die Stärke und das Potenzial unseres Teams und sind stets bemüht, dass Beste aus uns herauszuholen. Als Praktikant wirst du Teil dieses Teams. Dabei folgst du unserem strukturierten Ausbildungsplan, der darauf ausgerichtet ist, dich innerhalb kürzester Zeit zum Profi zu machen. Neben dem Programmieren stehen auch Tools und Prozesse wie Microsoft DevOps, Scrum und Git im Fokus. Sobald du dich sattelfest fühlst, erhältst du erste Einblicke in echte Projekte und kannst diese erkunden und kleinere Tasks umsetzen, frei von Termindruck und Deadlines. Aufgaben Das erwartet dich: Praktische Erfahrungen in einem schlagkräftigen Unternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung von Individualsoftware und Online-Plattformen spezialisiert hat Moderne Stacks, kein Wordpress, Joomla o.ä. Arbeit an spannenden Projekten und die Möglichkeit, moderne Technologien kennenzulernen Integration in ein engagiertes und kreatives Team Du kannst eigene Ideen einbringen und dich aktiv beteiligen Lerne den Scrum-Prozess kennen und arbeite mit DevOps-Boards Qualifikation Das bringst du mit: Laufende oder abgeschlossene Ausbildung, Weiterbildung, Umschulung, Fortbildung oder Studium mit Schwerpunkt Fachinformatik für Anwendungsentwicklung, Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik etc. Die Bereitschaft, neue Technologien, Programmiersprachen und Frameworks zu mastern Erfahrungen mit Programmiersprachen, CMS und Frameworks (JavaScript, PHP oder C# ist von Vorteil) Erfahrung mit Backend, Frontend, Datenbank, Versionierung mit GIT Leistungsbereitschaft (!), Eigenständige Arbeitsweise, Kreativität und Flexibilität Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Begeisterung für moderne Technologien Idealerweise ein Faible für Superhelden-Filme Benefits Das bieten wir: Ein Praktikum für mindestens fünf Monate, das Du für dein Studium oder deine Ausbildung anerkennen lassen kannst Eine Praktikumsvergütung in Abhängigkeit der Vorerfahrungen Eine Übernahme in eine Festanstellung bei erfolgreichem Abschluss (30 Urlaubstage, Verpflegung, Flexzeit, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, BVG-Ausweis, Bildungsurlaub etc.) Einen strukturierten Ausbildungsplan Pair Programming Sessions mit erfahrenen Entwicklern We love Kids! Zuschuss zur Kita und kinderfreundliche Bedingungen Ein motiviertes und freundliches Team, das dich jederzeit unterstützt und dir ein hervorragendes Arbeitsklima bietet Gratis Kaffee, Tee und Getränke, sowie Wirtschaftsmagazine Ein zentral gelegenes Office in Berlin Mitte, mit ausgezeichneter Anbindung an öffentliche Verkehrsmittel zwischen Rosa-Luxemburg-Platz und Alexanderplatz Dress code? Be dressed! Vierbeinige Kollegen willkommen - bringe deinen Hund mit ins Büro Wir sind zertifiziert vom TÜV Süd Du fühlst dich angesprochen? Nach der schriftlichen Bewerbung gehört die eigenständige Bearbeitung einer Fallstudie zum Bewerbungsablauf, deren Ergebnisse du in einem persönlichen Gespräch vorstellst. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! ---------------------- TenMedia GmbH - Software. Entwicklung. Berlin. title: Senior Sales Manager, Central Eastern Europe - Digital Natives, Startups
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location: Hybrid - </strong><strong>London, United Kingdom</strong></p> <hr> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, and Customer Success - all working together to help our customers adopt Cloudflare and build great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers take on real, technical problems while building the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Based out of our hub in London, you will help scale our new business revenues across the Digital Natives segment in the Central and Eastern Europe region by leading a team of Account Executives. As a first line manager you will i) coach AEs and act as the first line of support on pipeline generation, deal execution strategy and day-to-day matters, ii) work with Sales Ops, Management, Marketing, Partners, BDRs and other sales supporting functions to drive and iterate on/improving Cloudflare’s brand awareness, Go-To-Market strategy, and adoption, and iii) help attract, hire, and ramp-up high-performing Account Executives to hit sales targets and drive company goals (DNR growth, new product attach rates etc.).</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive exceptional sales growth by meeting and exceeding assigned quarterly and annual quotas</li> <li>Manage, coach, and develop your team of Account Executives</li> <li>Provide day-to-day deal support and functional guidance to AEs</li> <li>Source, interview, and recruit top sales talents in coordination with recruiting and sales leaders</li> <li>Own and drive accurate and up-to-date AE KPI, reporting in Salesforce and provide attainment forecast guidance to sales management on a weekly basis</li> <li>Help define ideal AE profiles for the region</li> <li>Help on-board and ramp up AEs</li> <li>Develop and iterate on best-practices/programs aimed at accelerating DNR growth, new product (Cloudflare One portfolio) attach rates, and other company goals</li> <li>Define and drive optimal Sales Go-To-Market coverage (vertical, geo-based etc.) for all market segments</li> <li>Drive channel relationships forward to accelerate channel business</li> <li>Help foster relationships between customer/partner executives and Cloudflare executives within key customer accounts</li> <li>Drive an efficient business cadence to cover forecast calls, pipeline, deal reviews, and account plan reviews ...etc</li> <li>Devise and lead quarterly business reviews/kick-offs reporting on the overall health of the business in your region</li> <li>Set the bar and best practices when it comes to data-driven new business sales and growth of existing accounts</li> <li>Document functional best practices and work with Sales Enablement to develop AE sales play books for both core and new products</li> <li>Work with Regional/Global Sales Management, Marketing, Channel, Sales Ops, and necessary sales supporting functions to devise and implement strategies to drive up Cloudflare’s brand awareness and revenues in target markets</li> <li>Develop and maintain relationships with industry related organizations that are key to Cloudflare's business in the region</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fluency in English and at least one Central and Eastern European languages</li> <li>A minimum of 15 years of overall sales experience out of which at least 10 years should be focused on the Central and Eastern Europe region working across the Digital Natives space</li> <li>You should have 5+ years experience managing a team of quota-carrying sales reps with a successful proven track record of selling and upselling complex solutions across all market segments in the Central and Eastern Europe region; preferably in a SaaS/Cloud/Cybersecurity platforms industry</li> <li>Experience directly managing a high volume, high velocity pipeline driving rapid growth while delivering long term value to our customers</li> <li>Experience developing & rolling-out Go-to-Market strategies in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment</li> <li>Excellent presentation and communication skills, both written and verbal, with confidence to develop and present ideas to different audience levels</li> <li>Established experience and relationships with the Cybersecurity and SaaS/Cloud community in the assigned market with the ability to establish and grow strong partnerships</li> <li>Hands-on leader that strikes a balance between strategic vision and tactical execution</li> <li>Having a well regarded market reputation with strong related connections and relationships</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce and other sales reporting and BI tools</li> <li>Self-motivated with an entrepreneurial spirit and comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment</li> <li>Capacity to strive in a diverse and multicultural workplace</li> <li>Aptitude to learn new technical concepts and terms</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree required in a related field (Computer engineering, computer science or similar studies). MBA or MIS a plus</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><spa

title: Organisationstalent gesucht: Technischer Disponent im IT-Helpdesk (m/w/d)
description: Wir bei NEXPERTO sind ein innovatives IT-Systemhaus, das Unternehmenskunden mit maßgeschneiderten IT-Lösungen unterstützt. Unser Fokus liegt auf einem verlässlichen Kundenservice und modernen Technologien, die echte Mehrwerte schaffen. Als Team arbeiten wir effizient und lösungsorientiert, ohne dabei den Blick fürs Wesentliche zu verlieren. Flache Hierarchien, klare Strukturen und ein offenes Miteinander machen uns aus. Wenn du einen Arbeitgeber suchst, der Professionalität und Teamgeist verbindet, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Aufgaben Anfragen-Manager : Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für Support-, Change- und Bedarfsanfragen und sorgst für Erfassung, Kategorisierung und Priorisierung. Service-Koordinator : Du steuerst eingehende Serviceanfragen und leitest sie an den 1st- und 2nd-Level-Support weiter. Planungsheld : Du organisierst und koordinierst Vor-Ort-Termine für den 2nd-Level-Support. Daten-Guru : Du pflegst Kundendaten sowie technische Details zu Projekten in unserem Ticketsystem. Einsatz-Architekt : Du planst, organisierst und kontrollierst Technikereinsätze – immer mit Blick auf Qualität, Kosten und Termine. Qualitätswächter : Du überprüfst ausgeführte Leistungen und stellst sicher, dass alles nach Plan läuft. Kaufmännischer Allrounder : Von der Abrechnung bis zur Kostenkontrolle übernimmst du Verantwortung für wirtschaftliche Aufgaben. Datenpfleger : Du kümmerst dich um Lieferanten- und Materialstammdaten, damit alles reibungslos läuft. Qualifikation Erfahrung in der Disposition, idealerweise in einem IT- oder technischen Umfeld. Ein Händchen für Organisation und eine strukturierte, detailorientierte Arbeitsweise. Kommunikationstalent, um Kunden, Technikerund interne Teams zu verbinden. Technisches Grundverständnis und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Aufgaben schnell zu durchblicken. Kaufmännisches Wissen und Routine im Umgang mit Abrechnungen. Sicherer Umgang mit Ticketsystemen und Office-Anwendungen. Belastbarkeit, Lösungsorientierung und eine gute Portion Teamgeist. Benefits Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag mit attraktivem Gehaltspaket. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, mobil zu arbeiten (nach der Probezeit und in gemeinsamer Absprache im Team) – inklusive Firmennotebook Einen modernen Arbeitsplatz mit Top-IT-Ausstattung. Ein familiäres Unternehmensklima mit flachen Hierarchien – Deine Ideen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht! Sorgfältige Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Kollegen. Regelmäßige Schulungen, Weiterbildungen und Austauschmöglichkeiten mit Experten anderer Standorte. Kostenlose Getränke (Kaffee, Tee, Wasser) und regelmäßige Team-Events. Zugang zum Fitnessprogramm WELLPASS . Unterstützung bei der Wohnungssuche, falls du umziehen möchtest. Das IT-Systemhaus NEXPERTO aus Kempten hat sich auf die gehobenen Ansprüche mittelständischer Unternehmen spezialisiert. Das Team von NEXPERTO übernimmt sowohl einzelne Projekte als auch die Rolle einer externen IT-Abteilung. Mit Full-Managed-Services halten die IT-Spezialisten rund um die beiden Geschäftsführer Dominik Tauscher und Ilja Moeller die IT-Infrastruktur ihrer Kunden immer aktuell und behalten sie über ein 24/7-Echtzeit-Monitoring ständig im Blick. Zu den Kernkompetenzen von NEXPERTO gehören neben IT-Outsourcing und Managed Services auch Home-Office-Konzepte, Backup-Konzepte und IT-Sicherheitskonzepte. Die tägliche Arbeit von NEXPERTO richtet sich grundsätzlich am eigenen Anspruch aus: Hier will man den Kunden IT-Service der Extraklasse bieten. title: Un(e) Chef(fe) de Projets élections RH
description: Notre entreprise Depuis 2007, Kercia est pionnier dans les technologies de vote électronique pour les élections professionnelles. Basée à Grenoble et Paris, notre équipe de 63 personnes accompagne plus de 5 000 organisations —PME, ETI et Grands Groupes — pour simplifier, sécuriser et réenchanter leurs processus électoraux. Kercia met à disposition une plateforme qui permet de gérer tous types d’élections avec des services adaptés à chaque organisation. Notre ambition : devenir le n°1 du vote électronique en France. KERCIA appuie sa stratégie de croissance sur le développement d’un environnement qui permet à tous « Les KERCIENS » de bénéficier d’une expérience salarié positive, individuellement et collectivement. Nous recherchons Un(e) Chef(fe) de Projets élections désireux de s’investir dans la réussite des objectifs de notre entreprise. En rejoignant la communauté des KERCIENS, tu participes à l’aventure d’une entreprise à taille humaine, qui saura t’accueillir avec bienveillance pour ce poste au sein du service opérationnel. Ton poste et tes missions Rattaché(e) au Manager opérationnel, tu assureras la réalisation de projets de vote électronique pour les clients en garantissant la tenue des délais, le respect des obligations légales et réglementaires et en optimisant la satisfaction du client. Tu seras basé(e) à Meylan, aux pieds des montagnes dans un bâtiment neuf au 5ième et dernier étage. Ce sont des espaces lumineux et modernes, avec une vuepanoramique à 360° sur les montagnes. Pour te repérer : https://share.google/8RQ9qsOwmtwZ1evCw Tu auras 3 jours/semaine possible de télétravail. Tu évolueras au sein d’une équipe de Chef(fe)s de projets, experte dans son domaine et passionnée par sa mission. Tes missions principales seront : D’assurer la réalisation des projets dans le respect des critères de qualité et dans un objectif de satisfaction client - Organiser les réunions de lancement avec les clients : - Proposer le planning établi en fonction des échéances du vote - Valider les points juridiques clés - Prendre en compte les attentes particulières du client - Réaliser le paramétrage de l’outil de vote électronique en s’assurant de la validation par le client - Piloter la réunion de scellement des urnes - Superviser le déroulement des élections et intervenir en support de 2eme niveau en cas de sollicitation - Animer la réunion de dépouillement des élections en rassurant sur la fiabilité du vote électronique - Réaliser un bilan du projet et envoyer un questionnaire de satisfaction au client - Organiser un point de débriefing avec le client pour les dossiers stratégiques De garantir le respect des obligations juridiques ou règlementaires particulières au projet - Recueillir auprès du client tous les documents d’entrée permettant d’évaluer les contraintes juridiques du client - Rédiger et fournir au client les notes/fiches juridiques nécessaires à la bonne réalisation du projet - Mettre en application les besoins juridiques du client (ex : échéances, sièges, quorum…) - Conseiller sur leur adaptation aux spécificités du projet et attentes du client - S’assurer de la prise en compte des règles juridiques (légales, conventionnelles) par le client tout au long du processus de vote De contribuer à la sécurité de l’information dans le cadre de tes missions Appliquer l’ensemble des politiques, procédures et bonnes pratiques de KERCIA en matière de sécurité de l’information dans tes activités de gestion de projets et de conseil juridique Veiller à la confidentialité, à l’intégrité et à la disponibilité des informations traitées (données électorales, données clients, documents juridiques, contrats, etc.) Signaler sans délai tout incident, suspicion d’incident ou non-conformité lié à la sécurité de l’information via les canaux internes prévus Participer, le cas échéant, aux actions de sensibilisation et d’amélioration continue en matière de sécurité de l’information (retours d’expérience, contribution à la FAQ interne, mise à jour de supports, etc.) Tu travailleras en synergie avec l’ensemble des services de KERCIA (commercial, technique, administratif, direction, …) et tu participeras à l’ensemble des ateliers et à la vie quotidienne de la communauté Kercienne. Tu génèreras de l’impact et de la satisfaction client au travers de tes missions. À ton intégration, tu suivras un cursus de formation interne aux méthodologies et aux standards de qualité KERCIA. Dès ton arrivée et tout au long de ta prise de poste, tu seras accompagné(e) par un membre de l’équipe. Partie intégrante du service opérationnel, le travail d’équipe et l’entraide sont au cœur des valeurs Kerciennes. Ton profil Tes atouts et toi De formation supérieure bac+2 (BTS / DUT) à bac+3/4 , tu as une forte appétence pour la gestion de projets et le conseil. Tu as acquis une expérience de 2 à 3 ans en Gestion des Ressources Humaines / Gestion de Projets ou Gestion Juridique (alternance incluse). Des connaissances en matière d’Elections Professionnelles seraient un plus et des compétences en matière de Relations Sociales / Gestion du Climat Social / Droit social sont recherchées pour répondre aux attentes du poste Diplomate, tu possèdes un bon relationnel, tu es reconnu(e) pour ton aisance orale et rédactionnelle. Tu es agile et autonome, doté(e) d’une bonne capacité d’organisation et de priorisation. Ton état d’esprit est orienté solutions. Tu sais faire preuve d’empathie et de bienveillance. Ton esprit de camaraderie et tes idées folles sont attendus sur ce poste ! Bonus : ton appétence pour les nouvelles technologies et ta maitrise du PACK OFFICE seraient un plus pour répondre pleinement aux attentes du poste. Mobile, tu seras amené(e) à te déplacer sur l’ensemble du territoire pour le compte de tes clients. Des réunions de coordinations régulières auront également lieu au siège à Meylan (38). Tu souhaites rejoindre une équipe dynamique dans un environnement stimulant ? Déposes ton CV sur ce formulaire (plus bas) ou postule via le bouton sur cette page. Nous t’attendons pour une prise de poste à partir de novembre / décembre 2026. Poste à pourvoir en CDD 12 mois / prime qualité / tickets restaurant / intéressement / séminaire d’entreprise. À compétences égales, tous nos postes sont accessibles aux personnes en situation de handicap. Votre intégration chez Kercia : Dès votre premier jour, nous mettons tout en œuvre pour que vous soyez accueilli dans les meilleures conditions : votre poste de travail (PC, bureau ect.) est prêt et configuré, et un « Pack Welcome » vous attend. Pour faciliter vos débuts, un parrain dédié vous accompagne et des sessions « Vis-ma-Vie » sont organisées pour vous permettre de découvrir nos différents métiers. Chez Kercia, l'onboarding est un véritable parcours de plusieurs semaines conçu pour vous intégrer naturellement à l'équipe et vous accompagner dans vos nouvelles missions au sein d'un environnement attentif à l'épanouissement de chacun. Rémunération et avantages Package salariale pour ce poste comprise entre EUR 25,000 et 34,000 par an (fixe et variable). Vous bénéficiez de 25 jours de congés payés par an. title: Social Media Manager, CDI / Freelance
description: Chez iara, on cherche un Social Media Manager quelqu’un qui pilote, structure, renforce , mais surtout fait grandir une stratégie social media déjà en place, dans un contexte de forte croissance et d’internationalisation (et ça, ça arrive très vite). iara, c’est quoi ? Die AJAT GmbH unterstützt Unternehmen in den Bereichen IT-Service, Cloud und Cybersecurity. Für die Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung von ERP-Umgebungen suchen wir einen ERP-Spezialisten, der fachliches Prozessverständnis mit technischem Wissen verbindet. Deine Aufgaben ERP-Systeme betreuen: Du unterstützt unsere Kunden beim Betrieb und bei der Weiterentwicklung von Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central und Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Navision – einschließlich älterer NAV-Versionen. Störungen analysieren und lösen: Du nimmst Supportanfragen auf, reproduzierst Fehler, prüfst mögliche Ursachen und dokumentierst die Bearbeitung nachvollziehbar. Dabei unterscheidest du zwischen Bedienungsfragen, Berechtigungsproblemen, Konfigurationsfehlern und technischen Störungen. Geschäftsprozesse verstehen: Du unterstützt Anwender bei Abläufen wie Auftragsbearbeitung, Einkauf, Verkauf, Lagerverwaltung und Rechnungsstellung. Du erkennst Zusammenhänge zwischen Belegen, Beständen und Buchungen. Benutzer und Berechtigungen verwalten: Du betreust Benutzerzugänge, Rollen und Berechtigungen nach abgestimmten Freigaben und unterstützt bei Zugriffsproblemen. Schnittstellen prüfen: Du analysierst Probleme beim Datenaustausch mit angebundenen Systemen, beispielsweise Lagerverwaltungssystemen oder Microsoft-Diensten, und koordinierst die weitere Bearbeitung mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartnern. Microsoft-Cloud-Anbindungen betreuen: Du unterstützt bei Benutzerverwaltung, Authentifizierung und der Integration von ERP-Systemen in Microsoft 365, Azure und Microsoft Entra ID. Änderungen begleiten: Du wirkst an Updates, Tests, Prozessverbesserungen und Migrationsvorhaben mit und stimmst Anforderungen mit Kunden, Fachbereichen und Entwicklungspartnern ab. Wissen weitergeben: Du erstellst verständliche Dokumentationen und unterstützt Anwender dabei, ihre Systeme sicher und effizient zu nutzen. Das bringst du mit Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Navision. Kenntnisse älterer NAV-Versionen, beispielsweise NAV 2016, sind für uns besonders wichtig. Praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central ist ausdrücklich erwünscht , insbesondere in Betreuung, Konfiguration, Administration oder Beratung. Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Microsoft-Cloud-Umfeld , insbesondere Microsoft 365, Azure und Microsoft Entra ID, mit Bezug zu Benutzerverwaltung, Berechtigungen, Authentifizierung und Anwendungsintegration. Ein gutes Verständnis für betriebliche ERP-Prozesse und die Fähigkeit, fachliche Anforderungen technisch einzuordnen. Eine strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und die Bereitschaft, Probleme bis zur Lösung nachzuverfolgen. Teamgeist, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und eine klare, freundliche Kommunikation mit Kunden und Kollegen. Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau in Wort und Schrift. Du kannst technische Sachverhalte erklären, Kundengespräche führen und aussagekräftige Dokumentationen erstellen. Bereitschaft zur Arbeit vor Ort in Köln sowie zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen zu unseren Kunden . Zusätzliche Kenntnisse, die uns freuen Erfahrung mit Upgrades oder Migrationen von Dynamics NAV zu Business Central. Kenntnisse in AL für Business Central oder C/AL für ältere NAV-Umgebungen . Erfahrung mit SQL Server und der Analyse lokaler NAV-/ERP-Umgebungen. Kenntnisse in PowerShell, Power Automate oder Power BI. Erfahrung mit ERP-Schnittstellen, Webservices und APIs. Was dich bei uns erwartet Eine Aufgabe mit direktem Kundenkontakt, technischen Fragestellungen und Einblicken in unterschiedliche Geschäftsprozesse. Du arbeitest mit unserem IT-Team zusammen und bringst dein Wissen in die Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung der Kundenumgebungen ein. Interesse? Dann freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und eine kurze Übersicht deiner relevanten Projekterfahrung. Bitte gib in deiner Bewerbung konkret an: Mit welchen Business-Central- und NAV-/Navision-Versionen du gearbeitet hast und welche Aufgaben du dabei übernommen hast. Welche Microsoft-Cloud-Dienste du praktisch betreut oder administriert hast. Dein Deutschniveau , deinen frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin und deine Gehaltsvorstellung . Ob du vor Ort in Köln arbeiten kannst und zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen bereit bist. AJAT GmbH · Köln www.ajat.io Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Under the direction of the EHS Manager, the EHS Advisor will be responsible for providing support to the Project Managers, supervisors and workers. This position will provide leadership and coordination of the day-to-day EHS requirements of the assigned project(s).</p> <p>  <br><strong>Key Functions of the Senior EHS Advisor</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide advice, guidance, support and instruction in all EHS matters to management, safety representatives and employees (including where applicable to sub-contractors, suppliers and visitors to sites).</li> <li>Provide leadership through good example. Be proactive in all matters concerning the role.</li> <li>Identify training needs, report requirements to project team and carry out training as required.</li> <li>Audit and inspect projects, agree and prepare achievable corrective and preventive action plans towards compliance to and continual improvement of the EHS on the project.</li> <li>Report on business EHS risks, KPIs and trends accurately with data and recommend constructive actions towards continuous improvements.</li> <li>Ensure incidents are reported and investigations are carried out in a thorough and professional manner in order to identify root causes and corrective and preventive action plans.</li> <li>Ensure that Site EHS Plans, RAMS and other associated site documents are updated and compliant with statutory and other requirements and that they are reviewed on a continuous basis.</li> </ul> <p>  <br><strong>EHS Advisor Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Reports to EHS Manager, Site Managers/Supervisors and Project Manager.</li> <li>Is conversant with the contents of the Kirby safety statement, environment manual, risk assessments, aspects & impacts, legislation and procedures.</li> <li>Provides advice, guidance, instruction and training in all EHS matters to management, safety representatives and employees (including where applicable to sub-contractors, suppliers and visitors to sites).</li> <li>Carries out internal audits and site inspections in conjunction with Site Management, recommends corrective actions, improvements and document findings.</li> <li>Prepares in conjunction with site management team a project specific EHS Plan, induction and Risk Assessment Method Statements (RAMS). These shall be compiled and agreed prior to work commencing and ongoing through lookaheads.</li> <li>Ensures that the project specific EHS Plan, induction and RAMS are up to date, reviewed periodically and communicated to all relevant persons (including clients, Main Contractor, other contractors, visitors and others who may be affected by that work).</li> <li>Visits each new project, sets up the necessary site safety files (Series 500 & 600), registers, abstracts of regulations, posters, SEOR program, etc., and ensures that site establishment complies with the legislation, client regulations and company regulations as a minimum.</li> <li>Reviews Contractor Appointments and ensures that correct appointment is carried out and that only competent contractors are used on projects.</li> <li>Introduces and implements effective measures aimed at the prevention of incidents at work.</li> <li>Reports on incidents and/or dangerous occurrences should they occur to the EHS Manager, Project Manager and Site Managers as required.</li> <li>Reports on areas of concern to the relevant party for correction. Persistent and serious areas of concern are to be reported immediately to line management as per (1) above. Retains evidence of communications with relevant parties.</li> <li>Carries out incident investigation in conjunction with site management, establishes cause of incident or dangerous occurrence and recommends method for future avoidance.</li> <li>Audits the company site safety file, (Series 500 & 600), makes sure that hazards/risks are regularly assessed, that control measures are implemented, that inspections are carried out and that all incidents are reported, investigated and closed out.</li> <li>Prepares Monthly KPI Report for their projects, issues monthly return of Site Visit Schedule, SEORs, KPIs, violations to the EHS Manager and the Business Unit Manager. Issues new SDS to EHS Manager.</li> <li>Provides training and information to the workforce using appropriate training aids and media as required. Issues records of training to HR to update the training matrix.</li> <li>Attends the regional EHS Coordination Meeting.</li> <li>Attends the EHS meeting with the Business Unit Manager, as required (1 per region).</li> <li>Attends internal and external site meetings as required – safety meetings, coordination meetings etc...</li> <li>Implements and promotes the company Incentive Scheme on all projects.</li> <li>Arranges distribution and maintenance of fully stocked first aid boxes on site.</li> <li>Monitors P.P.E usage and advises site management on type of protective equipment required.</li> <li>Issues non-conformances, commendations and disciplinary warnings both written and verbal if required or instructed to do so.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Necessary requirement of the EHS Advisor</strong><strong> </strong> </p> <ul> <li>5+ Years’ Experience in similar industry. Knowledge of Electrical, Mechanical and CSA preferably.</li> <li>Diploma to NFQ 8 in Occupational H&S. Certificate to NFQ 6 Environmental Management. Safe Pass, (CSCS (UK)), Train the Trainer, First Aid, Training Instructor.</li> <li>Internal ISO14000 and ISO45000 system auditor.</li> <li>Experience with the Construction Regulations and CDM roles, with experience working with sub-contractors.</li> <li>Experience with EHS Management Systems, safety schemes and tendering e.g. ISOs, Achilles, SSiPs etc.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, through presentations, reports, written and verbal.</li> <li>Ability to work with Kirby / client / main contractor Safety and Project teams.</li> <li>Ability to work well within strict deadlines.</li> <li>Ability to be able to prepare Audits and EHS reports, to a high standard.</li> <li>Up to date with Legislation, Standards, Guidance, Advice and Compliance.</li> <li>Proactive in identifying positive and negative acts, ability to follow through with realistic corrective and preventive actions.</li> <li>Ability to lead and coordinate incident investigations and utilise root cause analysis.</li> <li>IOSH Member or Equivalent.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>For more information on this role, or other Construction / Engineering opportunities across Ireland, the UK, Europe, or South Africa please review our careers page (<a href="https://careers.kirbygroup.com/vacancies/">Vacancies - Kirby Group Careers</a>) or contact the Talent Acquisition Team at Kirby Group in confidence on +353 (0)1 454 0411.</em></p> <p><em>Kirby Group Engineering is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of race, gender, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or age.</em></p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Manager (m/f/d)
description: <p><strong>At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for <strong>10,000+ businesses worldwide</strong>, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, <strong>millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day</strong>.</p> <p>We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.</p> <p>We're <strong>100 people</strong>, <strong>profitable</strong>, and have raised <strong>€18M in funding</strong> (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.</p> <p>We are hiring a backend-leaning Tech Lead to lead a team of 3-4 engineers and own the tech for a part of Superchat’s product.</p> <p>This is a hands-on leadership role: You’ll spend roughly half your time designing and building software and the other half enabling your team to perform at its best. Work directly on architecture, development and important projects while creating the clarity, feedback and environment your engineers need to deliver an excellent product</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who We Want</strong></span></h4> <p><strong>A strong, current backend engineer.</strong><br>You bring 3+ years of experience as a Senior or Staff Engineer and remain deeply involved in software development. You are comfortable owning, designing and building crucial parts of production systems.</p> <p><strong>Experienced with the JVM ecosystem.</strong><br>You have substantial experience with Java or another JVM language. Kotlin and AWS experience are a plus, since our backend runs on Kotlin/Quarkus.</p> <p><strong>Ready to lead people.<br></strong>You have at least 2 years of experience in a leadership role, whether as a Tech Lead, Engineering Manager, or through leading projects and owning architecture.</p> <p><strong>Strong at delivery.</strong><br>You know how to turn product goals into reality. You are used to work in fast-paced startups and are a driver to increase velocity.</p> <p><strong>Product-minded.</strong><br>You care about solving the customers problem. You engage with product decisions, challenge assumptions constructivly and find pragmatic solutions to build things in a lean way.</p> <p><strong>Clear communicator.</strong><br>You are able to explain complex technical things in details to Engineers and in an understandable way to non-technical stakeholders. You create alignment and motivate people </p> <p><strong>Excited about AI-assisted development.</strong><br>You are already using AI in your development workflow and are eager to explore how it can improve engineering speed, quality and the way teams work.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who We Don’t Want</strong></span></h4> <p><strong>Pure people manager.<br></strong>You no longer want to work directly on software. This role requires meaningful, ongoing involvement in architecture, implementation, code review, and technical problem-solving.</p> <p><strong>Hero engineer.<br></strong>You want to make every important technical decision yourself or become the bottleneck for the team. Your job is to raise the effectiveness of the whole team, not to be the only person who can solve difficult problems.</p> <p><strong>Pure delivery manager.<br></strong>You treat engineering as a ticketing operation focused only on timelines and task tracking instead of product quality, technical health, and team growth. We need engineering leaders, not project coordinators.</p> <p><strong>Remote-only operator.<br></strong>You prefer fully remote work and don’t want to actively build relationships and culture in person with the team. We believe strong engineering leadership requires regular in-person collaboration and presence in Berlin.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Your Day To Day</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li>Spend approximately 50% of your time contributing directly to architecture, development, code reviews, and important technical projects.</li> <li>Lead a team of 3-4 engineers and take responsibility for its effectiveness, technical quality, and delivery.</li> <li>Work closely with your Product Manager to understand customer problems, shape solutions, scope projects, and set priorities.</li> <li>Establish clear technical direction while enabling engineers to own decisions and develop their judgment.</li> <li>Run regular 1:1s, give actionable feedback, and support each engineer’s development and performance.</li> <li>Remove blockers, manage dependencies, and help the team identify delivery risks early.</li> <li>Improve engineering practices and explore effective uses of AI throughout the software-development lifecycle.</li> <li>Contribute to hiring through technical interviews, structured feedback, and candidate conversations.</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Stakeholders</strong></span></h4> <p><strong>Director of Engineering:</strong> Your manager and partner on people development, calibration, processes.<br><strong>Direct Reports: </strong>Engineers in your team; you own their development, performance and growth<br><strong>Product Manager:</strong> PMs own what and why; you own how (delivery) and who (people)<br><strong>CTO and CPO: </strong>We are a lean organization with a flat hierarchy. You will regulary disccuss the direction of architecture with the CTO and product with the CPO</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Why People Choose Us</span></h4> <p><strong>Mission that matters. </strong>Real impact on small businesses, not abstract metrics</p> <p><strong>Funded with conviction. </strong>$18M raised and profitable</p> <p><strong>Modern stack. </strong>Kotlin/Quarkus, AWS, TypeScript/React/Next.js, and LangGraph for AI-powered features</p> <p><strong>Squad-based organization. </strong>Each squad owns its domain end-to-end with real ownership and autonomy</p> <p><strong><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">Two clear career tracks</span>.</strong> We support both individual contributor growth (up to Staff level) and Management Paths with explicit reversibility between both and Tech Lead being the first level of management that is still quite hands-on</p> <p><strong>Product-led structure. </strong>PMs report directly to the CPO, keeping product strategy focused, consistent, and clearly prioritized</p> <p><strong>Hybrid by design. </strong>Our Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg is the center of gravity, with two work-from-home days as the standard setup</p> <p><strong>Direct feedback culture. </strong>Honest, direct, and kind feedback is part of how we work together - in 1:1s, retrospectives, and everyday collaboration</p> <p><strong>Benefits & Culture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Choose between an Urban Sports Club/John Reed membership or a public transport/Dance subscription</li> <li>Regular company and team events</li> <li>Annual personal development budget of €500 for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more</li> <li>An inclusive and exciting startup culture that enables fast professional and personal growth</li> <li>Beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment</li> </ul> <p><strong>We want to build a community, not just a company.</strong></p> <p>It’s important to us to create an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together - whether that’s through HYROX training, golfing, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or whatever kind of community you’d like to help build here!</p> <p><strong>We're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the description. At Superchat, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously.</strong></p> <p><strong>Relocating to Berlin? We support you with practical relocation help. You'll feel home in no time.</strong></p> <p><strong>We look forward to your application! 🙂</strong></p> <p><strong>With your application you agree to our <a href="https://www.notion.so/f601741cb4f24d418411aa0ff86c3787?pvs=21">privacy policy.</a></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><img src="https://i.imgur.com/Uicf3C7.jpg" alt="" width="800" style="max-width: 100%;"></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description: <h3><strong>Overview</strong></h3> <p>The Cybersecurity Engineer is a hands-on technical role within the Cybersecurity team, responsible for the day-to-day operation, monitoring and continuous improvement of the security controls that protect Cambridge Consultants’ systems, data and client work. As a small team, everyone contributes across the full breadth of the estate rather than owning a single system in isolation.</p> <p>Reporting to the Head of Cybersecurity, you’ll work across a wide range of security systems and tooling alongside the rest of the Cybersecurity team, while collaborating with colleagues across IT Services and other business stakeholders to keep the organisation secure. Strong teamwork and a willingness to build knowledge beyond your immediate specialism are essential, given the breadth of technologies and responsibilities covered by the team.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Monitor and operate the team’s core security tooling, investigating alerts and coordinating remediation activities.</li> <li>Manage vulnerability assessment activities, including vulnerability scanning, remediation tracking and maintenance of the risk register.</li> <li>Support the operation of email security controls, including investigation and triage of suspicious email activity.</li> <li>Review software requests, approving low-risk solutions and conducting more detailed security assessments where required, working with stakeholders across the business to understand requirements and risks.</li> <li>Contribute to the continuous improvement of security monitoring, processes and operational practices.</li> <li>Support the administration and improvement of identity, access management and endpoint security controls, including Active Directory, Entra ID, Conditional Access and endpoint management technologies.</li> <li>Help deliver cybersecurity awareness activities, provide practical security guidance, and work with colleagues across IT and the business to support secure ways of working.</li> <li>Contribute to security improvement initiatives and projects across cloud security, identity, monitoring and data protection technologies, informed by emerging threats and technology risks</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you need to succeed:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience investigating and triaging alerts from AV/EDR tooling (e.g. Sophos, Defender), including analysing Windows event logs, suspicious activity, email-related threats and Microsoft 365 security alerts.</li> <li>Ability to assess and articulate security risk, including the relationship between threats, vulnerabilities and risk, with working knowledge of vulnerability management concepts such as CVEs, CVSS scoring and remediation prioritisation.</li> <li>Experience supporting security incidents, with an understanding of the incident response lifecycle, evidence handling and reporting requirements.</li> <li>Basic grounding in identity and access management (Active Directory, Entra ID, Conditional Access, SSO), Microsoft 365 security capabilities, and core networking concepts (protocols, ports, DNS, firewalls/VPN).</li> <li>A team player with a strong willingness to learn, share knowledge and support colleagues across a small team covering a broad range of systems. This role requires breadth across many areas rather than deep specialism in a single technology.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills at both technical and non-technical levels, with strong attention to detail, critical thinking and problem-solving.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer: </strong></h3> <ul> <li>25 days annual leave plus bank holidays (with the option to buy 10 more a year)</li> <li>Company bonus (profit share)</li> <li>Flexible working patterns and hybrid working</li> <li>Medical insurance and group income protection</li> <li>Employee assistance programme and mental health support group</li> <li>Enhanced maternity/paternity leave</li> <li>Sabbatical leave</li> <li>Travel insurance (business and leisure)</li> <li>Generous company pension plan</li> <li>Personalised career development and training plans</li> <li>Free breakfast and two-course lunch in the office every day</li> <li>Free onsite parking and we are close to public transport links</li> <li>A variety of events organised by our social committee, ranging from summer and Christmas parties to board game nights and socials at our own rooftop bar!</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why Cambridge Consultants?</strong></h3> <p>At Cambridge Consultants, you'll contribute to radical, new-to-the-world innovation that transforms business, society and the planet. Joining our multidisciplinary teams means helping to turn bold ideas into reality, harnessing the power of deep tech to create products, services and experiences that have never existed before. Whether you're advancing technologies, shaping strategy, supporting operations or driving commercial growth, it's an opportunity to make a real impact and help create the future.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>By submitting an application to Cambridge Consultants, you confirm that the information provided in this application, together with any supporting documentation, is true, complete, and accurate to the best of your knowledge and belief. You understand that any false statement, misleading information, or material omission may render you liable to disqualification from the recruitment process, withdrawal of any offer of employment, or dismissal without notice if discovered following appointment. You acknowledge that the organisation reserves the right to verify the information supplied.</strong><br></p> <hr> <p style="text-align: center;"> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Fire Investigator - Ireland
description: <p> </p> <p><strong>Company Overview</strong></p> <p>Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.</p> <p>Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.</p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization. </p> <p>Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.</p> <p><strong>Job Overview</strong></p> <p>Jensen Hughes is a market leading forensic investigation company, comprised of highly experienced investigators committed to delivering technical excellence.  Operating throughout the UK, Ireland and overseas, we investigate the origin and cause of fires and explosions and other accidents or failures on land and at sea. Our clients trust us to respond rapidly and deliver conclusive reports, robust evidence and expert testimony of the highest technical standard in courts throughout the world.</p> <p>A forensic investigation includes establishing the root cause of an event and determining the likelihood of a recovery from a third party or the repudiation of a claim on an insurance policy because the policyholder has failed to fulfil obligations under the contract of insurance.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Senior Fire Investigator to join our highly qualified team, based in Ireland.</p> <p> This role will involve:</p> <ul> <li>Attending incident scenes, documenting and collecting evidence, interviewing witnesses</li> <li>Acting as investigator in the investigation of the origin, cause and development of more complex cases</li> <li>Liaising with experts representing other interested parties</li> <li>Producing consistently high quality, detailed and accurate technical reports</li> <li>Providing expert witness evidence, where required</li> <li>Utilising Jensen Hughes’ case management system to record all case-related activity, in line with SLA requirements</li> <li>Attending joint examinations, utilising the skills of specialists where necessary</li> <li>Maintaining technical knowledge and skills through continuous professional development, by attending training courses, undertaking research and reference to scientific papers and developments in the field of fire and explosion investigation</li> <li>Attending marketing events, as required</li> <li>Produce and present articles/presentations for training or marketing purposes</li> <li>Represent Jensen Hughes at meetings/conferences as an ambassador for the company</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements and Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Candidates will have relevant experience and/or qualifications in the field of fire investigation, fire engineering, forensic science or other relevant discipline. Membership to a professional body would be advantageous but is not essential. Regardless of academic/professional background, practical experience is essential.</li> <li>The role requires strong analytical skills and the ability to apply scientific and systematic approaches to the forensic examination of incident scenes.</li> <li>Strong communication skills are essential, along with the ability to present accurate information in a clear and unambiguous manner, both verbally and in writing.  Attention to detail, a flexible approach and an ability to form effective working relationships with colleagues and clients are key qualities for this position. You will be expected to be able to work independently with minimal supervision, albeit there will always be a support network of colleagues when assistance or guidance is required.</li> <li>This role requires frequent, often short notice, travel to scenes across Ireland and the UK. Some overseas travel may also be required. You must hold a current driving licence and, ideally, be a car owner.</li> </ul> <p>In return, we offer a competitive salary and performance-related bonus along with other benefits. </p> <p>#LI-MR1</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>Jensen Hughes is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.</strong></em></p> <p> </p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we embrace innovation and understand that people are increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) tools like ChatGPT and other generative platforms to learn, prepare and communicate.  We have provided some guidelines regarding the responsible use of AI in the recruitment process.  Please click <strong><a href="https://www.jensenhughes.com/careers/responsible-use-of-ai-in-the-jensen-hughes-recruitment-process">here</a></strong> to review.</p> <p><br>The security of your personal data is important to us. Jensen Hughes has implemented reasonable physical, technical, and administrative security standards to protect personal data from loss, misuse, alteration, or destruction. We protect your personal data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, using security technologies and procedures, such as encryption and limited access. Only authorized individuals may access your personal data for the purpose for which it was collected, and these individuals receive training about the importance of protecting personal data.  Jensen Hughes is committed to compliance with all relevant data privacy laws in all areas where we do business, including, but not limited to, the GDPR and the CCPA.  Additionally, our service providers are contractually bound to maintain the confidentiality of personal data and may not use the information for any unauthorized purpose.</p> <p> </p> <p>*Policy on use of 3rd party recruiting agency for direct placements<br><br>Jensen Hughes will occasionally augment a recruiting search through agencies for certain positions when business conditions warrant. Jensen Hughes will not accept resumes, inquiries or proposals from recruiting agencies as an acceptable method to consider a candidate. 3rd party recruiting agencies must sign a standard Jensen Hughes agreement after being evaluated and accepted by a Human Resources or Talent Acquisition manager, or member of the talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and employees of Jensen Hughes are not authorized to accept resumes, engage in fee-based searches through recruiting firms or sign a search agreement. Please note this policy does not apply to “staffing firms” or firms that are involved with hiring temporary staff. Any recruiting agency interested in being considered may contact our recruiting team at jensenhughesrecruiting.com.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Engineer - iGaming & .NET
description: <p>CreateFuture is fast becoming the UK's most recognisable digital consultancy, with years of experience building digital products and services for major organisations whilst putting our people first. We have offices in the centre of Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester and London as well as remote employees located throughout the country.</p> <p>We are a team of creators - whether that's code, project plans, go to market strategies, culture initiatives, marketing campaigns, large language models or people policies. And together, with our clients, we create the future. This has seen us collaborate and partner across a multitude of industries and sectors, with the likes of PayPal, Adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert to name just a few.</p> <p>Our reputation as a partner determined to deliver high-quality, robust and thoughtful products has enabled us to scale to over 500 people in the last couple of years, and it is our amazing people - along with the safe, supportive and friendly culture we have built - that makes CreateFuture a great place to work. Don't just take our word for it though, we have been recognised by Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row - across a number of categories - and our employee exit rate is astonishingly low.</p> <p>Join us on our journey… Let's create something awesome, together, today.</p> <h2><strong>About this role</strong></h2> <p>The bar has moved. Five years ago a strong engineer was measured by what they could build and how well they could mentor others to build it. Today, with Claude Code and agents, we produce quality work at a speed that would have looked superhuman in 2022.</p> <p>What separates exceptional from good is no longer typing speed or local craftsmanship. It is the complete package: architecture, deep engineering foundations, communication, system thinking, and the judgement to direct both your own intelligence and AI toward outcomes that matter.</p> <p>Exceptional people at this level are not the best implementer in the room; they are the person whose specifications, decisions, and review judgement compound into systems that work in production and that others (and agents) can build on. They are a force multiplier, they hold a room at the highest levels, and clients treat them as the SME by default.</p> <p>This particular Principal seat sits on one of our largest iGaming engagements: sportsbook, casino and gaming platforms for a major client.
