title: Senior Performance Creative Strategist (gn) @ Female Health Consumer Startup, London
description: About DITTO DITTO is a science-led brand redefining menstrual health. As a fast-growing, VC-backed business, we're scaling a new standard in menstrual wellbeing — empowering anyone with cycle symptoms to understand, support and optimise their health every day, not just during their period. Developed by female scientists and powered by biotechnology, the Cycle Supplement is backed by over 100 clinical trials and validated in its own clinical trial. Beyond the capsule, DITTO is building a movement — combining credible science, thoughtful design, and inclusive storytelling to change how menstrual health is perceived and supported. As we grow, performance creative will be central to how we convert attention into action. About the role You will sit at the intersection of data and creativity — turning science into content that stops the scroll and drives sales. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You will define what makes a potential customer stop, engage, and convert — and then build the systems to do it at scale. You are not just briefing others. You are embedded in the work from the first concept through to post-production feedback and the next iteration. If you are equally energised by diving into data and dreaming up ideas, this role was built for you. Performance creative strategy Own creative strategy across Meta, TikTok and YouTube with clear KPIs across ROAS, conversion and scalable growth. Develop creative frameworks that harness DITTO's scientific credibility to build trust and drive purchase decisions. Analyse performance data to surface winning signals, identify trends and shape the next generation of assets. Build and own a structured testing roadmap — challenging creative hypotheses, running experiments and scaling what works. Track and report on hook rate, watch time, CTR, CVR, and ROAS — using data to drive every creative decision. Hands-on execution Lead end-to-end creative development: concepting, scripting, storyboarding, briefing, and post-production feedback. Develop high-performing short-form content with a relentless focus on hooks, retention and shareability. Identify repeatable formats and frameworks that can be systematically tested and scaled. Ensure all output balances performance intent with DITTO's brand identity — science-led, design-forward and inclusive. What we're looking for Extensive experience in performance marketing or creative strategy, ideally within D2C or the wellness space. Thinks in data and dreams in concepts — equally comfortable interpreting performance metrics as developing bold creative ideas. Deep understanding of Meta & TikTok — the nuances, the algorithms and what actually makes content perform. Can translate complex science into consumer messaging that earns trust and drives action. Proactive, highly organised and thrives in a fast-moving environment where you own your output. Cares about purpose-led brands, women's health and reshaping the conversation around menstrual wellbeing. Bonus points if you: Have experience in a high-growth startup environment. title: Data Scientist
description: Do you want to work out how you actually measure whether an AI system is doing a good job, and then make it better? We're looking for a sharp, analytical data scientist to own the evaluation and quality loop of our AutoQA product. You can be early in your career (recent graduates with strong LLM fundamentals are welcome), we have room and a clear path for you to grow. In a nutshell Join a fast-growing SaaS company in an international environment (steep learning curve guaranteed). Own a high-impact problem: making LLM-powered quality assurance measurably accurate at scale. Sit at the intersection of AI and CX, working directly with enterprise customers and their real-world QA rubrics. Grow into a Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer role. We invest in progression. Enjoy the perks: flexible hours, open holiday policy, an office in the heart of Amsterdam with hybrid flexibility, visa sponsorship, great gear, workations, and team events. About Kaizo At Kaizo, we build a performance development and quality platform for customer support teams. Our AutoQA product uses LLMs to review support conversations against each customer's own quality rubric, automatically and at scale. Behind it sits a microservices-based stream processing platform handling over 200 million events per day (Kafka, Kubernetes on Google Cloud, ElasticSearch, MongoDB, BigQuery), and an LLMOps stack built around LangSmith for experimentation, prompt management, and tracing. The hard part isn't calling an LLM. It's knowing, with evidence, how well the system performs on every customer's unique rubric, and having a reliable, repeatable way to improve it. That's where you come in. What you'll focus on Translate customer rubrics into AutoQA instructions. Work with real customer quality criteria and turn them into precise, testable instructions that LLMs can score reliably. Run experiments that move accuracy. Design and execute evaluation experiments on large, representative datasets using LangSmith and BigQuery, and track quality with our performance metrics. Build the datasets that make evaluation possible. Curate raw production data into golden datasets with balanced coverage, and generate synthetic data to cover the rare cases that matter most. QA is a discipline of rare occurrences: distributions are skewed, positives are scarce, and resourcefulness beats volume. Build LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to assess system quality internally and make evaluation repeatable. Make results actionable. Your experiments should end in a decision: change a prompt, adjust which tools the system uses, surface context the AI is missing, or flag where new capabilities are needed. You'll work with the AI team to ship those decisions. Evaluate across the full stack. Beyond scoring quality, you'll help validate retrieval (RAG/IR), tool calling, and speech pipelines (transcription and diarization quality). Join customer calls with the team to understand how QA leaders define quality, and feed what you learn back into the product. What you'll grow into Shaping how customers monitor quality themselves, catch drift, and keep their AutoQA setup improving over time. Smarter categorization and routing of conversations to power analytics and get the right tickets to the right evaluation. A solid understanding of how LLMs work and hands-on experience prompting them for accuracy (coursework, thesis, internships, or side projects all count; production experience is a bonus). Good applied statistics: experiment design, classifier evaluation, precision/recall trade-offs, and working with heavily imbalanced data. Strong Python skills and fluency with the standard data toolkit (Pandas, NumPy, Jupyter). SQL is a plus. An analytical, evidence-first mindset: you'd rather measure than assume. Product sense and empathy for end users. You'll be building for QA managers and support agents, not just for benchmarks. Excellent written and verbal communication. You'll present findings to the team and join customer conversations. 0 to 2 years of industry experience. Recent graduates with strong relevant work are encouraged to apply. A team player who's comfortable wearing multiple hats. We're an early-stage company and things move fast. Bonus points for: Experience with LangSmith or similar LLMOps/evaluation tooling Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Docker, or Kubernetes Speech/audio processing or ASR evaluation Fine-tuning or building synthetic datasets for LLMs Who you'll work with You'll join our AI team (two data scientists, an AI engineer, and an ML engineer) and collaborate closely with our data engineers, frontend engineers, designer, product manager, and CX teams. You'll have mentorship from day one and real ownership fast. What's in it for you? An office in the heart of Amsterdam, with the flexibility of hybrid working Visa sponsorship available for eligible candidates Great office gear: MacBook, tools, desk, chair, whatever you need Flexible working schedule and an open holiday policy Fun workations and team events A clear growth path into Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer roles Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Marketing Specialist
description: Senior Marketing Manager Location: Europe, Amsterdam preferred (hybrid or remote possible) Competitive salary Start date: as soon as possible Let’s be blunt: Kaizo doesn’t have a real marketing engine yet. We’ve had marketers before, but the company we are today is a different company. Over the past 18 months we’ve signed enterprise customers like Canva, Instacart, UiPath and Indeed. We’ve also rebuilt our product around a new reality: support teams now run on a mix of human agents and AI agents, and someone has to check the quality of both. Kaizo is the independent Agentic QA layer for that hybrid workforce. We work across helpdesks and Customer Service platforms, and we don’t build AI agents of our own, so we have no reason to mark our own homework. The problem is that the market doesn’t know this yet. We’re the customer service industry’s best-kept secret. The website architecture has just been rebuilt, but the content is outdated and doesn’t tell today’s story. We have strong enterprise customer stories that nobody has written up. Inbound is no longer enough. AI search has changed how buyers find vendors, so pipeline now has to come from outbound, partners, events and reputation. We’re going to the field and starting to attend international events. Sales doesn’t have all the decks, battlecards and collateral it needs. Outbound has started, and it needs content behind it. That’s where you come in. What this role really is We need a senior marketer who wants to build from scratch, and who sees a blank page as an opportunity, not a threat. You’ll be the one who: Brings the website to life so it reflects who we are today and gets found, by people and by AI search. Turns our enterprise wins into case studies and references that open new doors. Owns our review and analyst presence : a proper G2 strategy, competitor and comparison pages that convert, and support for analyst relations. Gives Sales and CS the content, one-pagers, battlecards and decks that win deals and renewals. Starts product marketing : positioning, launches, and clear messaging on AutoQA, Agentic QA, Insights and AI Coaching for customers and prospects. Builds our brand through thought leadership , PR and executive content on the future of CX quality in an AI-agent world. Owns our social channels and online reputation . Defines and runs a field marketing plan, so Kaizo shows up at the international events that matter to our enterprise ICP. Works with Sales on outbound and partner campaigns , including our helpdesk and Customer Service ecosystem partners. You won’t inherit a polished machine. You’ll be the architect, the builder and the driver of Kaizo’s marketing. The deal Location: Amsterdam preferred, flexible across Europe, hybrid or remote possible. Reporting: directly to Thibaud, Co-CEO, as part of the commercial leadership team. Real ownership, a fast feedback loop with Sales and Product, and a seat at the table where positioning gets decided. Why this matters Marketing is the missing piece in Kaizo’s growth engine. The product is there, the enterprise customers are there and the deals are there. Now the market needs to know it, and we need demand that scales. If you succeed, your fingerprints will be all over Kaizo’s next growth chapter: From a handful of enterprise logos → recognised category voice From inbound dependency → repeatable, multi-channel pipeline From scrappy content → thought leadership → If you’re looking for a comfortable role with a big team, a big budget and playbooks already written, this isn’t it. → If you want to build the marketing engine that takes Kaizo from great product to visible market leader, let’s talk. Who you are A content-first marketer. Storytelling is your edge, not growth hacks. You’ve marketed complex B2B SaaS, ideally to enterprise buyers with long sales cycles and buying committees. You’re hands-on: you write, edit, brief designers, manage freelancers and run campaigns yourself. You know what good marketing ops looks like, and you can get by with lean tools (we run on HubSpot). You understand how AI search is changing B2B discovery, and you know how to adapt SEO and content to it. Your English is native or near-native. Everything we publish has to read sharp and professional. Bonus: AI, QA and CX excite you, and acronyms don’t scare you. You’re keen to learn our product, our customers’ pain points and the trends on both the CX and QA sides. Bonus: experience with field events, G2 or analyst relations, or partner and ecosystem marketing. Equal opportunities At Kaizo, we believe diversity drives innovation. We’re committed to an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected, supported and able to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, disability, religion or beliefs. title: Agentic Platform Engineer (gn) @ AI Venture, Berlin
description: This is an Atlantic portfolio venture. About the Venture AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up. Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around. We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task. Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one. Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. Backed by Atlantic at pre-seed, we are growing the engineering team to bring the product into production, with people already waiting to use it. About the Role As one of our first platform engineers, you will build the foundations that every product feature depends on: the gateway and router, usage and billing systems, customer key management and the European infrastructure underneath. Much of that platform is still taking shape. Working directly with the founder, CTO and founding AI engineer, you will help turn early architectural decisions into systems that remain reliable as the product grows. You will take capabilities from design through to production, thinking through their APIs, failure modes, deployment, observability and ongoing operation. In a team this small, building and running the system belong together. You will also work alongside our founding AI engineer on evals, embeddings and open-weight model serving, bringing platform engineering depth to the ML side of the product. Agentic engineering is central to how we work. You will operate in an agentic way by default, using coding agents as a core part of how you design, build, test and ship software. You'll develop the harnesses and workflows that allow you to delegate and parallelise work effectively, increasing what a small engineering team can deliver. This requires strong coding fundamentals and the judgement to review, challenge and take responsibility for everything that reaches production. There is a lot to build and an ambitious timeline ahead. We work with intensity, move quickly from decisions to execution and value people who take initiative and see things through. What You’ll Work On Your first area of ownership will depend on your strengths and our priorities. From there, you will contribute across the platform as it develops. Gateway and routing: build a consistent API across model providers, with reliable streaming, fallbacks and safe handling of retries and provider errors. Agentic engineering workflows: build and refine the harnesses, tooling and workflows that enable coding agents to work effectively across the development lifecycle, from implementation and testing to debugging and deployment. Cost optimisation: develop caching, history compression and model selection, measuring savings while keeping estimated costs distinct from actual spend. Usage and billing: build accurate accounting for model calls, usage reports, plan entitlements and invoice reconciliation. Agent infrastructure and integrations: support tool calls, cost limits, human approvals and runs that can recover safely from interruptions, alongside connectors for services such as Gmail, Slack and calendars. Tenancy and secrets: maintain workspace isolation, secure authentication and encrypted customer key management. European infrastructure and model serving: build and operate our cloud infrastructure, including the GPU capacity used to serve open-weight models. Production reliability: make systems observable, migrations reversible and releases safe, with tests that protect data integrity and logs that keep customer content and secrets private. The platform will evolve quickly. You will need to move comfortably between improving what exists and learning enough about a new problem to build the next piece well. Our Stack Our backend is built in Python, with a TypeScript frontend in a shared monorepo. Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic and LiteLLM. Data and queues: Postgres with row-level security and pgvector, Redis and arq. Frontend: Next.js , React and TypeScript. Cloud and infrastructure: Scaleway, Terraform and Kubernetes for GPU workloads. Auth and secrets: Zitadel, Secret Manager and KMS. Observability and testing: OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Sentry, pytest and testcontainers, alongside frontend testing tools. You should be comfortable with the core backend technologies and ready to learn the rest as the work requires. About You You enjoy the craft of engineering and the responsibility of seeing your work used in production. Faced with an unclear problem, you can identify what matters, make sensible trade-offs and carry a solution through to release without someone planning every step. You naturally look for ways to multiply your output through agentic workflows, rather than approaching every engineering task as something to execute manually. We are looking for: Experience building and operating production systems: several years of backend engineering with real users, typically three to six, and meaningful ownership of what you shipped. Strong Python fundamentals: confidence with async code, typing and testing. TypeScript experience is a plus. Agentic engineering as a default way of working: you have hands-on experience using coding agents as a core part of your engineering workflow. You know how to break down problems, delegate and parallelise tasks, provide the right context and build effective agentic workflows. Crucially, you have the technical depth to review, debug and take ownership of the resulting code. Platform engineering depth: practical experience with Postgres, Redis, queues, networking and Terraform. Kubernetes experience is useful, particularly for our GPU infrastructure. Sound engineering judgement: clear APIs, tenant isolation, data integrity, partial failure and safe rollouts. You can explain both your decisions and what you chose to leave out. A working understanding of ML systems: familiarity with LLMs, embeddings, evals, model serving and fine-tuning. Experience with LLM APIs, streaming and token costs is a strong plus. A disciplined approach to measurement: you benchmark changes, question assumptions and use evidence to understand whether an improvement holds up. Initiative and drive: you enjoy getting deep into a problem, finding a way forward and putting in the work to make it happen. This is an experienced individual-contributor role, with ownership of the capabilities you build and close collaboration across the founding team. Fluent English is required; German is a plus. Why Join At this stage, platform engineering decisions have a direct influence on the product and how quickly the team can build it. You will work close to the founder and CTO, with room to shape the systems you own and see the results of your work first-hand. The challenge spans AI infrastructure, distributed systems, security and cost efficiency. You will build across those boundaries, take real responsibility early and receive a meaningful equity package in the company you help develop. We are competing with teams that have more people, more funding and an earlier start. Our approach depends on technical depth, focused decisions and the drive to turn them into working software. We believe agentic engineering can fundamentally change what a small, technically strong team is capable of building, and we're looking for people who want to push that approach forward. For someone who enjoys a demanding build, close collaboration and visible impact, there is a lot to get involved in. This is a full-time role, based in our Berlin office five days a week, starting as soon as possible. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior C/C++ Low Latency Engineer
description: Your job This role is crucial for our organization. Our Technology team is small and therefore you get a lot of responsibilities and freedom! You are triggered by being faster than the competitors and you like to focus on quality. As you can imagine in a small team, there is a flat hierarchy and everybody is really hands-on to be the best in what we do! We are looking for senior C/C++ Engineers with extensive knowledge and experience in building, testing, monitoring and maintaining large scale parallel applications and databases. As a C/C++ Engineer at Mathrix in the low latency environment, your focus will be on the code which facilitates the automated trades on various exchanges worldwide. Our companies’ performance is highly dependent on the performance of our data processing pipelines. You will regularly need to appeal to all aspects of your developers’ skillset to find new and innovative ways to optimize your code. Some examples of the ‘everyday’ challenges you would encounter are and have to implement: low-latency networking code for fast communication with exchanges context-switch-free code design and implement custom data storage structures with minimalistic footprint data pipelines using a streaming paradigm complex trading logic for the decision engine with the lowest possible compute time reimplement existing code using advanced features of the CPU (SIMD) To accommodate the growth of the company, we spend increasing efforts on the maintainability and manageability of our large, highly optimized and multithreaded codebases while preserving its main purpose (low latency). You will have to maneuver yourself between these worlds to get the best results. In addition to writing code, the Technology team builds and maintains the global (hardware) infrastructure to facilitate the trading. In your job you will be regularly involved in all aspects of the pipeline and different tech stacks; from hardware compositions, network design to data logging pipelines for the traders and quants. Who are you Due to the growth of our organization, we are looking for more than one C/C++ Engineer. As the new team member, you bring the following skillset: extensive and thorough knowledge of C and C++ in Linux an understanding of – and the ability to verify - the assembly the compiler will produce from the code you write understanding what (GNU/Linux) system calls you invoke will do and cost knowledge of x64 hardware and how to use it efficiently understanding what storage structures to select or implement given their use (time complexity) ability to work with debuggers and profilers operative coding (git, documentation) ability to absorb from and provide knowledge to the team pro-active, a self-starter, honest, flexible and stress resistant In addition to the above, having a background in one of the specializations below are nice to have: experience with network engineering; either (low latency) networking hardware deployment or networking protocol implementations; experience with Big Data engineering and knowledge of Big Data best practices and implementations best suited for different use cases. What we offer Excellent remuneration (including discretionary bonus) Fun and inspiring work environment Experienced and knowledgeable colleagues 25 vacation days Allowance for commuting expenses Additional benefits: yearly office trip(s), fitness allowance, Friday afternoon drinks, weekly massages, excellent free lunch Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: What’s in it for you (to start with): Gross monthly salary ranging from € 4.000 to € 5.700 based on a 40-hour work week. This salary range reflects our career framework. And many more benefits that you can read about at the bottom of the job description! Your challenges: The Creatives team works on and is responsible for our Image Editor and related image-processing features. You will be working on the backend and sometimes a little bit on the frontend of a complex distributed web application. Our tool provides several different services, written in Haskell, Python, and Rust. In this position, you will be responsible for the architecture, development, and maintenance of new and old image-related features in our application. An important aspect of our work is scaling our services to the next level, so we can handle another order of magnitude increase in throughput while keeping our app fast and responsive. To give you a sense of scale: a couple hundred millions of images are inspected, transformed and created by our services every day. Plan and shape the future of the Creatives suite of features with our tight-knit team Design, develop, and test new product features Collaborate with and review PRs of other team members Improve the reliability and robustness of our application Work on scalability and performance improvements Collaborate with our other product and platform teams to integrate image-manipulating features with other parts of our tool. Our Stack includes: Haskell, Python, Rust, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, React, Ansible, Terraform, Prometheus. And we run all of our infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform. Who are you? You have good programming skills in Haskell (or a similar typed functional language) You are familiar with other programming languages and polyglot programming: we regularly need to make modifications in services written in other languages (especially Python and Rust) as well You have approximately 4-5 years of professional software engineering experience You have experience in tuning and scaling a big application You have experience with web development, web technologies, and APIs Familiarity with SQL and relational databases, preferably Postgres Good working knowledge of Linux, git, and the command line. Nice to have: Knowledge of Haskell libraries like warp, conduit, async, servant, aeson, effectful Knowledge of Rust and its ecosystem Prior experience in image processing Some knowledge of TypeScript/React, which we use in our WYSIWYG Image Editor A passion to provide value to customers and figuring out the 'question behind the question'. Practical requirements: EU citizenship or a valid work permit for the Netherlands; you are preferably already living in the Netherlands Available for at least 32 hours a week, with two days spent at the Utrecht office. Important note: we understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow. The team: You will join the Creatives team, consisting of five more Backend engineers, two Frontend engineers, a Product Manager, and a UI/UX designer. Who are we? Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht and is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals from more than 40+ nationalities. Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, helping, taking ownership, and creating an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read. Why Channable? At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other. Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/ And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like. More benefits: Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth. Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets. Stock Appreciation Rights: senior employees can financially profit from Channable’s success. 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave! Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands! Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources. Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads. Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more! Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. How can you introduce yourself to us? Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible! Interview steps: If it's a match, Ioana (Tech Talent Acquisition Partner) will get in touch with you for an introductory call (25 minutes) Then you are going to have a tech interview with the team members (1h) For senior candidates, we schedule a system design as well (1h) After that, we will schedule a culture and role fit interview with the Creative Team Lead and one more colleague (1h) When we don’t have enough information, we might ask you to work on a short assignment before your tech interview. Please note that after the interviews and before the offer stage, we’ll conduct reference checks. Important note: We know that in the current AI era, it's tempting to use technology to polish your interview performance. While we value your ambition, please do not use AI assistance during the first screening, so we can get to know the real person behind the resume. Note: Contact from job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 to Make-A-Wish. title: ML Platform Engineer
description: About us Bleu Robotics is an AI company developing universal AI software for the deployment of advanced robots , humanoids, mobile manipulators, and industrial arms, in real factories. The convergence of humanoid robotics and modern AI is one of the most significant technical opportunities of the decade, and most of the work today still happens in research settings. We are building the software layer required to bring it into operational use. We have a strong ambition to become the next Microsoft to run on every industrial humanoid. We have closed our pre-seed round with Top-tier fund to deploy our robot in Tier 1 manufacturing facilities. We are looking for deeply passionate scientists who can help us push the frontier and build a major lab in physical AI. Our vision To enable a robot to learn a new industrial task from a few demonstrations and operate autonomously, with under one hour between the start of the demonstration and the start of deployment. This objective shapes our roadmap and every technical decision we make. THE ROLE We are hiring an ML Platform Engineer to put our robot learning stack in the cloud and own the full stack. The platform will let customers run our learning pipelines on their own data as a hosted service; its exact scope will evolve with the product. You will be the first engineer at Bleu Robotics with cloud expertise. The scope covers infrastructure, training and inference services, the web front end, security, and cost. The choice of cloud provider and web framework is open; you will make it with the team. The role is based in Paris and is on-site. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: About the Role We’re looking for a top-tier Forward Deployed Engineer to join Linkup and work hand-in-hand with our founders, customers, and partners. You'll be part of the founding FDE team at Linkup Your mission: help leading AI companies, developers, and enterprises integrate Linkup’s AI-ready search APIs into their products - and shape how the next generation of AI agents connects to the web. This is a highly cross-functional role. You’ll operate at the intersection of engineering, GTM, and customer success , turning technical integrations into insights that drive our product roadmap, marketing narratives, and outbound strategy. You’ll be the connective bridge between what customers build with Linkup and how we tell that story to the world. What You’ll Do Work directly with customers and partners to design, prototype, and deploy integrations of Linkup’s APIs into real-world agentic systems. Participate in pre-sales efforts - technical discovery, proof-of-concept design, demo environments. Collaborate cross-functionally with backend, ML, and product teams to ensure performance and reliability at scale. Partner with the GTM Engineer and DevRel team to turn customer learnings into automation, tutorials, and playbooks. Identify and implement technical integrations with our other partners in the value chain (workflow orchestration, AI frameworks, etc.) Translate complex technical concepts into clear explanations for both developers and business audiences. Why This Role Matters Every integration you build helps define how AI systems connect to live, trusted information . You’ll operate on the frontier between customers and product - bringing the voice of the field into everything we build and say. Your work will inform: The stories we tell in marketing. The use cases we automate in our GTM systems. The features we prioritize in our roadmap. If you love blending engineering with impact - building things users actually depend on: this role is for you. You’re a Great Fit If You 2+ years in technical support engineering , software engineering , or solutions engineering , with direct application development experience. Strong API integration skills - able to design and debug REST/JSON payloads, manage auth flows, and optimize latency. Understand web infrastructure, distributed systems, or retrieval pipelines. Are comfortable debugging integrations and solving ambiguous technical challenges in customer environments. Communicate clearly and empathetically with both technical and business audiences. Are curious about AI infrastructure, retrieval, and the emerging agentic ecosystem. Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment. Example Projects Help a partner integrate Linkup’s /search endpoint into their multi-agent workflow. Build a proof-of-concept combining a customer’s private data with Linkup’s real-time web results. Collaborate with the backend team to improve SDK telemetry and enterprise deployment reliability. Work with the GTM team to turn successful integrations into published use cases and reference architectures. Identify recurring customer needs that can become productized templates or automation. About Linkup Our Vision We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web . These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information. AI agents need web search . To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off. Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs . Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space. Web 2.0 is sunsetting . The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home. Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up . We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone. Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup. Our Mission Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve. Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs. Our Culture Our culture is built on the following values: Mission . We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents. Speed . We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well. Ownership . We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion. Teamwork . Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset. Humility . We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences. We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture. Our Team We are small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents. A bit more about our 3 co-founders: Philippe Mizrahi - Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen , an open source search engine. Denis Charrier - Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience. Boris Toledano - Led robotics at Carrefour, after 3y at McKinsey & Co working on public affairs and digital transformation. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Robot Transporter (C Driver)
description: We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from diverse backgrounds, including consumer tech, finance and media, and companies like Dyson, Shopify, Meta and Tesla. From day one, you'll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural, alongside other renowned investors. Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with a fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house, hardware and software. Our work involves building robots in our workshop and houses on real construction sites, so we're onsite five days a week. Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company . You might enjoy our YouTube Channel , Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage , or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like . About the role You’ll transport robots that build houses. You’ll load them at our Amsterdam workshop, get them onto construction sites, and bring them back for repairs before their next job. When a team needs a replacement robot to keep building, you’re the person who gets it there. We’re hiring our first Robot Transporter. We already have 150+ robots in the field and we’re expanding from the Netherlands into the UK and US. You’ll be the first person dedicated to getting our robots, equipment and materials where they need to be, helping more teams build more homes. Your day could take you from the workshop to several active construction sites, delivering robots, collecting systems for repair and getting equipment to the next crew. You’ll work out the order of stops, what fits in each vehicle, and how to load and secure it safely. You’ll drive a C-licence box truck or B-licence van, work closely with our deployment team, and get to know the robots and the people building with them. This is practical, physical work with room to take charge. You’ll start by planning alongside the deployment team, then take ownership of routes and transport requests as you learn the sites and loads. Plans change, sites get muddy, and teams depend on you. You’ll see the houses going up and know you helped get them built. What you'll do Drive. Operate our leased C-licence box truck and our B-licence van across the Netherlands, usually two or more movements a day. When a move needs a flatbed with forklift loading, you arrange it. Plan the day’s transport. Work with the deployment team on the day’s plan: what goes in which vehicle, and the order of drop-offs and pick-ups across sites, our Groningen hub and our Amsterdam locations. Over time, more of this becomes yours to own. Load and secure. Robots, hoisting cages, scaffolding, inventory kits, equipment. You know weight limits, lashing and what it takes to get a 400+ kg system in and out of a vehicle safely. Run deployment logistics. Systems, kits and operational tools out to a new site before the team arrives, back to the workshop when a build wraps, and everything in between. Keep the fleet where it's useful. Move idle systems from one site to another that needs them, and bring systems back for repair so that a broken robot swapped today is a wall going up tomorrow. Own the vehicles. Servicing, inspections, cleaning, fuel, damage reporting and fines. Vehicles are always road-ready. Log every move. Each transport is recorded in our fleet tooling so deployment managers see when their request is planned and the company always knows where every system and kit is. Improve the process. Feed what you see on the road back to the inventory team (packing standards), deployment team (equipment ratios per site) and the team building our transport tooling. Help with inventory in downtime. When there's nothing to move, you work with the inventory team to prepare kits, organise stock and check returned equipment back in. What we're looking for A valid C licence with Code 95 and a driver card (bestuurderskaart) (required). Professional driving and load securing experience (required). Trucks, ideally box trucks with tail lift, with real responsibility for what was in the back: lashing, weight distribution, awkward loads. Equipment rental, construction logistics, removals or last-mile delivery are all good backgrounds. Comfortable with physical work. Loading heavy systems with the right equipment, early starts, all weather, construction site conditions. You don’t need a robotics or construction background, but you should want to know how the systems you’re moving work. Organised in chaos. You can hold a day with five drop-offs in your head, re-sequence it when a site calls, and still log everything at the end. Reliable and careful. A damaged robot costs a build day. You check straps twice and say no to an overloaded vehicle. Clear communication. You deal with deployment managers, site crews and the workshop every day, in person and on Slack. You raise problems early. Based in the Netherlands. Able to work from Amsterdam and drive to sites nationwide. We can't support relocation or visa sponsorship for this role. English required; Dutch is a plus. Nice to have Forklift certificate (heftruckcertificaat) VCA safety certificate (we can arrange it) Basic mechanical sense: you notice when something on a vehicle or a system doesn't look right Experience planning for more than one driver or vehicle Comfortable with simple apps and forms for logging work Why Monumental? Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. Here, your work has the potential to impact not just the company but the future of how we build. If you're driven by innovation, eager to tackle complex challenges, and ready to make a tangible difference, we want to hear from you. For open applications (where you don't see an exact role match), please reach out to us at: Unfortunately we do not currently support internships. If you don't meet all the qualifications here but are excited about Monumental and feel you'd still be able to help us tackle complex challenges, do get in touch. title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Discovery
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon, or London (Hybrid)</strong></h3> <div class="container"> <div id="model-response-message-contentr_ccb59069932b9a6f" class="markdown markdown-main-panel md-content enable-luminous-fast-follows enable-updated-hr-color stronger tutor-markdown-rendering"> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>We build the products that enable the next era of the Internet: making domains <strong>Readable</strong>, <strong>Discoverable</strong>, and <strong>Callable</strong> for autonomous AI agents.</p> <p>Here at Cloudflare, agentic discovery is a core part of our vision for the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/the-agentic-internet/">Agentic Internet</a>. As AI agents change how humans and machines find, evaluate, and act on information, businesses need tools to control how they are represented and reached. We build capabilities that enable website owners to prepare their sites for agent interaction, test and observe how agents read their content, establish open interaction standards (like WebMCP and MCP), and create entirely new channels to reach agentic audiences.</p> <p>We are a cross functional group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to serve as a technical anchor and become a subject matter expert on our Agentic Discovery team. In this role, you will define the architecture, core protocols, and multi-team standards powering the next generation of agent-web interactions.</p> <p>As a senior technical leader, you will shape product roadmaps, mentor engineers across Cloudflare, and write technical specifications that drive execution across multiple teams. You will drive engineering excellence across edge infrastructure, data pipelines, protocol layers, and developer tooling, ensuring systems are resilient and complexity is reduced for your peers.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Architect and ship high-throughput, resilient production services </strong>that make web properties Readable (structured content transformation), Discoverable (indexing and AEO), and Callable (WebMCP, tool-calling APIs, Generative UI) for autonomous agents.</li> <li><strong>Define emerging agent protocols and integrations</strong> (MCP, MCP Apps, UCP, MPP, WebMCP). stakeholders</strong> to translate customer needs into technical requirements, clarify KPIs, and shape engineering roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>Drive improvements in system health and observability. </strong>Lead complex incident responses, conduct post-incident retrospectives, and rearchitect systems to eliminate failure modes and minimize customer-escalation issues.</li> <li><strong>Elevate the engineering process across Cloudflare</strong> through code reviews, technical mentorship, architectural governance, and candidate evaluation for engineering hiring.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, specifications and leading cross-functional technical initiatives to completion.</li> <li>Deep understanding of HTTP, APIs, proxies, caching, web security, and performance bottlenecks spanning multi-service architectures.</li> <li>Hands-on experience and deep conceptual understanding of AI agents, tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or agent harnesses.</li> <li>Ability to partner with product managers and customers to navigate ambiguous problem spaces and iteratively deliver large-scale architecture.</li> <li>Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers, contributing to hiring, and driving improvements to engineering processes and incident response workflows.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Fluency in async Rust or TypeScript/JavaScript edge runtimes (e.g., Cloudflare Workers) at scale.</li> <li>Active contributions to or leadership in open-source agent frameworks, protocols (e.g., MCP), web standards bodies, browser engines, or network proxies.</li> <li>Track record of resolving complex, multi-team production incidents and driving post-mortem recommendations to completion.</li> <li>Background in search engines, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), web crawling at scale, or RAG platform engineering.</li> <li>Expertise in cryptographic protocols (public-key encryption, digital signatures) or privacy-preserving web architectures.</li> </ul> </div> title: ML Intern: Optimization Quality & Monitoring
description: Our common vision Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Our AI-powered attribution creates real transparency, showing how digital advertising investments perform across channels. On that foundation, we optimize budgets so our customers can sustainably grow their bottom line. We support leading European brands across e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance & energy, and many other industries in making their marketing smarter, more efficient, and more impactful. About the role Nexoya runs fully automated, AI-driven budget optimizations and simulations for enterprise marketing portfolios across many ad channels. Every result that reaches a customer must be correct, explainable and on time. As our ML Intern, you make sure it is: you monitor pipeline health, check the quality of predictions, optimizations and simulations, investigate anomalies and turn recurring manual checks into reliable tooling. You work closely with our ML engineers and Customer Success, and you see directly how your work shapes our customers' budget decisions. Your responsibilities Monitor the automation and assure result quality Monitor the automated prediction, optimization and simulation pipelines across customer portfolios and track run health, completeness and timeliness. Verify that predictions, optimization proposals and simulation results meet our quality standards before they reach customers: budget shifts, expected KPI changes, channel constraints and funnel-level effects. Investigate failed or unexpected runs, identify the root cause (data, configuration or model) and resolve it or escalate it with a clear diagnosis. Assure the quality of results over time Define and maintain plausibility checks for optimization and simulation results, for example for budget planning, seasonal shifts or new channel tests. Make sure results are consistent and explainable, so that customers and account managers can trust them without manual checks. Compare optimized and simulated outcomes with realized performance, document deviations and feed the findings back to the ML team. Safeguard data and model quality Monitor input data for gaps, anomalies and tracking changes that affect optimization quality. Track model fit and prediction accuracy per portfolio and flag degradation early. Maintain portfolio configurations such as funnel steps, constraints and target definitions together with the responsible teams. Automate the operational workflow Replace manual checks with Python scripts, validation rules and alerts. Build and maintain dashboards that show run status, data health and model performance across portfolios. Write runbooks so that operational knowledge is shared, not held by one person. The impact you will have Customers receive optimization proposals and simulations that are correct and delivered on time. Issues are caught before customers see them, not after. The time the ML team spends on operational work goes down measurably, because recurring steps are automated. Customer Success can trust automated optimization and simulation results without checking them by hand. Your experience and skills Recently completed Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field. Solid Python skills, including pandas and NumPy, and comfort working with SQL. Good understanding of statistics and basic machine learning concepts such as regression, model evaluation and overfitting. A careful, structured way of working: you check results before you share them and you document what you do. Ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical colleagues. Fluent English, spoken and written, is a must. Bonus points Experience with optimization methods, for example constrained or non-convex optimization. Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling, attribution or digital advertising metrics. Experience with data pipelines, scheduled jobs or monitoring tools. Experience with Git, Docker and cloud environments. Fluent in German or Italian. Your future work life Purpose: Your work directly influences how enterprise marketers allocate their budgets. Responsibility: You own the quality of a defined part of our automation from day one, with a personal development roadmap and regular feedback. Learning: You work alongside experienced ML and data engineers on production systems, not on side projects. Culture: A transparent company culture at eye level, where every person is valued and supported. Strategy: You take part in shaping company strategy and culture during our quarterly Strategy Days. Events: Regular team events, on-site and off-site. title: GTM Engineer (m/w/d - German-Speaking)
description: Tech gestalten. Automatisieren. Go-to-Market skalieren. Du baust gern Systeme, die funktionieren, und willst nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern sehen, was deine Arbeit bewirkt? Als GTM Engineer bei LNKSTR bist du der technische Motor hinter unserer AI-gestützten Delivery. Du entwickelst Automatisierungen, baust AI-Agents und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen messbarer Output wird. Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit dem Leadership-Team. Deine Aufgaben Automatisierungen bauen: Du entwickelst Workflows mit n8n, Make oder eigenem Code, die Research, Lead-Aufbereitung, Kampagnen-Setup und Reporting skalierbar machen. AI-Agents entwickeln: Du konzipierst LLM-basierte Agents und Pipelines für Recherche, Personalisierung und Account Management, testest sie und bringst sie in den Betrieb. Tool-Stack verantworten: Du analysierst bestehende Tools und Schnittstellen (CRM, Datenanbieter, Outreach-Infrastruktur), integrierst sie und baust Überflüssiges ab. Schnittstelle zum Account Management: Du verstehst die Anforderungen aus dem Tagesgeschäft und übersetzt sie in technische Lösungen. Rapid Prototyping: Du testest neue Tools und APIs, MCPs, baust MVPs und Proof-of-Concepts und entscheidest mit, was in den Standard übernommen wird. Dokumentation: Du dokumentierst deine Lösungen so, dass das Team sie ohne dich nutzen und warten kann. Dein Profil Technisches Verständnis: APIs, Datenflüsse und Logik sind dein Werkzeug. Du arbeitest sicher mit Low- und No-Code-Tools und schreibst bei Bedarf eigenen Code, etwa in Python oder JavaScript. Erfahrung mit Automatisierung und AI: Du hast bereits Prozesse automatisiert und LLM-basierte Workflows oder Agents gebaut und betrieben. GTM-Verständnis: Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, im Outbound oder in einer Agentur ist ein Plus. Strukturiert und lösungsorientiert: Du denkst in Abläufen, erkennst Engpässe und löst sie pragmatisch. Eigenständigkeit: Du priorisierst selbst, lieferst schnell und stehst für deine Lösungen ein. Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch fließend, Englisch sicher. AI bei LNKSTR Wir bauen unsere Delivery konsequent mit AI. Im Tagesgeschäft laufen LLM-Pipelines, AI-Agents für Recherche und Personalisierung sowie n8n-Workflows. Wir testen lokale LLMs und eigene Agents. Als GTM Engineer bestimmst du maßgeblich, wie dieser Stack weiterwächst. Was wir bieten Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Leadership-Team Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau unseres AI-Stacks Flexibilität und Remote-Work (Office in Berlin als Anker) Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft Persönliche Weiterentwicklung mit Schulungen und Trainings Pets welcome Team-Events und Reisen Über uns LNKSTR ist eine LinkedIn Outbound Agency für B2B-Unternehmen. Unsere Mission: Sales-Exzellenz durch smarte Automatisierung, echte Relevanz und menschliche Kommunikation. Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit Roland Berger, PwC, Jung von Matt, Logfret, Seifert Logistics, port-neo, Green Mining, dbeyond ai+ und Parcel Perform. Wir haben unseren Hauptsitz in Berlin und entwickeln uns aktiv von einer Agentur zur AI-getriebenen GTM-Plattform. So bewirbst du dich Klingt nach dem richtigen Setup? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich. Unser Prozess ist bewusst schlank: 15-Minuten-Erstgespräch Technischer Take-Home Case Interview vor Ort in Berlin Reference Check Angebot Bewirb dich direkt über dieses Formular mit Lebenslauf, Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestem Starttermin. Optional freuen wir uns über Beispiele deiner Arbeit, etwa Workflows, Projekte oder ein GitHub-Profil. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Customer Engineer, Sweden
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h4>Available Locations - Sweden</h4> <p><strong>About Us</strong></p> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. </p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Senior Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal levelling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="

title: Customer Engineering Specialist - Network Services
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Locations:  Lisbon</strong></p> <h4>Customer Engineering Specialist - Network Services</h4> <h4>About Us</h4> <h4>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet.
