We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</h4> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>As a CE Specialist you will be the trusted technical advisor for customers adopting Cloudflare's network services. These include Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare Network Firewall and Cloudflare Network Interconnect (CNI), alongside Cloudflare One. You will lead Magic Transit and Cloudflare WAN POCs from design through to production cutover. You will also help customers modernize how they protect, connect and secure their networks and sites.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Act as a trusted advisor, helping customers choose the right Cloudflare network and security solution for their business needs.</li> <li>Lead qualified prospects through Solution Design and POC.</li> <ul> <li><strong>Magic Transit:</strong> plan and run POCs covering BGP onboarding, prefix advertisement, GRE/IPsec tunnels or CNI, and DDoS validation.</li> <li><strong>Cloudflare WAN:</strong> plan and run POCs covering site and branch connectivity (IPsec/GRE tunnels, CNI, Cloudflare One Appliance), data center and cloud-to-site connectivity, routing design, and coexistence with or migration from existing SD-WAN or MPLS.</li> </ul> <li>Understand the customer's network topology, IP addressing, routing policy and security requirements. Then design an architecture that fits, including hybrid environments with Azure, AWS and GCP.</li> <li>Run technical discovery, demos and workshops as part of the pre-sales cycle. Support RFP/RFI responses and technical validation.</li> <li>Explain the benefits of Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN and Cloudflare One compared with alternative approaches. These include traditional DDoS scrubbing services, appliance-based protection, SD-WAN solutions, next-generation firewalls and MPLS or traditional WAN.</li> <li>Work with GTM partners to consistently achieve pipeline and revenue goals.</li> <li>Present network and security transformation messages to senior technical leaders and executives.</li> <li>Capture product and feature gaps and feed them back to Product and Engineering.</li> </ul> <h2>Core requirements</h2> <ul> <li><strong>GTM experience:</strong> 5+ years in Customer Engineering, Pre-sales, Solutions or Systems Engineering, or Technical Sales. You should have experience guiding customers through discovery, solution design, POC and handover to delivery or support.</li> <li><strong>BGP and routing:</strong> Strong working knowledge of BGP (eBGP, route advertisement and filtering, AS paths, communities, anycast, RPKI and route hygiene). You should also be comfortable with static and dynamic routing, subnetting, route-based policy and split tunnels.</li> <li><strong>TCP/IP:</strong> Deep understanding of the TCP/IP protocol stack and packet-level troubleshooting (for example with tcpdump and Wireshark). This includes MTU/MSS, tunneling (GRE, IPsec), NAT and asymmetric routing.</li> <li><strong>DDoS protection:</strong> Understanding of L3/L4/L7 DDoS attack types and mitigation approaches (for example volumetric floods, SYN floods, amplification and reflection attacks). You should also understand how on-demand and always-on protection differ.</li> <li><strong>SD-WAN and WAN architecture:</strong> Familiarity with SD-WAN architectures and routing protocols (BGP and OSPF overlays), underlay and overlay design, local internet breakout, branch connectivity, and migration from MPLS or legacy WAN.</li> <li>Fluent in English, written and spoken. Additional languages are a plus.</li> <li>Ability to manage a project, work to deadlines and prioritize between competing goals.</li> <li>Curiosity and learning agility. Cloudflare sits at the cutting edge of internet technology, so you are expected to keep up with industry trends as well as our own products.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable skills</h2> <p><strong>Network and security fundamentals</strong></p> <ul> <li>DNS: Good knowledge of DNS, including authoritative and recursive resolution, DNSSEC, DNS over HTTPS/TLS, DNS-based attacks (such as tunneling and cache poisoning) and DNS filtering.</li> <li>Detailed understanding of the path from user to application, including hybrid and multi-cloud architectures (Azure, AWS, GCP).</li> <li>Knowledge of end-user and application security risks. These include DDoS, malware, phishing, viruses, ransomware.</li> <li>VPN and remote access challenges, and moving to Zero Trust access.</li> <li>SIEM and log analytics platforms. You should also be comfortable with network telemetry such as NetFlow and sFlow.</li> <li>Experience and knowledge with network and security vendors, including Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, and Check Point (covering architecture, capabilities, configuration, and troubleshooting).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Market and competitive knowledge</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understanding of the market for CDN providers, Web Application Firewalls, remote access solutions, next-generation firewalls, CASB, DDoS mitigation, SD-WAN and secure gateway solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cloudflare One and Zero Trust</strong></p> <ul> <li>SASE concepts and Zero Trust networking architectures.</li> <li>Knowledge of Cloudflare Zero Trust solutions: Access, Gateway, Browser Isolation, and WARP client deployment.</li> <li>Secure Web Gateway, CASB and DLP.</li> <li>IdP and authentication (SAML, OTP), plus SaaS application integration and tenant controls.</li> <li>Client OS fundamentals and software distribution.</li> </ul> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €59,000 - €92,000.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="2"><strong data-path-to-node="2" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="3"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="3,0,0">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"> </h3> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0"> </p> <p data-path-to-node="3,0,0"> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Data Scientist

AI.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner and align with business leaders, stakeholders, product managers and internal teams to understand the business and product challenges and <li>Ability to define and spot macro and micro levels trends with statistical significance on a regular basis and understand key drivers driving those trends.</li> <li>Active role in hiring, growing, and mentoring the data scientist team in Bengaluru.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelors or M.S in Computer Science, Statistics, teams). fast-growing SaaS business based company is preferred.</li> <li>Strong experience working with business functions such as Finance, Sales, and Marketing to build models and drive impactful business outcomes (eg: customer and revenue growth)</li> <li>Strong experience in scientific computing using Python</li> <li>Experience with Spark, SQL, Tableau, Google Analytics, BigQuery (or any other Big data/Cloud equivalent) etc.</li> <li>Experience working with and processing structured, unstructured, and semi-structured data. </li> <li>Strong cross-functional collaboration experience with data engineering and data analysts teams within the function.</li> <li>Proven track record of applying data insights and machine learning in order to address business needs and drive revenue.</li> <li>Proficiency in large language models and the frameworks (Langchain, Langgraph, etc.) necessary for implementing GenAI applications, such as AI Agents, chatbots and related use cases.</li> <li>Strong communication and presentation skills catered to different audiences within the company.</li> <li>Capable of working closely with business, engineering, and product teams to ensure data initiatives are aligned with business needs.</li> <li>Experience in hiring data scientists and establishing team best practices is preferred.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: (Senior) Product Manager - Customer Taxation (m/f/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="sc-gEkIjz cjtSrT MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body1 sc-hoLEA">Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the <strong>FinTech</strong> connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers <strong>better interest rates</strong> and banks a <strong>diversified form of refinancing</strong>. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.</p> <p class="sc-gEkIjz cjtSrT MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body1 sc-hoLEA">Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from <strong>more than one million investors</strong> which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.</p></div><p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong>Team</strong></span></p> <p>Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t.  We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require. </p> <p>Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Our goal is for customers to trust that their tax is right, find it easy to manage, use the tax allowances they are entitled to, and have peace of mind.</p> <p><br><strong>Your Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will own a regulated domain that customers depend on every tax year. Working with an experienced Engineering Lead, you will become the go-to expert for customer taxation at Raisin.</li> <li>Own customer taxation end to end: Define the vision and roadmap together with Product and Engineering leadership. Take each topic from discovery to delivery to measured impact. Decide what we build first, and keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, risks and trade-offs.</li> <li>Keep tax accurate and reliable: Agree with Legal, Compliance and country managers on what correct looks like. Work with Engineering so calculation, documents and reporting stay stable and easy to extend.</li> <li>Grow Raisin’s tax proposition: Shape how tax works when Raisin enters new markets, launches tax-advantaged products or brings on new partners. Find where we can take tax work off customers’ hands, so they don’t have to declare and settle it themselves.</li> <li>Turn complex rules into simple experiences: Translate the  tax rules behind each launch into clear requirements with the edge cases covered. Design the customer experience and see the work through to delivery.</li> <li>Hit the deadlines that cannot move: Make sure annual tax documents and statutory reports go out correct and on time, working with Product Operations. Plan backwards from fixed dates and monitor data quality.</li> <li>Catch errors before they reach customers, and escalate early when a date is at risk.</li> <li>Make tax effortless for customers: Keep self-service for tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates intuitive, so customers get them right the first time. Give Customer Service the tools to answer tax questions fast, especially around tax season.</li> <li>Shape the team culture: Give and ask for feedback openly, share wins with the team, and treat mistakes as a reason to fix the process.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Profile</strong></p> <p><em>Must haves:</em></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a technical product such as a back-end, platform or data-heavy service.</li> <li>Experience leading a cross-functional product team and getting engineers and stakeholders behind shared priorities.</li> <li>Experience launching new products or taking products into new markets, with the precision to get every edge case right, because one wrong tax rule can affect thousands of customers.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and the habit of checking and reconciling numbers yourself.</li> <li>Curiosity about tax and a drive to make it feel easy for customers, even when the rules behind it are not.</li> <li>The ability to learn fast, take feedback well and change course when new facts come in.</li> <li>Energy, a strong work ethic and a hands-on attitude to detailed work.</li> <li>Clear, structured written English, and the confidence to explain trade-offs to senior leaders and say no with a reason.</li> </ul> <p><em>Nice to haves:</em></p> <ul> <li>Experience in a regulated field such as banking, payments, insurance or tax technology.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of the tax regime in one or more of Raisin’s markets, for example Germany (Abgeltungsteuer, tax exemption orders), or of statutory reporting such as CRS. Tax knowledge is not required. We will teach you.</li> <li>You have built tools for operations or customer service teams.</li> </ul> <p><em>Important attributes for this role:</em></p> <ul> <li>You bridge product and engineering. You are comfortable discussing data models and architecture trade-offs, and you push for practical solutions that scale.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!</strong></p> <p>At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.</p> <p>As part of our team, you will benefit from</p> <ul> <li>Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.</li> <li>Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.</li> <li>A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.</li> <li>Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. </li> <li>Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.</li> <li>Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.</li> <li>Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.</li> <li>You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><a href="https://www.raisin.com/corporate/raisin-applicant-privacy-policy/"><em>Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy</em></a></p> <p data-start="728" data-end="900">We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.</p> <p data-start="907" data-end="1013">We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.</p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Product Manager – Firefox Enterprise

title: Staff Engineer - Telematics
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role<br></strong>At Samsara, we're looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to help turn growing Telematics products into major businesses. Our new product bets include routing and workforce management for physical operations.<br>The portfolio has paying customers and early traction. You'll help shape what comes next, working directly with customers to understand their operations, test ideas and build solutions they choose to use. You'll stay close to the work through production, customer adoption and scale.<br>This is a technical leadership role with substantial hands-on engineering. You'll define important problems and make product and technical decisions alongside Product, Design and Engineering partners. You'll bring the judgement to move forward when requirements are incomplete, and the influence to align other teams around a clear direction.<strong><br><br>What you will do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work directly with customers and customer-facing teams to understand unmet needs, test assumptions and identify opportunities worth pursuing. Agree on success measures with Product and Design before investing in a solution.</li> <li>Lead ambiguous initiatives end to end, from discovery and prototypes through production rollout, adoption and iteration. Use customer feedback and product data to decide what to improve, expand or stop.</li> <li>Write and ship code on the critical path. Work across services, APIs and customer-facing experiences as the problem requires, combining technical depth with the ability to learn unfamiliar parts of the product.</li> <li>Set technical direction for your area and align the teams needed to deliver it. Make pragmatic architecture choices that support rapid learning today and reliable growth over time.</li> <li>Own the production quality of what you build. Design for correctness, reliability and performance, plan safe rollouts, and use operational evidence to address the constraints that emerge as usage grows.</li> <li>Increase the effectiveness of the engineers around you through design and code reviews, mentoring senior engineers, and removing recurring obstacles to delivery. Share context and decisions so others can move independently.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <h4>In this role, you will:<span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></h4> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team</span></strong></li> </ul> <p><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">What you will bring</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>A track record of shipping customer-facing products and growing them beyond their initial launch. You can explain your contribution to measurable outcomes such as adoption, revenue growth, retention, customer efficiency or cost to serve.</li> <li>Strong product judgement. You have worked directly with customers, clarified poorly defined problems and made decisions using evidence, including changing direction when an initial idea did not work.</li> <li>Deep hands-on software engineering ability, with recent experience designing, implementing and operating production systems. You can move from a prototype to maintainable software and explain the trade-offs along the way.</li> <li>Experience scaling products and the systems behind them. You know how to identify the next constraint, balance speed with reliability, and make technical investments that support customer and business growth.</li> <li>Technical leadership across team boundaries. You have built alignment without formal authority, made other engineers more effective, and communicated difficult choices clearly to technical and business partners.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Experience that could be useful</strong><br>Experience building B2B software through an early growth stage, or working on routing, workforce management or other software for physical operations. We value evidence of learning a complex customer domain and delivering results; previous industry experience is helpful, rather than essential.</span></strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br><strong>What success looks like</strong><br>Customers adopt the capabilities you help build and can see the benefit in their day-to-day operations. The products remain dependable as usage grows. Your technical decisions support measurable business progress, and the teams around you can deliver more effectively because of your work.</span></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p> <p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p> <p><strong>Flexible Working </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. title: Product Manager (English/French)
description: <h3><strong>About Unframe</strong></h3> <p>Unframe is an AI-first startup helping the world’s largest enterprises bring LLM-powered applications to life in days - not months. We combine the speed of a product company with the flexibility of a consultancy, helping customers move from idea to deployed AI systems faster than anyone else in the market.</p> <p>Backed by Bessemer, Craft, and TLV Partners with $100M in Series B funding, we’re building a fast-growing, revenue-generating company working with Fortune 500 customers globally</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>This role sits on the front line: you engage directly with enterprise clients, lead discovery to uncover core business challenges, and design and ship tailored AI solutions built on Unframe's platform. You own the work end-to-end, serving as the strategic and technical bridge from initial conversation through to final deployment.</p> <p>This is a true builder role. You write the precise specifications and prompt architectures that bring solutions to life, making the critical design decisions that determine whether an enterprise AI deployment actually succeeds.</p> <h3><span class="s1"><strong>What you’ll do</strong></span></h3> <p>This is a project-led role with unmediated access to clients at every stage. You will typically manage several engagements simultaneously, with short planning horizons and evolving requirements. Roughly 30 to 40 percent of the role is active client management, ensuring senior stakeholders remain aligned through delivery, progress reviews, and post-deployment rollouts.</p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li><strong>Lead Enterprise Discovery: </strong>Conduct discovery sessions directly with enterprise clients to map workflows, uncover business challenges, and distinguish surface-level requests from fundamental operational needs.</li> <li><strong>Design & Spec AI Solutions: </strong>Translate customer problems into structured solution plans on Unframe's platform. Write detailed specs and define prompt and context structures, owning the complete solution design.</li> <li><strong>Drive End-to-End Delivery: </strong>Collaborate with engineers and AI specialists to deliver solutions on target. Prioritize requirements and manage tradeoffs across speed, stability, and scope.</li> <li><strong>Represent the User & Platform: </strong>Act as the voice of enterprise operators and domain experts while collaborating with the Platform team to identify reusable product patterns.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h3><span class="s1"><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>4+ years of experience in product management or technical delivery roles, with a proven track record working alongside engineering teams on complex, fast-paced technical products.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="5,0,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">Bilingual Fluency (English & French):</strong> Fluent in French to connect with users and stakeholders in France, and fluent in English for daily collaboration across our international teams.</li> <li><strong>Customer-Led Discovery: </strong>Proven experience personally leading consultative conversations with enterprise buyers and operators - not supporting a sales call, not interviewing platform users, but owning the conversation to surface unstated needs and translate them into clear solution scope.</li> <li><strong>Enterprise Stakeholder Management: </strong>Ability to manage senior client relationships through a complex delivery; keeping stakeholders aligned, navigating competing priorities, and being the primary point of contact when requirements shift or timelines compress.</li> <li><strong>Problem-to-Solution Design: </strong>Ability to start from a raw business problem without existing features for reference, defining exactly how an AI solution should function and writing precise specs for build teams.</li> <li><strong>Complex Delivery Execution: </strong>Experience shipping AI-powered features under tight timelines, managing evolving requirements, and documenting strategic tradeoffs.</li> <li><strong>AI Solutions Experience: </strong>Direct exposure to building with LLMs - writing prompt structures, defining context and output constraints, working with agentic systems, or managing model uncertainty in a shipped product or working prototype. This is the dimension most learnable on the job; concrete work product carries more weight than certification.</li> <li><strong>Builder Orientation: </strong>Driven by creating customer-facing solutions rather than simply managing traditional roadmaps or processing requests.</li> <li><strong>Core Competencies: </strong>Strong written communication, systems thinking, high attention to detail, fluent English (written and verbal), and the ability to navigate multi-faceted projects.</li> </ul> <h3><span class="s1"><strong><br>Why join us</strong></span></h3> <p class="p2">At Unframe, you’ll help build AI systems that are already delivering real value to global enterprises - not prototypes, demos, or side projects.</p> <p class="p2">You’ll work with exceptional teammates, collaborate directly with top-tier customers, and have real influence over both the solutions we ship and the evolution of our platform. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where product thinking, technical depth, and creativity come together.</p> <p class="p2">If you enjoy solving hard problems, moving fast, and building practical AI products that actually make it to production - we’d love to meet you.</p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive - Lyon
description: <p><strong>About OpenTable:</strong></p> <p>With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. </p> <p>Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture and inclusive environment, and get the benefits, flexibility, and support you need to succeed.</p> <hr> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>The Account Executive is responsible for bringing new restaurants onto our dining network through a consultative sales approach.</p> <p>OpenTable’s Account Executive team is dedicated to improving restaurants’ revenue potential by applying best-in-brand front-of-house management and online reservation technology. We are looking for sales professionals who are passionate about the restaurant industry and enjoy working with industry-leading technology.</p> <p><strong>We don't have an office in France so you'll spend much of your week meeting restaurant operators face-to-face across your territory, helping build trusted relationships and close new business.This field-based role combines home working with regular travel across your territory. </strong></p> <hr> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and grow your assigned territory by proactively identifying, targeting and winning new restaurant partners through strategic outbound activity and thoughtful market mapping.</li> <li>Build trusted adviser relationships with top and elite restaurants, strengthening long-term partnerships and expanding revenue opportunities within your market.</li> <li>Deliver high-quality, tailored product demos, both virtual and in-person, using data-driven insights to diagnose needs and position OpenTable solutions effectively.</li> <li>Drive sustainable revenue growth by creating compelling commercial opportunities that generate measurable value for restaurateurs and OpenTable alike.</li> <li>Act as a market expert by educating operators on industry trends, competitive insights and performance data, while challenging them to think differently about their business.<br>Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans, confidently overcoming objections and navigating competitive environments.</li> <li>Consistently exceed monthly and quarterly acquisition and revenue targets while maintaining accurate forecasting and disciplined pipeline management through Salesforce.</li> <li>Capture and translate customer insights into action by sharing structured feedback with Product and Marketing teams to continuously refine the value proposition.</li> <li>Represent OpenTable within the hospitality community through industry events, networking and active market engagement to strengthen brand presence and credibility.</li> </ul> <hr> <p><strong>Please apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant B2B sales experience, with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding targets in fast-paced environments.</li> <li>Native French speaker with professional fluency in English, able to build trust and influence stakeholders across markets.</li> <li>A tenacious, goal-oriented self-starter who leads from the front — proactive in outbound activity, resilient in follow-up, and professionally persistent in driving opportunities forward.</li> <li>Strong discovery and consultative selling skills — confident asking the right questions, uncovering needs, and reframing how customers think about their business.</li> <li>Skilled at negotiation and value-based selling, able to articulate ROI and drive meaningful commercial outcomes during sales engagements.</li> <li>Comfortable using data and analytics to inform decisions, build compelling business cases, and strengthen customer conversations.</li> <li>Excellent time management, presentation and organisational skills, with confidence handling administrative responsibilities alongside pipeline management. Proficient in Google Workspace and Salesforce CRM.</li> <li>A collaborative, insight-driven team player who thrives on feedback, learning and shared success, as much as closing deals.</li> <li>Passionate about hospitality and technology. Experience in restaurant management and/or food & beverage sales is strongly preferred but not essential.</li> </ul> <hr> <p><strong>A few of the benefits you get at OpenTable—</strong></p> <ul> <li>Our Account Executive's are rewarded with uncapped commission</li> <li>Vacation: you accrue 25 days a year + RTTs</li> <li>Wedding days: 4 days off for your own wedding and 1 day for your child’s wedding</li> <li>Health and Life Insurance Scheme with Malakoff Humanis.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Occupational Health Service with the occupational health provider of your region.<br></strong></p> <hr> <p><strong>Work Environment & Flexibility</strong></p> <p>At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Inclusion</strong></p> <p>We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.</p> <p>If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.</p> <p>#LI-hybrid</p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Growth Lead (Berlin)
description: This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000). We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world. At Almedia, you’ll: Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast. Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity. Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people. Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need. Growth Lead (Berlin) Salary: 100-120k We are looking for a powerhouse Growth Lead (Berlin) to become the a dedicated leader for our Growth (sales and account management) team. Reporting directly to the Growth Director and in close alignment with the CEO, you will be the architect of our go-to-market engine. This is a dual-impact role: you will lead, coach, and motivate a high-performing team while remaining "in the trenches" to close strategic partnerships with the world’s top mobile game publishers. You will own end-to-end growth by building a high-accountability team culture and a repeatable GTM playbook. You will turn publisher insights into product strategy, move fast to scale our outbound motion, and raise the bar on execution across the entire lifecycle—from first contact to long-term integration and partnership. What You’ll Do 🎯 Architect the GTM Playbook: Build and own a repeatable outbound sales motion. You’ll define our segmentation, messaging, and CRM workflows to ensure the team executes with speed and precision. Lead from the Front: Personally drive Tier-1 deals from discovery to signed integration. You will land key accounts that serve as the "win stories" to unlock the rest of the market. Scale & Mentor the Team: Manage, motivate, and develop a part of the Growth team. You’ll be responsible for their KPIs, career growth plans, and day-to-day coaching to foster a culture of extreme ownership. Bridge Product & Market: Create a tight feedback loop with Product and Engineering. You will translate publisher needs into a prioritized backlog, ensuring our roadmap is aligned with what the market actually buys. Operational Excellence: Define the rituals of success—qualification standards, pipeline hygiene, and forecasting. You will provide the Growth Director with a live, transparent view of deal health and unblock the team to keep opportunities moving. What your first 90 days look like Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine hands-on. Days 31–60: Take over a full book of accounts. Own your first KPI review with our a senior team member. Contribute with your first written process improvement. Days 61–90: Operating with increasing independence. You've caught at least one issue before it escalated and proposed a test or lever on your book. Beyond 90 days: A clear path from Growth Lead to Strategic Growth Lead with even more ownership, and beyond. What You’ll Bring 💡 The "Player-Coach" DNA: You have a proven track record of running full-cycle enterprise sales (prospect → pitch → close) while simultaneously managing a small team. Pipeline Mastery: You know how to build an outbound engine from scratch. You are comfortable experimenting with A/B outreach, sequencing, and offer tests to find what sticks. Strategic Communication: You can translate complex product features into quantified ROI for Monetization and LiveOps leaders at major game studios. High-Stakes Leadership: You give candid feedback, address performance early, and know how to keep a remote or multi-geo team (Berlin/China/Israel) engaged and hungry. Operational Rigor: You don’t just "do sales"—you build systems. You are a power user of CRM data and live by pipeline hygiene. What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟 Own Everything: You care deeply about the team's performance and see every roadblock as an opportunity to build a better process. Move Fast: You thrive in the ambiguity of an early-stage environment and can pivot strategies without losing momentum. Focus on Impact: You prioritize the 20% of activities that drive 80% of the revenue. You are obsessed with results, not just "being busy." Why Almedia? 🎁 Scale With Almedia: Have a real impact and grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one. High-Growth Environment: We encourage all staff to take ownership of projects and consistently raise the bar. Do More, Get More: Generous bonus scheme to ensure great, proactive work is valued. We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. Compensation: €100K – €120K • €100K – €120K Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Internships 2027
description: About Nabla Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes: Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes. AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems. Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks. Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems. Early Careers: Software Engineering & Machine Learning We’re looking for early-career engineers who want to learn fast, work with experienced mentors, and make a real impact from day one. You’ll join a collaborative, mission-driven team where technical curiosity and humility matter as much as skill. Location: Paris (Hybrid) Start Date: 2027 (or as early as possible) Commitment: Internship-to-hire What we Offer Real Impact from Day One: You won’t be stuck with small tasks: you’ll contribute to real features and products. Learning Everywhere: We believe in mentorship, pair programming, and leveling up together. Lean, Ambitious Team: Be part of a fast-moving, deeply technical culture where your contributions matter. Healthcare Mission: Help doctors, nurses, and care teams spend more time with Patients Career Launchpad: Many interns convert to full-time, and early engineers grow quickly. Humble and resilient — you ask questions, take feedback, and grow. Nice-to-Haves (but not required) Internship or personal projects in AI, full-stack, or backend systems. Experience with React, GraphQL, or cloud infrastructure. Knowledge of CI/CD, Docker, or automated testing. Our Values at Nabla Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion. Every day is a new chance to excel We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day. Stay humble There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture. Feedback is a gift We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions. Committed to diversity We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work. Diversity & Inclusion Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond. As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive. title: GTM Operations Manager
description: RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue. We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading. The role We’re looking for a GTM Operations Manager to build and improve the workflows that connect our go-to-market teams. A promising account signs up. Does the right person find out, with enough context to act? A customer becomes eligible for a new product. Do they receive useful guidance? A data sync fails overnight. Do we catch it before it affects a campaign, account handoff, or business decision? You’ll help make those things work reliably. You’ll join an existing GTM Operations team, working closely with @Nathan Bellehsen on Salesforce and Sales systems and @Masha Tsaryk on Marketing and customer-lifecycle systems. Your initial focus will be lead handoffs and lifecycle execution: the data, automation, quality checks, and reporting that turn customer signals into useful action. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. You’ll own agreed projects from understanding the problem through building, testing, rollout, and ongoing improvement. Experienced teammates will provide context, help set priorities, and partner with you on architectural decisions. Within that direction, we expect you to make progress independently and flag problems early. Our stack includes Salesforce, Customer.io , Clay, Looker, automation tools, and a growing set of AI workflows. You don’t need to know every tool. You do need to understand how systems connect and enjoy figuring out why something isn’t working. title: Engineering Manager, AI Group
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h3><strong>What’s the opportunity?</strong></h3> <p>We’re hiring an <strong>Engineering Manager</strong> for our <strong>Product Workstreams</strong> in the <strong>AI Group</strong>. The AI Group’s product workstreams, partner with the wider product org to build the AI capabilities that underpin Fin. These workstreams do not act as ‘AI services’ for the wider org; they are instrumental in shaping AI products from the earliest stages and owning their ongoing development. Product workstreams are composed of EMs, PMs, Engineers, AI Designers, and Machine Learning Scientists.</p> <p>You will lead our Berlin-based product engineers in the AI Group and will be a key leader of our Berlin hub, helping it grow. You will also work across Fin's core capabilities, such as Skills, Personalisation, Procedures and Safety, and contribute directly to delivering new Fin products from inception.</p> <p>This is a <strong>hands-on</strong> EM role. You will lead a senior team of engineers and stay hands-on in the codebase. An EM who regularly works alongside ICs builds the context to make good strategic decisions and to support engineers well. Contributing to Fin’s central AI system, architecture and experimentation are core to the job. </p> <p>Learn more about Fin's AI engineering and research at<a href="https://fin.ai/research"> </a>Fin <a href="https://fin.ai/research">/research</a>, and more about Fin at<a href="http://fin.ai"> fin.ai</a>.</p> <h3><strong>What will I be doing?</strong></h3> <p>As a hands-on leader, you will: </p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and grow a high-performing engineering team </strong>based primarily in Berlin, with members across our European offices.</li> <li><strong>Incubate and deliver AI products </strong>from ideation through to success, leveraging backtests, evals and A/B tests to inform what ships.</li> <li><strong>Contribute directly to our production systems</strong> so you keep first-hand context.</li> <li><strong>Own operational health</strong> for your workstreams: SLOs, alarms, and proactive management of our most critical systems.</li> <li><strong>Plan, prioritise and deliver</strong> best-in-class AI products with your most senior engineers, ML Scientists, PMs and AI Designers.</li> <li><strong>Make AI-first the team default.</strong> Build shared skills, agents, and automations that raise the bar for the team’s output and ambition.</li> <li><strong>Hire and onboard</strong> great engineers, and help them build the Berlin office.</li> </ul> <h2>What skills do I need?</h2> <p>Must-haves:</p> <ul> <li>Strong prior experience as an engineer, with recent hands-on technical contributions.</li> <li>Strong technical judgement, and the ability to coach senior engineers through complex architecture and product trade-offs.</li> <li>Strong product sense: you can weigh AI product opportunities and decide what matters most.</li> <li>A data-driven approach: you use experiments and metrics to make decisions.</li> <li>Strong ownership of production quality and reliability.</li> <li>An adaptable leadership style for a group and environment that will grow fast and change shape.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Nice to haves:</p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Experience leading engineering teams that build and operate generative AI systems in production.</li> <li>Experience with AI evaluation, backtesting or experiment design at scale.</li> <li>Experience managing AI costs and how product choices affect it.</li> <li>Experience in a hands-on EM role, or alternating between EM and IC roles.</li> <li>Experience helping build or grow a new engineering site.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h2>How will I be supported?</h2> <ul> <li>You’ll have a structured onboarding experience to help you get up to speed quickly in Berlin and across Intercom.</li> <li>You’ll have a close group of management peers to collaborate with and learn from.</li> <li>We invest in our managers, supporting individual career development through training, coaching and regular feedback.</li> <li>You’ll have opportunities to contribute to and learn from our wider engineering community.</li> </ul> <h2>Benefits</h2> <p>We’re a well-treated bunch, with awesome benefits. If there’s something important to you that’s not on this list, talk to us.</p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary and equity in a fast-growing company.</li> <li>A flexible, hybrid way of working from our Berlin location.</li> <li>Regular compensation reviews—we reward great work.</li> <li>Health, wellbeing and insurance benefits designed for our employees in Germany.</li> <li>Family-friendly leave and support in line with local requirements and company policy.</li> <li>Flexible time off so you can take a break when you need it.</li> <li>A well-equipped Berlin office, including lunch and kitchen provisions.</li> <li>A MacBook as standard, with flexibility to choose the equipment that helps you do your best work.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p> <p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at<a href="http://fin.ai/careers"> fin.ai/careers</a>. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. </p> <p><strong>Policies </strong></p> <p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p> <p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our <a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.  </p> <p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal">Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.</a> Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.</p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive, Enterprise
description: <div class="content-intro"><p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.</p> <p>We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.</p></div><p><a style="display: block; overflow: hidden; position: relative;" href="https://share.synthesia.io/35a0c2a2-c772-4d2a-b571-808b7462c25f" target="_blank"> <img style="width: 100%; display: block; max-width: 100%;" src="https://image.synthesia.io/35a0c2a2-c772-4d2a-b571-808b7462c25f/thumbnail.gif" alt="Inside the Life of a Zscaler Enterprise Account Executive"> </a></p> <p><strong>Role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an Account Executive to join our team. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain</li> <li>3+ years of sales experience with a revenue quota, selling to Enterprise accounts in Germany</li> <li>History of net new logo accomplishments and a clear understanding of how to leverage channel partnerships</li> <li>Willingness to be coached and the discipline to work a proven sales process from beginning to end</li> <li>Evidence of successful "team sales" and the ability to leverage internal resources and partners</li> <li>Fluency in German</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience leveraging AI-powered sales intelligence, predictive forecasting, or conversational AI platforms to optimize enterprise territory planning and pipeline acceleration</li> <li>Proficiency in strategic sales planning with experience closing net new logos</li> <li>A consistent track record of winning business in Enterprise accounts</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid #LI-MM5</p> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span data-sheets-root="1">Zscaler’s salary ranges are benchmarked and determined by role and level. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.</p> <p>Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:</p> <div class="has-nudge" data-nudge-id="5eb9419b-6a4d-4451-bfa6-e2eb96084be0"> <ul> <li>Various health plans</li> <li>Time off plans for vacation and sick time</li> <li>Parental leave options</li> <li>Retirement options</li> <li>Education reimbursement</li> <li>In-office perks, and more!</li> </ul> <div class="has-nudge" data-nudge-id="5eb9419b-6a4d-4451-bfa6-e2eb96084be0"> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits <a href="https://www.zscaler.com/candidate-resource-hub" target="_blank">here</a>.</p> </div> </div> <p>By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.</p> <p class="p1">Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. title: Strategic Account Executive - Transportation & Logistics
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><h4><strong>The Team:</strong></h4> <p>You will join a high-performing sales team within the DACH sales organization, responsible for driving growth within large global enterprises from the Transportation & Logistics industry, including rail, ocean shipping and contract logistics. Transportation & Logistics is one of our strategic industries, where we help global leaders optimize their end-to-end processes, increase operational efficiency through our Process Intelligence platform, and provide the contextual layer to industrialize Enterprise AI.</p> <h4> </h4> <h4><strong>The Role:</strong></h4> <p>Applying a value-driven consultative sales approach, you will create and cultivate strategic relationships to drive sales cycles from deep discovery to value realization. Navigating complex organizations up to the C-suite, you will collaborate cross-functionally to understand your accounts' needs and systematically drive the end-to-end sales cycle to a successful close.</p> <h4> </h4> <h4><strong>The Work you'll do:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Manage your accounts from an existing customer perspective. translate customer challenges into compelling, AI-enabled use cases with measurable impact.</li> <li>Hold an individual revenue target for closing six- to seven-figure deals within your accounts.</li> partners.</li> </ul> <h4> </h4> <h4><strong>The Qualifications you need:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>8+ years of relevant experience in either one, or ideally both, of the following domains:</li> <ul> sell complex, strategic business solutions to large enterprise accounts with full account ownership, ideally at a hyperscaler or leading SaaS company.</li> </ul> <li>A proven track record of commitment, long tenure and successful career progression with your previous companies.</li> <li>Strong business acumen and a deep understanding of how transportation and logistics companies operate, with familiarity with their core processes and KPIs, particularly within Supply Chain and Finance.</li> <li>Familiarity with the different industry players (3PL, contract logistics, freight forwarding, rail) and experience in addressing their key challenges: supply chain volatility and resilience, cost pressure (e.g. from manual document handling such as customs and air waybills), and punctuality.</li> <li>Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior Business and IT stakeholders and engage effectively at the C-level (CEO, CFO, CIO, COO, Head of Operations).</li> <li>Experience with complex tender processes is a strong plus.</li> <li>Grit, a hands-on mindset, and strong discovery and sales process leadership.</li> <li>Fluency in German and English, with exceptional communication and presentation skills.</li> <li>Ability to adapt to a fast-moving, high-growth environment and approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking and a growth title: Customer Success Manager, Southern Europe
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h1><strong>À propos du poste</strong></h1> <p>Rejoignez l'équipe Customer Success d'Anthropic en tant que Customer Success Manager basé(e) dans la région EMEA, alors que nous façonnons l'avenir de l'adoption de l'IA en entreprise. En tant que Customer Success Manager chez Anthropic, vous serez partenaire stratégique et conseiller de confiance de nos clients les plus complexes dans la zone EMEA, les aidant à exploiter pleinement le potentiel de toutes nos fonctionnalités Claude : API, Claude for Enterprise et Claude Code.</p> <p>Vous développerez de véritables partenariats avec les clients, acquérant une compréhension approfondie de leurs objectifs commerciaux, de leur orientation stratégique, de leur vision en IA et de leurs besoins techniques. Vous ferez appel à la fois à votre sens des affaires et à votre expertise technique pour agir comme conseiller stratégique tout au long de leur parcours chez nous.</p> <p>En partenariat avec l'ensemble de l'équipe chargée des comptes, vous aiderez les clients à identifier les fonctionnalités Claude les mieux adaptées à leurs objectifs commerciaux spécifiques, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec eux pour leur fournir les meilleures pratiques et des conseils, tout en les aidant dans la croissance et l'évolution de leur utilisation (consommation et base) sur le siège.</p> <p>Votre rôle consiste à aider les clients à adapter efficacement leur utilisation, à mettre en œuvre des stratégies de gestion du changement, à optimiser les cas d'utilisation et à maximiser la valeur de leur investissement en élargissant les cas d'utilisation à l'ensemble de leur organisation. Les informations que vous recueillerez auprès de vos clients serviront directement à définir nos priorités en matière de recherche, de développement et</p> <p>de stratégies de commercialisation, vous permettant de jouer un rôle clé dans la manière dont nous créons et fournissons de la valeur en continu en tant qu'entreprise.</p> <p>En tant que l'un de nos premiers CSM dans la région EMEA, vous serez une pionnière en aidant à mettre en place des processus régionaux, à établir de nouvelles relations avec les clients et en représentant la marque Anthropic dans un</p> <p>marché en forte croissance. Vous travaillerez avec une grande autonomie tout en maintenant un alignement fort avec les équipes mondiales, ce qui requiert une personne qui s'épanouit dans des environnements ambigus et peut travailler efficacement dans différents fuseaux horaires.</p> <h2><strong> </strong></h2> <h1><strong>Responsabilités :</strong></h1> <ul> <li>Établir des relations de confiance et stratégiques avec les décideurs clés des clients EMEA afin de comprendre leurs activités et leurs objectifs, en identifiant des opportunités d'optimisation et d'expansion</li> <li>Devenir expert des produits Anthropic via API, Claude for Enterprise et Claude Code, en comprenant les nuances techniques et les meilleures pratiques de chacun afin d'orienter les clients vers les bonnes solutions</li> <li>Tirer parti de votre connaissance approfondie du client et des spécificités régionales pour piloter de manière proactive la planification de l'utilisation, en cernant les tendances actuelles et futures en matière de consommation et d'adoption, ainsi que la manière dont celles-ci se traduisent en valeur ajoutée pour le client</li> <li>Surveiller les schémas d'utilisation et identifiez les opportunités d'optimisation, en traitant de manière proactive la sous-utilisation des produits basés sur la consommation (API) et par abonnement (Claude for Enterprise / Claude Code) pour tirer pleinement parti des engagements contractuels</li> <li>Jouer le rôle de partenaire stratégique auprès des clients, en enrichissant leur connaissance des produits Claude grâce à la diffusion de la feuille de route des produits d'Anthropic, en faisant connaître les nouveaux produits et en impliquant les chefs de produit pour qu'ils se fassent le porte-parole des clients de la région EMEA</li> <li>Documenter et quantifier la valeur client réalisée grâce aux résultats commerciaux, au ROI et aux indicateurs d'impact afin de constituer des arguments commerciaux internes convaincants en vue de poursuivre et d'accroître les investissements</li> <li>Identifier les cas d'utilisation potentiels et les secteurs d'activité qui ne sont pas encore exploités, en collaborant avec les clients pour découvrir de nouvelles applications pour Claude au sein des différents services, équipes et flux de travail</li> <li>Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de gestion du changement pour favoriser l'adoption par les utilisateurs finaux et maximiser la valeur au sein des organisations clientes, y compris des programmes de formation des formateurs, le développement de centres d'excellence et l'accompagnement organisationnel</li> <li>Gérer l'expérience client tout au long de son cycle de vie : gérer des comptes complets et des plans de réussite fondés sur les objectifs commerciaux du description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. Blog</a> for more insight into our culture and technology.</p> <h2><strong>Our humble expectations</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proven expertise in building production frontend applications using TypeScript and React.</li> <li>Solid backend knowledge, comfortable owning and operating Node.js services that support frontend infrastructure.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of frontend build tools, bundlers, and module systems, and the ability to evolve them as the platform grows.</li> <li>Track record of diagnosing and resolving complex performance, reliability, or DX issues in large frontend codebases.</li> <li>Experience driving technical initiatives across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management skills: aligning priorities, managing expectations, and communicating trade-offs clearly with partner teams and leadership.</li> <li>Strong communication skills and a collaborative, platform-mindset approach to working with feature teams.</li> <li>Strong documentation skills, including experience writing RFCs or ADRs.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to Haves</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with micro-frontend architecture.</li> <li>Frontend platform engineering experience.</li> <li>Experience building shared component libraries used by many product teams.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and cloud infrastructure for frontend workloads.</li> <li>Experience or interest in observability and reliability (SRE).</li> <li>Experience building tooling or workflows for autonomous AI coding agents (e.g., agent instructions, skills, MCP servers, or evaluating agent-generated code).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What’s in it for you</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Impact:</strong> Build and shape the platform that thousands of people depend on.</li> <li><strong>Scale:</strong> Work on real platform problems behind 250+ MFEs with hundreds of monthly contributors.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration:</strong> Partner with talented engineers, designers, and operators across companies to make their daily work faster and better.</li> <li><strong>Growth:</strong> Take on deep technical challenges across frontend architecture, agentic development, DX, and improving engineering efficiency.</li> <li><strong>Culture:</strong> Be part of a diverse, open-minded team that values creativity, autonomy, and continuous learning.</li> title: Senior Backend Engineer, AI Platform (Toqan)

Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover. Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. You’ll work where distributed systems meet applied AI: orchestrating models and tools, enabling agents to perform long-running work, and turning rapidly evolving AI capabilities into dependable platform primitives. The challenges span asynchronous workflows, isolated execution, extensible integrations, reliability, observability and cost control. You're comfortable owning architectural decisions on novel infrastructure — the kind where the right answer isn't obvious and the stakes are real. You think in systems, spot failure modes early, and hold a high bar for production quality without letting perfect block good. The 80/20 mindset comes naturally: you know when to go deep and when to ship. You've likely come from a startup or high-velocity environment where shipping fast wasn't a culture slogan — it was survival. You know how to cut scope without cutting corners, move from zero to production without a safety net, and iterate quickly on systems that are still finding their shape. You're genuinely curious about the AI and LLM space — not as a trend to track, but as a domain where you've already done hands-on integration work and want to go further. AI tools aren't an afterthought in how you work — you use them daily, whether that's Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or OpenAI Codex, and you've developed real judgment about where they accelerate work and where they don't. You operate with low ego, share context freely, and thrive in an environment where autonomy and accountability go hand in hand. Ambiguity doesn't slow you down — it's where you do your best work. You might design a new capability for the agent runtime, improve how models and tools are orchestrated, investigate a production reliability issue, or take an integration from an early prototype to a secure, observable service. You’ll spend much of your time building in Go, reviewing code and making architectural decisions with the team. You’ll also work closely with product, platform and AI colleagues to shape requirements, test ideas and ship them safely. Along the way, you’ll improve the testing, deployment and observability foundations that let the team move quickly with confidence. What We Offer Global Impact: Play a crucial role in shaping the future of global commerce. Growth Opportunities: Expand your expertise through diverse global challenges and unique opportunities. Innovative Culture: Join a forward-thinking team that values strategic insights and fosters continuous innovation. Creative Environment: Engage in work that encourages creativity and constant improvement. Collaborative Atmosphere: Benefit from autonomy and self-management in a supportive and positive workspace. Hybrid Work: Experience the satisfaction of our flexible model tailored to balance work and life. Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a salary package that reflects your skills and contributions. Comprehensive Benefits: From health and wellness to learning, commuting, and everyday perks, we offer a well-rounded package designed to help you thrive at work and beyond. Why Prosus? At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next. Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.
