title: Robot Pilot
description: About nu glass The Robot Pilot is responsible for operating our laser robot technology on-site, ensuring strict adherence to production schedules, quality standards, and safety guidelines. Reporting to the Robotics Manufacturing and Support Engineer, this role plays a key part in troubleshooting issues and maintaining efficient, continuous operations within a collaborative team. Your responsibilities As a Robot Pilot at nu glass in Spiez, you will operate and manage robotic systems directly on-site as part of a 45-hour workweek on a 12-month fixed-term contract starting January 11, 2027. Responsibilities & Areas of Expertise - Machine Operation & Daily Maintenance: Operating and running the laser robot (CNC) at the assigned site; systematically performing Level 1 maintenance, including daily cleaning, thorough cleaning of protective glass panels, and verification of safety barriers before starting each shift. - Quality Control & Production Monitoring: Conducting visual inspections and quality checks; accurately recording production tracking sheets, scrap rates, and performance data (KPIs) in Odoo. - Safety & Site Discipline (5S Methodology): Strictly complying with EHS/OHS requirements, personal protective equipment (PPE) standards, and ergonomic guidelines; maintaining a consistently clean, tidy, and well-organized 5S-compliant workstation at the client site. - Escalation & First-Level Troubleshooting: Early detection of technical deviations; promptly notifying the Production Manager and Technical Support (Olivier); assisting with the initial diagnosis of straightforward technical issues. - On-Site Presence & Operational Continuity: Ensuring production continuity at the assigned site and participating in shift handovers between teams, as well as during Technical Support interventions. What we are looking for We are looking for someone ready to take on the operation of our specialized laser ablation equipment within our agile team. Open to working 4 nights/week German and English speaker Willing to travel in Germany and within Switzerland ( at our cost) Your first months at nu glass You will quickly get hands-on with state-of-the-art laser technology, integrating into our daily operations and contributing to projects that enhance connectivity and sustainability. If you match most of our requirements, we encourage you to apply. Benefits Flexible working hours Compensation CHF 60,000–64,800 per year Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Associate Director- Sustainability & Impact (Lyon, France)
description: Location : Lyon, France About ARCHIMED: With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. Its mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise allows ARCHIMED to serve as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Prioritized areas of focus include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools & Biologic Services, MedTech, and Pharma Services. ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services. ARCHIMED manages €8 billion across its various funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based General Partner. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed Impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation. The Team • An international team (with more than 30 nationalities) with complementary education and experience in the investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational sectors • Composed of alumni from: INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, ESSEC, Imperial College, Dartmouth, etc. • Professional backgrounds: Private Equity (3i, Siparex, USS Ltd, Barings, capiton), Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), M&A (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC), Industry (Biotronik, Cerba, Pharmacy, Veterinary) Your Role Portfolio engagement and value creation Lead portfolio engagement on Sustainability and Impact (S&I), providing hands-on support to portfolio companies and tracking S&I progress across ARCHIMED’s portfolios through dashboards, KPIs, and supporting processes. Lead select portfolio value creation projects, collaborating with deal teams as well as guiding and project managing S&I interns where required. Develop and oversee the execution of actionable S&I roadmaps for each portfolio company, with targets and milestones based on the company’s materiality analysis and aligned with ARCHIMED’s S&I strategy, partnering with third-party technical experts when necessary. Influence portfolio company management to advance their roadmaps through technical guidance and sharing of best practices. Investment process Act as the bridge between deal teams and external providers during due diligence, critically assessing findings to confirm that each target is consistent with ARCHIMED’s S&I strategy and fund obligations. Work with all ARCHIMED functions to review and improve how S&I is integrated into investment decision making. Data, reporting, and compliance Establish the tools and framework to collect, monitor, and coordinate S&I data across funds, enabling timely, accurate, and consistent reporting, and select third-party technical experts when necessary. Analyze and interpret S&I data and substantially contribute to the production of ARCHIMED’s annual S&I report in line with industry standards and frameworks, turning data into clear narratives. Contribute substantially to regular reporting to investors and to mandatory disclosures on fund S&I performance, ensuring credibility and transparency. Monitor regulatory developments in ARCHIMED’s locations and sectors of focus, and help ensure compliance with sustainability-related requirements. Center of excellence and capability building Establish an S&I center of excellence across funds and portfolio companies, with tools, reports, and training materials that share guidance and best practices. Provide expert guidance and S&I training to management, investment, and investor relations teams to deepen integration across the business. Requirements At least 10 years’ experience building and executing sustainability strategies, preferably in private equity. Proven hands-on leadership, initiative, and project management skills, with strong problem-solving ability. Robust knowledge of S&I frameworks and disclosures, including SFDR, SASB, CSRD, EDCI, PMDR, and the UN SDGs. Strong command of impact measurement methodologies, including developing and reporting on impact metrics. Strong attention to detail, with the ability to build coherent sustainability narratives and proofread content. Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the adaptability to engage C-suite executives internationally. Proven team player, able to build working partnerships and promote collaboration with a wide range of stakeholders. Ability to coach junior team members, sharing knowledge and giving regular feedback. Pragmatic, constructive, creative, and solution-oriented, with a positive mindset and the ability to work under varied pressures. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Quantum Applications Engineer
description: Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions Description of the Project As a Quantum Applications Engineer , you will work at the intersection of quantum algorithms, real-world applications and customer projects . Your mission will be to identify relevant problems that can be addressed using Quandela's quantum computing technology, assess their feasibility and define how meaningful performance should be measured. Working directly with industrial and academic partners, you will translate real-world challenges into quantum computing problems, evaluate potential approaches and establish the appropriate benchmarks against classical methods. This is a highly technical role with strong exposure to customers and partners. It is particularly suited to someone with a background in quantum algorithms who wants to apply that expertise to practical use cases rather than focus exclusively on theoretical research. Your Key Responsibilities Identify and assess quantum use cases by working with customers, industrial partners and internal teams to understand their challenges and translate them into relevant computational problems. Perform feasibility studies to determine whether and how these problems can be addressed using current and near-term quantum computing technologies, with a particular focus on NISQ approaches. Define meaningful benchmarks , including relevant problem instances, expected outputs, accuracy targets and classical baselines to objectively evaluate quantum approaches. Explore promising application domains and contribute to application roadmaps, from near-term demonstrations to longer-term utility-scale applications. Evaluate scientific, industrial and economic value to help prioritize the applications where quantum computing can have the greatest impact. Design and maintain strategic demonstrations and Proofs of Concept , working with internal teams or external software partners depending on the project. Follow customer projects throughout their lifecycle , including projects where algorithm development is performed by external partners. Present technical work to customers and partners , explaining quantum approaches, results, limitations and opportunities to both technical and non-specialist audiences. Collaborate closely with Quandela's algorithm, machine learning, product, project management, sales and engineering teams. Depending on the strategic interest of a project, you may also contribute directly to the development and implementation of quantum algorithms in Python. What will make you successful You do not need to know every possible quantum application from day one. What matters is your ability to approach an unfamiliar problem, ask the right questions, understand its computational structure and determine whether quantum computing provides an interesting direction to explore. You are comfortable navigating between research and practical applications : scientifically rigorous enough to challenge an algorithmic approach, pragmatic enough to assess its real-world relevance, and comfortable enough with people to discuss your conclusions directly with customers. Requirements You have a strong technical background in quantum computing and quantum algorithms , combined with the curiosity and communication skills required to explore real-world applications. You ideally bring: A PhD in quantum computing, quantum information, physics, applied mathematics, computer science or a related field , or a Master's degree combined with relevant professional experience. A first professional experience in a similar environment is strongly preferred. Strong understanding of quantum algorithms , particularly approaches applicable to current or near-term quantum computers. Knowledge of NISQ algorithms and variational quantum algorithms . Good programming skills, particularly in Python . The ability to understand a complex industrial or scientific problem and translate it into a computational and algorithmic framework. A rigorous approach to benchmarking quantum and classical methods . Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication skills and the confidence to present technical topics directly to customers, partners and broader audiences. Professional proficiency in English . Previous experience working on customer-facing technical projects, quantum application projects, consulting, pre-sales, collaborative R&D projects or industrial partnerships would be a strong plus. Experience with Agile ways of working and tools such as Jira is appreciated but not essential. Benefits Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience Profit-sharing & company savings plan 100% health coverage (Alan) 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000) What we offer: A role at the intersection of cutting-edge quantum research and real-world industrial applications. Direct exposure to a wide variety of quantum computing use cases and industries. The opportunity to work with leading researchers, engineers, industrial partners and customers. Significant ownership in shaping Quandela's application portfolio and identifying the problems quantum computing should address next. title: Platform Architect - Banking
description: About us EggAI is a fast-growing AI consulting and development startup. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets. The role You will own the design of a shared AI platform for our clients. The platform has two parts. An AI Control Plane governs what agents may do, through identity and delegated permissions, policy enforcement, approvals, budgets and durable audit records. A managed AI Runtime is where the agents run. Both integrate with the client's identity, security, delivery and audit services. You will set the architecture, define how services and controls fit together, and make sure what the team builds is sound, assured and ready for production. The role reaches across engineering, security, audit, risk and the client's architecture function. You will take designs through their governance, record the decisions, and give the engineers a design they can build and the client a design they can approve. You will be EggAI's accountable architecture lead on the engagement, leading design for a delivery team of platform engineers. You make the technical decisions within the team's remit, recommend on the rest, and secure the client's approval where their architecture or risk governance requires it. What you will do - Own the architecture of the AI Control Plane and AI Runtime and keep it aligned with the client's architecture standards, cloud substrate, API gateway, identity provider and audit services. - Define service interfaces and contracts. Decide where each security and policy control is enforced: in the gateway, the control plane, the runtime or the client's own services. - Keep the design record. Write architecture decision records (ADRs) and record every deviation from the client's standards or our reference designs for a client decision. - Take designs through the client's architecture and risk forums. Secure approvals in time for dependent work, so that design precedes implementation. - Lead design and quality review across all platform services. Review engineers' changes, cross-service tests and fault exercises with the CTO. - Define how the architecture will be proven. Agree acceptance criteria with engineers and client control owners for each interface, control and infrastructure contract, including behaviour when a dependency fails, and review the test evidence showing they are met. - Hold the build to the design's principles: policy enforced outside the agent, decisions recorded before actions take effect, fail closed with stop always available, and audit evidence that is administered independently of the people who build and run the platform, reconciled against what actually happened, and readable with the client's own tools. - Maintain the inventory of platform controls. Record for each one whether it is enforced or only monitored, whether it is implemented, tested or still open, and what evidence it produces, so acceptance reviews work from a current record and coverage gaps are visible. - Assess proposed technology, scope and dependency changes for their effect on the design, controls, effort and running costs, and give the programme lead a clear basis for plan and cost decisions. - Evaluate new runtimes and managed services against the platform's control requirements. Compare shared controls with provider-native ones on integration effort, operating cost and assurance gaps, separate what is verified from what is assumed, and recommend whether to adopt, change the design or hold scope. - Lead the technical assessment of production readiness. Review recovery, containment and fault-exercise evidence, and give the programme lead a clear view of what is ready and what is not. - Stay with the platform through go-live and the support period after it. Resolve the architectural issues that production exposes, and decide when a fix is a design change rather than a defect. - Prepare the client's receiving engineers to maintain the design. Lead the architecture parts of training and handover, and leave documentation, decision records and guidance they can extend without you. Essential experience - You have been the accountable solution or platform architect for systems that went into production, and have led engineers through building them. - You have delivered cloud platforms into production in a regulated environment and taken designs through formal architecture and risk governance. - You know a major cloud platform in depth: networking, identity, secrets, Kubernetes and managed services. Azure is strongly preferred. - You have hands-on experience with API gateways, identity and delegation using OAuth and OIDC, and policy as code. - You work with infrastructure as code, GitOps and software supply-chain controls, and understand how they underpin reproducible environments, conformance tests and release assurance. - You have designed systems that must produce audit evidence and fail safely: durable records, immutable storage, separation of duties and deny-by-default access. You have sound judgement about retries, partial failure, idempotency, identity propagation and recovery. - You write clear architecture decision records and can explain and defend a design to senior architects, risk owners and engineers. Nice to have - Delivery in financial services or banking. - LLM or agent platforms in production, including model gateways, agent orchestration and protocols such as MCP and A2A. - Audit, evidence retention or AI risk controls, including EU AI Act, PRA or FCA expectations. - Products in this space such as Kong, Open Policy Agent or Microsoft Foundry. Practical details - Hybrid working and client-site attendance will depend on the engagement. - You will need to complete the background and security checks required by the client. title: Technical Business Development Intern (Emerging Verticals) (f/m/d)
description: Description QuantumDiamonds is building the world's first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. Our Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDm) images magnetic fields with micrometer resolution, and that capability could matter far beyond semiconductors. As our Technical Business Development Intern for Emerging Verticals in the Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development, you help us find out where. Working directly with our project lead for Emerging Verticals, who mentors you, you explore new application fields for widefield magnetic imaging. You dig into the science and the markets behind them, talk to potential customers and users, and help turn promising ideas into first feasibility studies with our magnetic field imaging system. You see how a deep tech company decides where its technology goes next, and help shape that decision. This is a full-time internship for 6 months, starting as soon as possible. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Why join Quantum Diamonds? Picture this: Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. Still unsure about why joining us? You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors. Let’s make the invisible visible! What will you do Map and evaluate application areas for magnetic field imaging beyond semiconductors: key players, customer segments and structured comparisons of use cases. Review scientific literature and patents to understand the state of the art, competing measurement methods, and where NV-based imaging offers a real advantage. Prepare and join discovery conversations with researchers and companies to understand their measurement challenges, and keep contacts and opportunities up to date in our CRM. Support feasibility studies with our experts, from defining suitable samples to interpreting first measurement results. Turn your findings into clear deliverables such as application one-pagers, decision memos, and presentations. What is expected of you Enrolled in or recently graduated from a degree program in physics, engineering, materials science, chemistry, biophysics, or a related natural science or engineering field, ideally with some Python exposure. Available full time for 6 months, starting as soon as possible. Curiosity about how a new measurement technology can solve problems in fields you may not know yet. Clear writing and structured analysis: you turn a pile of papers and conversations into a one-page recommendation. AI tools are part of how you research, analyze and write, and you check their output the way you check your own. Fluent in English. On-site in Munich. Business studies or first experience in market research, consulting, or a startup is a plus, not required. Our benefits Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual. Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast. Mentoring: An experienced colleague from the team mentors you throughout your internship. Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active. Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment. Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 24 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired. About us QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act. title: Director, Sales (Nordics & Eastern Europe)
description: About Ping Identity: At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. The Sales Director will be tasked with influencing and developing an energized, competitive, high impact sales team that is characterized by its ability to create differentiated value for our customer base. We're looking for a seasoned leader from within the SaaS enterprise marketplace, with proven software solution selling combined with success in a fast growth business. This leader will be a model to drive the team in building extraordinary customer relationships and experiences, leveraging a strong teamwork approach, and cross matrix collaboration across all Ping functions. This role will demonstrate a depth of understanding when working alongside a partner community and posess a well-established customer and partner network in the Nordics & Eastern Europe regions. In order to acquire, develop and retain customer relationships and create a winning Ping business, this leader will be able to create and maintain a high-performance culture, that is grounded in data, transparency, accountability, and agility. The ideal candidate's mindset should be customer-focused, people-oriented, open, passionate, and authentic. Responsibilities: Creates, implements, measures and reviews a strategic or operational plan that drives achievement of business goals aligned to overall Ping strategy Uses mechanisms such as territory planning, account plans, opportunity inspection, pipeline management, account reviews, forecast calls, etc. Advises and coaches the sales team around how to position and articulate Ping Identity's value proposition at enterprise customers, thus increasing the average deal size Identifies and pursues opportunities to expand business activities within areas of responsibility Leverages GSIs & other partners to help source, develop and progress business Plans and controls the expense associated with the area of responsibility even if not responsible for overall cost center Establishes working relationships with external parties which supports the achievement of business goals Is conversant with Ping Identity's systems and procedures and ensures effective use of and conformance to standard business practices and tools (i.e. SFDC – SalesForce.com) Communicates Ping Identity's vision and aligns team and personal goals to achieve business results Provides direction and guidance, mentoring and development of the field team Lives teamwork and promotes cross-functional collaboration Recruits, builds and develops the team to deliver business results; Identifies, develops and promotes high potential employees Recommends and/or approves people-related decisions – hiring, promotions, merit increases, rewards & recognition, training initiatives, etc. Drives performance review and development planning process with annual and quarterly review meetings Has established multi-vertical C level contacts in large enterprise customers Has an established partner/SI network and is used to working with partners on projects Builds relationships with customers (internal or external) as necessary providing customer escalation management as necessary for problem resolution Provides support for customer relationship management as necessary and drives initiatives which result in improvement in customer satisfaction Drives initiatives which result in improvement in customer satisfaction Required Skills & Qualifications: Proven experience of successfully leading sales teams focused on the Nordics & Eastern Europe Expertise in enterprise software, SaaS, managed services and strategic account management Results-oriented with multiple years meeting or exceeding quota Flexibility to travel to across the regions Transitioned a team through on-prem to SaaS solutions Adept working in a fast-growing global organization Good interpersonal skills to align and foster positive working relationships across the organization Eligibility to work in the Netherlands or Norway Life at Ping: We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We're growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that's who we want to succeed with every day. Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special: A company culture that empowers you to do your best work. Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone. title: Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing - alternance
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p><strong>Pourquoi Deliveroo ?</strong></p> <p>Lorsque l'on vous dit Deliveroo, vous imaginez sans doute d'abord les bons petits plats livrés chez vous en moins d'une demi-heure. Plutôt sympa non ? Mais c'est en coulisses que l'histoire est la plus intéressante. Nous opérons désormais à travers le monde et travaillons avec plus de 176 000 restaurants partenaires et commerces en tous genres en France. Nous collaborons avec des milliers de livreurs et de livreuses partenaires pour le plus grand bonheur de nos millions de personnes clientes.</p> <p>Nous recherchons un·e Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing Merchant en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing à Paris, pour une durée de 12 mois. Aux côtés de l'équipe Merchant, vous contribuerez au développement de la croissance de nos partenaires, au déploiement de nos campagnes nationales 360° et en accompagnerez des projets à fort impact sur l'acquisition, la rétention et la fidélisation de nos restaurants partenaires.</p> <p><strong>Descriptif du poste :</strong></p> <p>En tant qu’Apprenti(e) dans l’équipe Marketing Merchant Restaurant, vous travaillerez au quotidien avec l'équipe marketing chargée de mettre en avant toute la sélection de restaurants et de partenaires de Deliveroo. Vous serez également amené(e) à <strong>interagir régulièrement avec les autres départements marketing </strong>tels que l’équipe média, l’équipe créative, le CRM ainsi qu’avec l’<strong>équipe commerciale. </strong></p> <p><strong>Vos missions consisteront à:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Mettre en avant sur l’application les restaurants et partenaires disponibles sur l’app.</li> <li>Soutenir l’équipe commerciale dans la création et l’exécution de plans marketing destinés à mettre en avant les partenaires présents sur Deliveroo.  </li> <li>Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe commerciale et les équipes marketing transversales (marque, réseaux sociaux, CRM et influenceurs) pour développer et exécuter des plans partenaires basés sur les priorités commerciales (par exemple, objectifs régionaux, accords d'exclusivité, renégociations).</li> <li>Préparer des présentations et des supports pour appuyer les discussions de l'équipe commerciale avec les partenaires, en veillant à l'alignement et à la clarté.</li> <li>Contribuer à l’exécution des points forts des partenaires en collaboration avec le CRM et le Commercial (communications mensuelles d'exclusivité / bannières dédiées sur l’application / notifications push...).</li> <li>Gérer le budget alloué pour le plan de chaque partenaire, en optimisant les ressources locales pour obtenir un impact maximal. </li> <li>Analyser l’impact de nos campagnes pour en tirer des recommandations pour les équipes commerciales</li> </ul> <p>Cette alternance vous permettra d'appréhender de nombreux sujets marketing (création de campagne, analyse, sensibilité client) et vous permettra d'acquérir une bonne connaissance des enjeux marketing et de la gestion de projets complexes grâce à la collaboration transverse que vous aurez avec les autres pôles. </p> <p><strong>Ce qui vous permettra de réussir</strong></p> <p>Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en école de commerce, université ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en marketing, communication ou digital et recherchez une alternance d'une durée d'un an à partir de Décembre 2026 / Janvier 2027.</p> <p><strong>Vous Vous Reconnaissez Dans Les Points Suivants</strong></p> <ul> <li>Vous êtes organisé·e, rigoureux·se et savez gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle en respectant les délais</li> <li>Vous avez une excellente communication écrite et orale en français ainsi qu'un bon niveau d'anglais.</li> <li>Vous êtes à l'aise avec les chiffres et aimez analyser les performances pour en tirer des recommandations.</li> <li>Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et la coordination de nombreux interlocuteurs.</li> <li>Vous êtes curieux·se, proactif·ve et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et en forte croissance.</li> </ul> <p>Voici un<a href="https://sites.google.com/deliveroo.co.uk/biz-interview-guide/home?authuser=0"> lien</a> avec de la documentation pour vous préparer aux entretiens.</p> <p>Nous offrons un environnement de travail dynamique et stimulant, où vous aurez l'opportunité de développer vos compétences et de contribuer activement à notre mission. Rejoignez notre équipe exceptionnelle dès maintenant et faites partie de cette aventure passionnante !</p> <p><strong>La vie chez Deliveroo :</strong></p> <p>Notre équipe est en forte croissance, notre impact très important, et nous cherchons à répondre aux questions les plus stimulantes du moment. Nous progressons rapidement, nous explorons toujours de nouvelles idées et nous sommes très transparents quant aux décisions que nous prenons et à ce qui motive nos choix.</p> <p>Il y a tellement de questions que nous souhaitons résoudre, et encore plus que nous n'avons pas encore rencontrées. Comment les données et la technologie peuvent-elles aider les restaurants à développer leur activité à mesure que les habitudes des consommateurs évoluent ? Comment pouvons-nous prédire ce qu'une personne souhaitera pour dîner avant même que l'idée ne lui vienne à l'esprit ? Chez Deliveroo, ces questions ne sont que quelques-uns des défis ambitieux auxquels nous nous efforçons de répondre – et il n'y a aucun projet qui ne peut pas devenir le vôtre. Aucune solution n'appartient à une équipe en particulier, ce qui vous ouvre d'extraordinaires possibilités en termes de développement et d'impact personnel.</p> <p><em>À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l’article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s’engage en faveur de la diversité, l’égalité professionnelle, l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.</p> <p>We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.</p> <p>If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a <em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none"><strong>Our Markets & Transactions team is looking for a Senior Consultant / Manager to join the team in Amsterdam</strong>.</span> </span></h2> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none"><span class="TextRun SCXW92380952 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW92380952 BCX8">Baringa’s </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW92380952 BCX8">market</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW92380952 BCX8">-</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW92380952 BCX8">leading Power </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW92380952 BCX8">Market </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW92380952 BCX8">A</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW92380952 BCX8">dvisory</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW92380952 BCX8"> practice works with clients across the energy value chain</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW92380952 BCX8">: </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW92380952 BCX8">utilities, independent power producers, developers, network companies, commodity traders, industrials, investors, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW92380952 BCX8">policymakers</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW92380952 BCX8"> and regulators. title: Senior Privacy Counsel, Germany
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.</p></div><p>As part of Waymo's Legal team, you will work on the exciting legal issues surrounding our transformational autonomous driving technology and help drive our business lines forward from technology ideation through scaled commercial deployment. We partner with our public policy, safety, security and privacy experts to define transportation policy for the autonomous driving world to come, advising on regulatory changes that support and protect our users around the world. We collaborate with our engineering, product, strategy and operations teams to develop and protect our intellectual property portfolio and drive our corporate and commercial transactions. We ensure compliance with an increasingly complex and dynamic range of global regulations. And we anticipate, mitigate, and litigate high-profile and precedent-setting legal matters.</p> <p><em>In this hybrid role, you will report into our Managing Counsel. </em></p> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary, on-the-ground Privacy Counsel for Waymo's operations, product launches, and engineering initiatives across Germany and the broader EU, acting as a trusted advisor to ensure compliance with GDPR, ePrivacy, and local laws like the BDSG.</li> <li>Advise on "Privacy by Design" and data minimization principles for European market entry, working directly with Product, Engineering, and AI/ML teams to design innovative privacy solutions for complex sensor data and model training.    </li> <li>Proactively build and maintain constructive relationships with EU Data Protection Authorities (DPAs), acting as the primary legal contact for regulatory inquiries, data protection impact assessments (DPIAs), audits, and ongoing local engagement.    </li> <li>Lead rapid, localized legal response for any EU data incidents, coordinating internal investigations and compliance reviews, managing strict notification timelines, and mitigating regulatory risk.    </li> <li>Partner with Waymo’s Public Policy, Trust & Safety, and Regulatory Affairs teams to monitor, review, and help shape emerging European privacy legislation, developing advocacy strategies to influence policy changes that support responsible innovation.    </li> </ul> <p><strong>You have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A Juris Doctor (or equivalent law degree) and active qualification to practice law in Germany (e.g., Volljurist) or another relevant EU jurisdiction.    </li> <li>8+ years of legal experience with significant expertise in European privacy, data protection, and regulatory compliance, preferably in-house at a global technology company.    </li> <li>Deep, practical expertise in the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and German national data protection laws (BDSG), with a track record of operationalizing these frameworks for complex data flows.    </li> <li>Direct experience engaging with European Data Protection Authorities (DPAs) and working with government or regulatory bodies to navigate rulemaking processes and compliance readiness.    </li> <li>Experience advising on cross-border data transfers, international data governance, and translating strict legal requirements into practical engineering specifications.    </li> <li>Professional fluency in both German and English, with exceptional ability to communicate legal risks clearly to leadership and technical teams in the face of ambiguity.    </li> </ul> <p><strong>We prefer:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recognized European privacy certifications, such as CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT.    </li> <li>Prior in-house experience at a US-based multinational technology company, autonomous vehicle developer, or AI-focused enterprise navigating EU expansion.    </li> <li>Hands-on experience advising on the intersection of GDPR with emerging European technology and data regulations (e.g., the AI Act, Data Act), including experience providing counsel on proposed legislation.    </li> <li>Experience structuring and defending main establishment strategies (One-Stop-Shop) and data transfer frameworks for EU resident data.    </li> <li>Background in responding to privacy litigation, localized incident response, or managing comprehensive privacy compliance audits.    </li> <li>A technical background or strong fluency in data infrastructure, cloud computing, title: Deployment Strategist - German Speaking
description: About HappyRobot HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide. Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. Role Overview We are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our team. In this role, you'll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) across the full deployment lifecycle, from first discovery conversation to live production. You'll lead use case discovery and scoping with senior customer stakeholders, ship prototypes hands-on to prove value early, then stay close to the build through delivery to bring the strategic, business-value lens to every decision. You're the partner who keeps the work pointed at the highest-impact outcomes, ready to pick up the keyboard alongside the FDE when the moment calls for it. We're looking for engineers with strategic instincts: people who can write code, but whose deepest strength is the strategic, opinionated lens they bring across every phase of a deployment - spotting where value lives, scoping it realistically, and partnering with engineers to capture it from prototype to production. At HappyRobot, there's no role seniority or hierarchy. We operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success. What You'll do Strategic Leadership and Use Case Discovery: Partner with Global and Regional C-Level executives and VPs to assess AI opportunities and prioritize the highest-impact use cases. Lead curiosity-driven discovery that surfaces the workflows where AI creates the most business value, well beyond what the customer thought to ask for. Build the trusted relationships that let you present findings and challenge assumptions at the most senior levels, keeping technical delivery aligned with their business priorities. Scoping : Frame impact versus effort with rigor on both axes. On business value, pressure-test the realistic upside, question whether the use case as posed will actually deliver the most impact, and explore whether reframing it or pivoting to an adjacent process would unlock more. The art is deeply understanding how to maximize value of this use case for the customer, not just delivering what was asked for. On technical effort, map integrations, data, and platform constraints, and surface the edge cases and dependencies that shape timelines. Land on a plan that's realistic on both. Prototyping : Build prototypes and demos hands-on. Use our platform and AI-powered coding tools to test ideas end-to-end at light scope. Prove value early, before the customer commits. Program Management : Coordinate work across the active deployments in an account. Be the escalation point for the customer and the watchout partner for the FDE. Stay close enough to the build that you both understand the use case deeply, spot opportunities to capture more value, and catch when work is drifting from the highest-impact path. Prioritization : Sequence use cases within an account so each deployment compounds the next. Make the call on what gets built when, what gets parked, and where to invest discovery and building time. Customer Partnership : Be the main business-side point of contact for the account. Build trust with operational and executive stakeholders day-to-day. Translate AI capabilities into language they can act on. Onsite Embedding : Travel onsite for kickoffs, mapping sessions, and key moments where being on the ground changes the outcome. Product Feedback Loop : Bring field signal back to Product and Engineering. Identify reusable patterns, common edge cases, and where the platform needs to evolve. Must Have Background that mixes technical depth with strategic instinct, and a real history of building things. Common paths include engineering (Computer Science, electrical, industrial, systems), data science, founding a tech startup, product management, or technical / strategic consulting. Drive account expansion through timely up-sell and cross-sell opportunities, maximizing value delivered to our customers. Partner with global peers to collaborate on multi-region and strategic global accounts with long-term growth potential. Collaborate with internal sales engineers, product experts, customer success, and marketing, as well as partner channels, to expand your reach and velocity. Stay ahead of industry shifts and translate emerging challenges into opportunities for Elliptic’s solution suite. title: Supply Chain Manager
description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Supply Chain Manager (m/f/d) at Filics, you will build the supply chain that takes the robots into series production. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics robots are built from hundreds of components. Many come from a single source, and most aren’t under contract yet. Moving from prototypes to series production, one missing part can stop the whole line. Your job is to build a robust supply chain from scratch. It needs to know exactly what Filics depends on, secure those parts before they become a risk, and hold up as volumes grow, all while production is already running. You take full ownership of how every component is sourced, secured and managed. You’ll work closely with Engineering, which owns the technical specs and qualifies suppliers and alternative components. Assembly depends on reliable supply to plan builds. Leadership sets volume commitments based on your analysis. What you’ll do Identify critical dependencies, lock in availability through supplier contracts, and qualify alternatives so no single source can stop production Set up the ERP and the systems the supply chain runs on, including supplier quality tracking Define clear quality criteria for suppliers and components together with Engineering Give the assembly team the forward visibility they need to plan builds Turn supply analysis into input for Leadership’s volume commitments Once supply is robust, reduce component prices toward a leaner bill of materials About you Several years in supply chain , procurement or sourcing for hardware products (e.g. robotics, automotive, machinery, electronics) Proven experience moving products from prototype to series production A solid grasp of BOMs, component sourcing, supplier qualification and supplier quality Strong negotiation skills and experience closing supplier contracts A hands-on, structured approach: you prioritize well, work comfortably without defined processes, and deliver Clear, concise communication in English and German What Filics offers Full ownership of a function you build yourself, with direct impact on getting the robots into series production A small, ambitious team where initiative leads to responsibility Work on a first-of-its-kind product in intralogistics An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly Sound like you? title: Pricing & Deal Desk Manager (m/f/d)
description: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next. We're hiring a Pricing & Deal Desk Manager within the Revenue Operations team. You'd take ownership of one of Moss's highest-leverage commercial functions: the pricing deal desk. It's already delivered real results, and it matters more every quarter as deal volume grows and Moss moves into bigger, more complex deals. What makes the role unusual is that the desk already runs on AI. An agent picks up each request, pulls the deal's scoring and call history, calculates margin, and drafts a reasoned reply; you approve, correct, or overrule it. So the job is two things at once: the reviewer who decides live deals, and the person who builds & improves the AI-based deal desk agent Your responsibilities Own the day-to-day approval flow for non-standard pricing, discounts, and commercial terms, acting as the fast, consistent escalation point for reps without slowing deals down. Build and evolve pricing governance, including discount rules, approval thresholds, and playbooks, converting recurring exceptions into documented policy. Drive deal health across the funnel: discount discipline, price realization, deal structure, and win rate by segment, diagnosing where deals leak value and fixing it. Translate customer segmentation into differentiated pricing guidance and deal strategies, partnering with Sales to get it applied in real deals, and getting it into the ruleset so it's applied consistently. Coach reps on pricing confidence and value-based selling Partner with Customer Success to adapt the pricing and deal playbook for consistency after the sale. About you Proven experience in a deal desk, pricing, commercial, revenue operations, or sales-strategy role, ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech. Experience standing up or scaling a deal desk or pricing process from scratch is a plus. Strong analytical toolkit, including SQL and/or advanced spreadsheet modeling. The ability to leverage AI to build a scalable Pricing Deal Desk model, or the appetite to learn it. The direction is a low-touch desk: the agent executes the rules, its output gets better as you correct it, and each additional deal costs less human attention than the last Fluent in English; German or Dutch is a plus. In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for: Comfortable holding the line with Sales on discount governance while staying a genuine partner to the team. A critical eye for AI output. The agent is sometimes confidently wrong, and catching that before a rep acts on it is part of the job. Brings commercial judgment: understands how reps sell and how price sensitivity shifts across customer segments. Structured and high-ownership, at ease in a fast, low-process, high-change environment. Able to move fluidly between detailed data analysis and higher-level strategic thinking. About Moss Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work. Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star. We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA : playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect: Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos. Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits. Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package). By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy . Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: ZEAL Network SE is a dynamic, international group of companies that has been creating exciting and innovative lottery experiences for over 20 years. We are passionate about driving innovation, as demonstrated by our newest brands, Freiheit+ and Traumhausverlosung, which bring fresh and exciting dreams to life. Additionally, through ZEAL Ventures, we invest in inspiring e-commerce start-ups like Omaze and DAYMADE, fueling fresh ideas and opportunities. Our team of 350+ professionals from diverse backgrounds is united by a visionary mindset, a passion for collaboration, and a commitment to inspire dreams. At ZEAL, we empower our people to think ambitiously and work together toward a shared purpose: helping people imagine and achieve their aspirations. As a (Senior) Quality Engineer (f/m/d) in our Backoffice Team, you will help shape a new internal platform used across ZEAL to support business-critical operational workflows. You will join a small cross-functional team and have a high level of ownership from the start. The Backoffice integrates with a wide range of backend services and supports workflows that can have financial, operational and compliance impact. Your work will directly influence how confidently and quickly we can deliver new functionality. This is an engineering-focused quality role. You will work directly in the application codebase alongside the engineers and build the tooling, infrastructure and automated feedback loops that help the team ship safely at high speed. Your tasks: Shape and continuously improve the quality engineering strategy for the Backoffice application Design and build automated test infrastructure across unit, integration, API and end-to-end levels with a strong focus on Playwright and TypeScript Develop reusable test fixtures, test-data seeding, environment tooling, harnesses and abstractions that make realistic and repeatable testing easy. Build fast automated feedback loops and validation mechanisms that make AI-assisted development safer and more effective. Design meaningful regression coverage for critical workflows, complex permissions and scenarios with financial, operational or compliance impact Strengthen CI quality gates and improve test execution so that a green pipeline provides a strong and fast signal that changes are safe to ship. Investigate defects, flaky tests and systemic quality issues and turn findings into durable engineering improvements. Triage bug reports together with internal users, reproduce issues and turn findings into clear actions for the team. Champion a strong quality mindset across the team and challenge workflows and designs from an end-user perspective to identify usability issues and edge cases early. Foster knowledge sharing and collaboration with the wider QA community at ZEAL to exchange practices, tools and learnings. Work closely with engineers, Product, UX and backend teams to identify risks early, improve testability and build quality into the development process What you offer us: Strong software engineering skills and experience in quality engineering, test automation, SDET or a comparable engineering-focused role. Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript or JavaScript and the ability to contribute production-quality code directly to a modern web application. Experience designing and building test frameworks, tooling, harnesses, fixtures and automation infrastructure rather than only writing individual test cases Strong experience with Playwright, Cypress or a similar modern end-to-end testing framework. Good understanding of APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD pipelines and applications that integrate with multiple backend services What we offer: State-of-the-art technologies and an agile environment (Check our Tech Radar: https://lotto24.github.io/tech-radar/ ) A modern, dynamic culture grounded in the success of a leading-edge e-commerce company. A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact. Ongoing personal growth, supported by an annual development budget of €1,500 to invest in your professional development. Trust and autonomy, no micromanagement, just confidence in your ability to deliver and excel. Flexible work options with a hybrid setup focused on results. Unlimited vacation days in addition to your yearly 30-day vacation allowance. Opportunity for workations abroad using our WorkFlex tool. Monthly mobility allowance of €30 to use on the mobility option of your choice (e.g., the Deutschlandticket), plus access to a company bike leasing program. Company pension scheme, provided in partnership with Degura, to support your future financial security. Subsidized EGYM WELLPASS membership, with a contribution of only €25 per month, giving you access to a wide range of gyms and sports options across Germany. Quarterly company events, along with regular team activities and informal gatherings, a favorite being our Healthy Tuesday lunches or Treat Thursdays in the office! Sounds exciting? Great! description: About Mirakl: Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy. title: Global Director, Mid-Market Onboarding
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲𝘀 𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘂𝗱𝗯𝗲𝗱𝘀 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝗾𝘂𝗲</p> <p>At <a href="https://www.cloudbeds.com/">Cloudbeds</a>, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.</p></div><p><strong>How You'll Make an Impact:</strong></p> <p>As Global Director, Mid-Market Onboarding, you will own and scale the onboarding function for Cloudbeds' fastest-growing and most complex customer segment. You'll lead the team responsible for guiding mid-market customers from contract signature through go-live, adoption, and a clean transition to Account Management. You'll build the frameworks, standards, metrics, and team capability that make that experience world-class and repeatable at scale.</p> <p>You'll inherit a team of dedicated ICs and leads that have been experimenting with new ways to support these customers and improve their experience. Your charter is to get leadership in place and be maniacal about customer experience while building the project-management rigor that complex mid-market deployments demand. You'll be measured on onboarding velocity, deployment quality, customer satisfaction, and the long-term retention impact of a strong start.</p> <p><strong>Our Onboarding Team:</strong></p> <p>Our team is passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences and helping hoteliers succeed with Cloudbeds from day one. We build together with a test-and-learn mindset that encourages innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Every team member is valued and empowered to share feedback, ideas, and insights so we can learn, grow, and improve both as individuals and as a team. Leaders who thrive here are proactive communicators, collaborative problem-solvers, and true customer advocates who enjoy navigating complexity while building the systems and people that scale it.</p> <p><strong>What You Bring to the Team:<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, coach, and develop the Mid-Market Onboarding team — including Onboarding Project Managers and senior coaches — setting clear expectations, performance standards, growth paths, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement</li> <li>Own end-to-end onboarding outcomes for mid-market customers from sales handoff through go-live, adoption, and transition to Account Management — diagnosing and fixing execution gaps in training quality, error detection, and deployment velocity</li> <li>Build standardized onboarding frameworks, SOPs, and configuration standards for complex multi-property and 25–100+ room deployments that balance customization with scalability</li> <li>Establish and own the metrics that matter: onboarding velocity, deployment quality scores, training completion, CSAT/NPS, and early-lifecycle retention — monitoring portfolio health and intervening early on at-risk projects</li> <li>Own capacity and staffing planning for the division — forecasting demand, balancing workload across the team, and partnering with leadership on headcount decisions</li> <li>Serve as a senior escalation point for complex or at-risk mid-market deployments and partner with Account Management on clean, trust-preserving handoffs</li> <li>Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Support, Professional Services, and Account Management — bridging what gets sold and what gets delivered, and contributing to the broader strategy for how Cloudbeds serves mid-market and enterprise-adjacent customers</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Sets You Up for Success:<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years in hospitality or hospitality technology, including hands-on customer onboarding or implementation experience and team leadership (time at a hotel, hotel group, or a PMS or hospitality-tech company; OTA or travel-distribution experience on its own does not count)</li> <li>Track record of building or significantly improving onboarding and implementation functions and frameworks</li> <li>Proven people-leadership experience — hiring, coaching, and developing customer-facing teams in a distributed, global environment</li> <li>Strong project-management foundation: scope, milestones, timelines, and risk mitigation applied to complex multi-stakeholder deployments</li> <li>Deep understanding of hotel operations and the complexity of serving multi-property, mid-market hospitality customers</li> <li>Ability to move fluidly between strategy and execution — you can design the framework and roll up your sleeves to implement it</li> <li>Data-driven: comfortable with KPIs, dashboards, and using insights to drive decisions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Skills to Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Additional language fluency (Spanish, Portuguese) at a business-professional level</li> <li>Direct experience onboarding or implementing customers at a hospitality SaaS or PMS company</li> <li>Familiarity with property management systems, payments, or hospitality fintech</li> <li>Experience building onboarding or implementation functions at a scale-up stage company</li> <li>Background working with hotel management companies, small chains, or the consultant ecosystem</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Authorization: </strong>Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas. </p> <p>#LI-SD1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p>𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸 𝗔𝘂𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗿𝗶𝘇𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.</p> <p> </p> <p>𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗰𝘁 - 𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗝𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗻𝗲𝘆 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗨𝘀</p> <p>Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.</p> <p>Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.</p> <p>Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.</p></div><h2>The role</h2> <p>As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Applied AI team at Nebius Token Factory, you will own model and endpoint optimization from model artifacts through production deployment. Your work will span model internals, quantization and model compression, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, inference engines, serving architecture, and benchmarking to improve latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and cost per token while preserving quality and reliability.</p> <p>You will work with kernel and platform engineers to investigate serving problems, compare configurations, and resolve performance and quality regressions. You will evaluate model- and engine-level optimizations together with distributed inference designs, including request routing, scheduling, prefill/decode coordination, and multi-node GPU execution. Your improvements will be validated through reproducible benchmarks and safe production rollouts under real-world workloads.</p> <h2>Your responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Own optimization projects for specific model families, customer endpoints, or serving backends.</li> <li>Compare inference engines and recommend serving configurations suited to individual workloads.</li> <li>Diagnose model-quality and performance regressions during production rollouts.</li> <li>Improve LLM and VLM endpoint latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.</li> <li>Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, and NVIDIA Dynamo.</li> <li>Develop production model-compression workflows covering quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.</li> <li>Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving. For prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD), evaluate KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and capacity balancing to determine which workloads benefit from the architecture.</li> <li>Design and improve LLM request routers and scheduling policies that balance worker utilization, queueing, request characteristics, and KV-cache locality while meeting latency and reliability targets.</li> <li>Scale dense and mixture-of-experts inference across multiple GPU nodes. Select and tune tensor, pipeline, data, and expert parallelism—including wide expert parallelism (WideEP)—with attention to hardware topology, expert load balance, and communication overhead.</li> <li>Build reproducible benchmark harnesses measuring TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token. Validate architecture choices under representative traffic and consistent GPU budgets.</li> <li>Collaborate with GPU kernel and platform engineers to trace bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.</li> <li>Produce design documents, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.</li> </ul> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Strong engineering skills in Python and PyTorch.</li> <li>Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer inference.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack, such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or an equivalent internal system.</li> <li>A strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks involving KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.</li> <li>Ability to quantify trade-offs among latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost.</li> <li>Experience designing or optimizing distributed inference system architecture, with hands-on work in one or more areas such as request routing, distributed scheduling, PDD, multi-node inference, or expert parallelism.</li> <li>Strong communication and collaboration skills across research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8, INT8, INT4, NVFP4, MXFP4, AWQ, GPTQ, or SmoothQuant.</li> <li>Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-step orchestration.</li> <li>Familiarity with CUDA or Triton; the role does not require kernel engineering to be the candidate’s primary specialization.</li> <li>Contributions to open-source title: Customer Service Specialist (m/w/d) Telefonservice
description: Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen. Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen. Als Customer Service Specialist (m/w/d) Telefonservice bist du eine der ersten Stimmen, die unsere Kundinnen und Kunden hören. Du sorgst für Klarheit, Verbindlichkeit und einen professionellen ersten Eindruck – und stellst sicher, dass sich unsere Kund:innen jederzeit gut aufgehoben fühlen. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Marketing und unseren technischen Teams zusammen und trägst maßgeblich zur Kundenzufriedenheit bei. Deine Aufgaben Entgegennahme und Bearbeitung eingehender Kundenanrufe als zentraler, telefonischer Erstkontakt. Aktive Nachverfolgung von Kundenanliegen per Rückruf (Outbound), wenn eine Klärung es erfordert. Direkte, strukturierte Lösung von Anliegen am Telefon – von allgemeinen Fragen bis zu spezifischen Problemen. Einhaltung von Service-Levels (Erreichbarkeit, Anrufannahme, Bearbeitungszeit) mit klaren Zielwerten. Lückenlose Dokumentation jedes Gesprächs im CRM-System direkt im Anschluss an den Call. Enge Abstimmung mit Sales, Marketing und technischen Berater:innen zur Sicherstellung der Kundenzufriedenheit. Mitwirkung an der Optimierung von Gesprächsleitfäden, Skripten und Telefonie-Prozessen. Dein Profil Erfahrung im telefonischen Kundenkontakt, z. B. im Kundenservice, Inside Sales, Vertrieb oder in der Bestandskundenbetreuung. Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Tools. Fließendes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift (C2). Zusätzlich sind uns folgende Fähigkeiten und Eigenschaften wichtig: Methodical Thinker: Du arbeitest strukturiert, datenbasiert und lösungsorientiert und gehst Prioritäten ruhig und systematisch an. Proactive Problem Solver: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Lösungen, denkst einen Schritt weiter und hilfst dabei, Probleme nachhaltig zu vermeiden. Clear Communicator: Du erklärst auch komplexe Themen klar, verständlich und verbindlich am Telefon – und bleibst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen souverän. Customer Oriented: Du versetzt dich in die Situation unserer Kund:innen, verstehst ihre Bedürfnisse und findest zügig passende Lösungen. Quick Learner: Du eignest dir neue Produkte, Prozesse und Technologien schnell an und hast Freude daran, dazuzulernen – auch im Zusammenspiel mit internen Abläufen und Kundensystemen. description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles.
