title: Head of Finance & Administration
description: The role H55 is looking for a versatile and hands on Head of Finance & Administration to lead its corporate functions and ensure the effective running of its Swiss site. This broad leadership role combines a solid finance background with strong corporate governance and practical operational management. Working closely with the CEO and leadership team, you will connect people, priorities and resources, providing the structure and support needed to deliver the company’s business objectives. You will develop a thorough understanding of H55’s corporate framework, including its shareholder arrangements, financing agreements and key contractual commitments, and translate these obligations into clear responsibilities, practical policies and timely action. You will oversee finance, HR, IT, facilities and general administration, supported by internal specialists and external partners. As a central point of coordination for Swiss site matters, you will help teams resolve operational issues, improve ways of working and ensure corporate services meet the needs of the business. Key responsibilities Corporate governance and administration Coordinate Board and shareholder matters with the CEO and legal counsel, including meeting preparation, resolutions, corporate records and follow through on decisions. Maintain a clear overview of the company’s corporate structure, shareholder arrangements, financing agreements and material contractual commitments. Track related obligations and deadlines, ensuring clear ownership and timely action across relevant functions. Ensure governance requirements, delegated authorities and approval processes are understood and applied. Manage relationships with external legal advisers, insurers and corporate service providers. Policies, compliance and internal controls Coordinate the development, implementation and review of company policies in line with business needs, investor commitments and applicable requirements. Work with functional owners on anti corruption, cybersecurity and incident response, related party transactions, internal financial controls, global trade controls, personal data protection, and health and safety. Translate policies into practical procedures, with clear responsibilities and guidance for employees and managers. Coordinate communication and training, maintaining appropriate records. Monitor implementation, address gaps with relevant owners and bring matters requiring attention to the leadership team. Swiss site and corporate services Coordinate Swiss site administration and corporate support activities, working closely with production, engineering and other teams. Oversee facilities, workplace services and external providers, ensuring a safe and effective working environment. Help resolve site issues and coordinate improvements that support daily operations. Oversee IT services and infrastructure through internal resources and external partners. Drive improvements in digital tools, systems and administrative processes. Coordinate site procedures and business continuity arrangements with relevant specialists. HR oversight and organisational support Oversee the HR function, supporting the HR team in delivering effective people processes and reliable daily operations. Work with the CEO and managers on workforce planning, organisational changes and recruitment priorities. Ensure employment administration, payroll coordination and HR policies are managed consistently and appropriately. Support clear internal communication and effective collaboration across teams. Financial management and business support Oversee budgeting, forecasting, cash flow planning and financial reporting, supported by internal finance resources and external partners. Ensure reliable accounting, statutory reporting, tax and audit processes. Provide clear financial visibility to support business decisions and resource allocation. Maintain appropriate financial controls, spending discipline and approval processes. Monitor costs and commitments with budget owners and programme teams. Support investor reporting, financing activities and due diligence when required. Leadership and continuous improvement Lead and support a small multidisciplinary team, coordinating external expertise where needed. Set priorities, allocate resources and ensure actions are completed. Build trusted working relationships with managers and colleagues across the organisation. Simplify processes and adapt corporate services as the business evolves. Your profile Experience in a broad finance and administration, corporate services or business operations leadership role. A solid finance background, with experience taking responsibility beyond the finance function. Strong understanding of corporate governance and confidence working with corporate documents, contractual commitments and legal advisers. Experience implementing policies and translating compliance requirements into practical ways of working. Experience coordinating site operations or corporate support functions, ideally in a technology or industrial environment. Familiarity with the Swiss business environment and relevant administrative and statutory requirements. Ability to lead across different functions, drawing on the expertise of colleagues and external partners. Sound judgement, discretion and the ability to build trust with people across the organisation. A practical, collaborative approach, with strong organisational skills and a willingness to get involved in day to day matters. Fluent English and French. You decide what gets delivered, what gets flagged, and what gets re-run. Judge the curves, not just the numbers. A clean-looking Kd on a bad fit is worse than no number at all. You know the difference between a real off-rate and a drifting baseline, and you can say why. Review data from our other assays too: thermostability, expression, developability, enzyme activity. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p><strong>What to Expect</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a Senior Cryogenic Engineer to support and develop advanced cryogenic platforms for our SNSPD (Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detector) product line, with a strong emphasis on next-generation rack-mountable systems.</p> <p>You will join a cross-functional team dedicated to advancing world-class quantum technologies that address some of the most complex challenges in computing, networking, and sensing. In this role, you will play a central part in the development lifecycle, overseeing cryogenic subsystems and ensuring robust, reliable 2K cryo-systems that can be deployed across internal and customer environments, while remaining maintainable and adaptable as the technology evolves.</p> <p><strong>What You'll be Doing</strong></p> <p>Working at the intersection of engineering and innovation, you will lead system-level specification, integration, and testing of cryogenic platforms tailored to SNSPD requirements. Conducting regular performance reviews with team members you will also help identifying areas for improvement/development as well as celebrating excellence, recognising team achievements, and setting goals for individual growth. </li> <li><strong>Cross-functional collaboration: </strong>collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. You will establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.</li> <li><strong>Documentation and reporting: </strong>you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you will also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excellent academic results at school and university</li> <li>Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM subject</li> <li>Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries</li> <li>Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results</li> <li>Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific</li> <li>Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration</li> <li>Experience growing and developing a CSM team</li> <li>Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Whilst English is our business language, proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, or French will be valued.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline. - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path. - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate. - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps. - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles. - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room. - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working. - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria. - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve. - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles. NICE TO HAVES: - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions. - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals. - Prior experience selling to commercial accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software. - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion. - Fluency in Dutch We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
description: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. Responsibilities Plan your sourcing. You take the bill of materials and build a sourcing plan for each commodity. You weigh criticality, lead time and single or dual source options. Find the right suppliers. You run market scans, requests for information and requests for quote. Then you shortlist the suppliers worth a closer look. Judge capability together. You work with R&D, Production, Finance and Compliance to build one clear view of what each supplier can do. Negotiate the deal. You agree pricing, volume tiers, tooling and payment terms. You also set up the NDAs, supply agreements and long-term agreements that back them. Set suppliers up properly. You onboard new suppliers and keep vendor data, price breaks and lead times current in our ERP system. Lead supplier qualification. You coordinate our tiered qualification process, including quality agreements and first-article inspections. Audit on site and remotely. You check suppliers for quality management, traceability and compliance. You also screen them against trade compliance requirements. Keep builds moving. You place and expedite orders for prototype, validation, pilot and pre-series builds. You track supplier performance on delivery, price and quality. Bring costs down. You work with suppliers on cost reduction, using should-cost and landed-cost models. Grow our supplier base. You qualify suppliers for additional production sites and regions, reusing existing qualification records. Make it repeatable. You document sourcing processes, templates and playbooks, so the purchasing team can take over mature suppliers. Requirements You have 6+ years in sourcing, purchasing or new product introduction for hardware products, across a variety of product types, complexities and technologies. You can read technical drawings and specifications, and you work closely with engineers. You’re willing to travel regularly, including international trips of several days. You’ve audited suppliers hands-on or worked within a quality management system such as ISO 9001. You have working knowledge of trade compliance rules. You’ve used an ERP system for purchasing and vendor data. You have a qualification in engineering, supply chain, business or a related field. You communicate excellently in English and build good working relationships with colleagues and suppliers. Plus Experience in aerospace, drones or other safety-critical products Experience sourcing custom electromechanical parts such as plastic parts, motors, batteries and avionics Experience qualifying suppliers for production in more than one region Experience with supplier scorecards and performance reporting If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you. title: Ingénieur Sécurité des Procédés - Process Safety Engineer (H/F)
description: 📜 Contexte Dans le cadre du renforcement de l'équipe Sécurité des Procédés d'un site industriel situé à Genève, Suisse , nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés (H/F) afin de contribuer à la maîtrise des risques liés aux procédés chimiques et à la sécurité des opérations industrielles. Rattaché(e) au Département HSE / Sécurité des Procédés , vous évoluerez dans un environnement industriel exigeant et apporterez un support technique aux équipes de Production, de Maintenance et d'Ingénierie. Vous contribuerez à l'identification, à l'évaluation et à la maîtrise des risques procédés sur les installations existantes, les modifications techniques et les nouveaux projets. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes EHS, Ingénierie, Production et Maintenance , ainsi qu'avec des interlocuteurs externes et les autorités locales lorsque nécessaire. Vos missions 🎯 Responsabilités 🔹 Analyse des risques procédés • Réaliser et mettre à jour les analyses de risques procédés, notamment les études HAZOP, What-If et LOPA . • Identifier les scénarios de risques potentiels et recommander les mesures de prévention et de protection adaptées. • Contribuer aux études de sécurité des installations existantes et des nouveaux projets. 🔹 Sécurité thermique & analyse technique • Interpréter les résultats d'essais de sécurité thermique tels que DSC, C80 et RC1 . • Identifier des solutions concrètes pour maîtriser les risques liés aux réactions chimiques et aux procédés industriels. • Analyser des données techniques complexes et formuler des recommandations claires. 🔹 Ingénierie & projets industriels • Participer aux revues de conception des équipements et des installations industrielles. • Contribuer aux projets d'investissement et aux modifications d'installations sous l'angle de la sécurité des procédés. • Veiller à la prise en compte des exigences de sécurité tout au long de la conception. 🔹 Gestion du changement & conformité • Participer aux processus de gestion du changement (MOC) . • Évaluer l'impact sécurité procédés des modifications techniques et vérifier leur conformité aux exigences applicables. • Soutenir la mise en œuvre et le suivi des standards de sécurité des procédés conformément à la politique EHS de l'entreprise. 🔹 Support aux opérations & à la maintenance • Apporter un support technique aux équipes d'exploitation et de maintenance sur les sujets de sécurité des procédés. • Apporter votre expertise sur des thématiques telles que l'inertage, les pressions, les températures et les compatibilités chimiques . • Accompagner les équipes dans la mise en œuvre des bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés. 🔹 Audits, réglementation & études de sécurité • Participer aux audits et inspections de conformité réglementaire. • Contribuer aux analyses quantitatives des risques (QRA) , aux études de protection contre les explosions et aux autres évaluations de sécurité. • Veiller au respect des standards et réglementations applicables en matière de sécurité des procédés. 🔹 Formation & sensibilisation • Former et sensibiliser le personnel aux principes et bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés. • Promouvoir une culture forte de la sécurité des procédés sur le site. • Communiquer les exigences réglementaires et techniques aux interlocuteurs concernés. Vos compétences 💼 Votre profil • Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master en génie chimique, chimie ou domaine équivalent . • Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en sécurité des procédés dans un environnement industriel chimique ou pharmaceutique. • Expérience confirmée dans la réalisation d'études de sécurité des procédés. • Maîtrise des méthodologies HAZOP, LOPA, SIL et ATEX . • Bonne connaissance des standards internationaux de sécurité des procédés tels que API, CCPS, IEC 61511 et SEVESO . • Capacité à lire et interpréter des P&ID, schémas de procédé et spécifications d'équipements . • Fortes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec l'aptitude à synthétiser des informations techniques complexes. • Excellentes qualités de communication et capacités pédagogiques. • Esprit d'équipe, proactivité et autonomie. • Français courant et bon anglais technique , notamment pour la lecture et la rédaction de documents HSE internationaux. title: Performance Marketing Manager
description: Why we do what we do The mind is our window to the world. It can paint everything outside in grey or in bright colors. Whoever finds access to that window can change their perspective every day, and psychological hurdles can become chances to grow. Happiness spreads from one person to the next and across a whole society, like a quiet revolution, one mind at a time. Who we are Our mission inspires us and challenges us. Our skills, thoughts and ideas go into a product that reaches thousands of people, and that brings responsibility with it. The work asks for passion, integrity and the courage to try things no one has tried before. A team full of people who are crazy enough to think they can change the world they live in. Yes, we are a hardworking team, but not for us alone, not for money or personal fame, but for the people we serve at the center of our efforts: Our team, clients, psychologists on our platform and supporters across the country. Why this role exists Aepsy serves three audiences, each with its own timeline. Clients need support now. Psychologists are building their practice. Employers are deciding whether to unlock access for their whole team. This role leads performance marketing for all three: how people find Aepsy, what actually works, and what the numbers suggest we do next. Marketing at Aepsy is a small, focused team, and every role has a clear place in it. The Creative Marketing Lead owns copy and shapes the campaigns. The Art Director builds the visual language. The Growth Performance Architect owns the measurement architecture. You work closely with all three, bringing campaigns to the right people through the right channels, finding out what worked, and helping the team decide what to keep, change or stop. Performance with principles Our values shape how we advertise. Privacy is non-negotiable. Anyone visiting a mental health platform deserves the highest level of privacy and data security. That means no urgency or fear in our messages, no before-and-after claims, and no targeting or retargeting based on health data or other sensitive personal information. Sometimes this makes a number harder to reach. It also builds trust that lasts, and that trust is why people choose Aepsy. If strong performance combined with strong principles sounds like the challenge you’ve been looking for, we’d love to hear from you. What you’ll do Own performance across all funnels. Clients may decide within days. Employers take longer and involve several people. Together with the colleagues closest to each audience, you define what success means for each one. Run paid media end to end on Meta, Google, TikTok and LinkedIn. That covers structure, bidding, audiences, creative rotation, and both awareness and conversion, plus the judgement to know which of the two you’re working on. Read the numbers and get more out of them. The Growth Performance Architect builds the measurement setup with you. You turn it into insights the team can act on. Turn patterns into decisions. Why do people who considered Aepsy drop off before deciding? Does the response to a creative suggest it should run weekly rather than monthly? Answering questions like these is the core of the role. Shape how people find support. Search is changing fast, and new ways of discovering things are emerging. You’ll help decide how people find Aepsy when they need it most. Help build the team’s marketing rhythm. You’ll set up the flow for campaigns, newsletters and more, from first idea to delivery, so the whole team can rely on it. What you bring Three to four years in performance marketing, including campaigns you’ve run end to end and at least one that didn’t go as planned and taught you something. A data-driven mindset with a real feel for brand and content. Confidence running Meta and Google on your own, and experience with TikTok or LinkedIn for reaching HR leads and psychologists. Bring the channels you’ve found work best. Judgement that weighs data together with values. The field is sensitive, Switzerland is a small multilingual market, and the mission matters. Fluent (Swiss) German and English. Aepsy works in four languages, German is the largest market, and most partners and HR leads communicate in German. A habit of noticing a step that repeats and improving it, using AI in your daily work. Strongly preferred SEO and GEO basics, and curiosity about how AI search engines choose which sources to cite. Lifecycle marketing experience: segmentation, triggers and deliverability. Experience at an organisation with strong convictions, and enjoyment of doing great work within clear principles. What we offer Work that matters. Every campaign you improve helps someone find support a little sooner. Your skills serve something bigger than a conversion rate. A team that has your back. The Creative Marketing Lead, Art Director, Growth Performance Architect and Head of Marketing are each strong in their field. You’ll never have to face a number alone. A strong foundation. You’ll build on a product people trust, a network of qualified psychologists, partnerships with employers and insurers, and values clear enough to make hard decisions easier. Room to shape things. There are three audiences, several funnels, a content area being rebuilt, and a search landscape that AI is changing. Your ideas will have impact, and you’ll see it. A short line to decisions. You’ll report directly to the Head of Marketing and have access to leadership strategy. Modern tools , including AI, and the freedom to use them well. Time to recharge : five weeks of holiday and a mental health benefit (of course). Together with us We’re a young, ambitious team with diverse backgrounds and beliefs. We love conversations about the big picture and about the small details. We believe in what we do and work hard for a slightly better world. We’re also friends, parents, partners, stand-up comedians, yoga beginners and Zen monks who enjoy life. Sleep on it. Read it again. Then take a deep breath and send us: Your CV and a personal cover letter . We read every letter carefully, so tell us what motivates you, why this mission matters to you, and why this role, right now. Whatever shows your thinking best . A short note is enough. One campaign you can explain well is worth more than a full portfolio. In our conversation we’ll be curious about two things: a number that proved you wrong, and something you decided to stop doing. PS: Please skip the generic, AI-generated cover letter. A few honest lines in your own words mean much more to us. The time you save is better spent in the sun, on a walk in the forest or with a friend. Life is too beautiful for impersonal cover letters :) Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

evolving Technical Program Management best practices.<br><br><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead 1–3 strategic technical programs at a time spanning multiple engineering teams and product stages, ensuring clear scope, priorities, and outcomes.</li> <li>Partner with engineering leaders and other key stakeholders to align on goals, timelines, and delivery milestones for cross functional initiatives.</li> <li>Own end-to-end program planning and execution, from initial discovery and scoping through delivery, measurement, and retrospectives.</li> <li>Drive asynchronous collaboration using GitLab issues, epics, and handbook updates so globally distributed teams stay aligned and informed.</li> <li>Identify risks and blockers early, coordinate resolution across teams, and escalate when needed to maintain momentum.</li> <li>Facilitate working group meetings and async discussions to support decision-making, surface tradeoffs, and keep programs on track.</li> <li>Track and communicate program health through metrics, dashboards, and regular status updates to provide visibility to the Engineering Division and partners.</li> <li>Contribute to evolving Technical Program Management practices by documenting processes, sharing learnings, and improving how R&D programs run across GitLab.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in technical program management, project management, software engineering, or similar technical roles.</li> <li>Understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile ways of working, including how engineering teams plan, build, and ship.</li> <li>Skill in coordinating programs across multiple engineering teams or departments, aligning stakeholders on goals, timelines, and milestones.</li> <li>Strong written communication skills for asynchronous, documentation-first collaboration in a fully remote environment.</li> <li>Ability to work independently in a distributed setting, set priorities, and make progress with minimal supervision.</li> <li>Comfortable navigating ambiguity, identifying blockers, and proposing practical solutions to keep programs moving.</li> <li>Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, or platforms like GitLab, with interest in deepening this knowledge over time.</li> <li>Openness to learning, iterating based on feedback, and applying transferable skills from varied backgrounds to technical program management.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong><br>You’ll join the R&D organization as part of the Technical Program Management function, a small, cross-functional team that leads high-impact programs spanning multiple product stages and departments. The team focuses on driving clarity, alignment, and predictable delivery for complex initiatives that touch many parts of GitLab, using a handbook-first, asynchronous way of working with stakeholders across regions and time zones. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. plans for managers and individual contributors.</li> <li>Own GitLab’s most senior and executive-level technical searches in the region, including Vice President and C-suite-adjacent leadership roles.</li> <li>Set sourcing, talent pipeline, and market strategies for hard-to-fill roles in artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative artificial intelligence, security, infrastructure, with People Business Partners, Compensation, Finance, and other recruiting leaders on headcount strategy, process improvements, tooling decisions, and company-wide talent priorities.</li> <li>Champion diversity, inclusion, and belonging, strengthen candidate and hiring team experiences, and build an effective operating model for all-remote collaboration across regions and time zones.</li> </ul> leadership roles in competitive markets.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of India’s technology talent market and experience setting hiring strategy across India and the broader Asia-Pacific region.</li> when advising senior leaders on recruiting strategy and priorities.</li> <li>A data-informed approach to recruiting, including experience with hiring metrics, dashboards, market intelligence, applicant tracking systems, LinkedIn Recruiter, and sourcing tools. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>This role is not a typical infrastructure operations role. As Manager, Engineering, Git & Gitaly Operations, you'll lead the team responsible for the infrastructure layer underneath Git at GitLab: the open source Git project itself, Gitaly, GitLab's Git storage and remote procedure call layer, and the services that make Git perform at enterprise scale.</p> <p>Git and Gitaly are core to GitLab. If they go sideways in production, they affect everything downstream, including continuous integration, code review, and deployments. This role starts with genuine subject matter expertise in Git technologies and extends to reliable operation across GitLab's deployment models: Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and SaaS.</p> <p>You'll build and develop a team with deep platform expertise and strong operational judgment. You'll partner across engineering groups to shape how Git and Gitaly operations evolve as the platform grows.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build and lead a team with deep platform expertise in Git and Gitaly, hiring and developing engineers who can operate this infrastructure layer with strong operational judgment.</li> <li>Own production reliability for Git and Gitaly across GitLab's full deployment footprint.</li> <li>Drive incident management, root cause investigation, and postmortems with the technical depth to distinguish a Git internals problem from a generic infrastructure problem.</li> <li>Design and operate Git and Gitaly service models that work across Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and SaaS, with a clear view of which elements are common and which must differ between them.</li> <li>Maintain cloud-agnostic architecture and tooling decisions, avoiding designs that assume a single hyperscaler's primitives.</li> <li>Partner with the teams that own each deployment model so operational practices stay coherent rather than fragmenting into separate playbooks.</li> <li>Apply distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, replication, and failure domains, to Gitaly's storage and replication model.</li> <li>Own elastic storage and compute strategy for Git repository data, including capacity planning, autoscaling, and consumption-based provisioning for GitLab's largest self-managed and SaaS customers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Familiarity with GitLab's product and deployment models, and how Git and Gitaly support repository operations across self-managed, dedicated, and SaaS environments.</li> <li>Hands-on subject matter expertise in Git internals, including how the protocol, object model, and storage layer behave under load and at scale, not only familiarity with Git usage.</li> <li>Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, replication, failure handling, and horizontal scalability.</li> <li>Experience running production infrastructure across multiple deployment models, such as self-managed, dedicated or single-tenant, and multi-tenant SaaS, or a credible path from adjacent experience to it.</li> <li>Experience with elastic storage and compute, and consumption-based system design for variable, unpredictable load.</li> <li>People management experience, ideally leading site reliability engineering-style or platform operations teams.</li> <li>Direct experience with Gitaly, libgit2, JGit, or another Git implementation's internals is advantageous.</li> <li>Experience operating cloud-agnostic infrastructure across multiple hyperscalers or on-premises environments is advantageous.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Git & Gitaly Operations team owns the Git infrastructure layer that powers GitLab and works at the intersection of Git internals, distributed systems, storage, and production operations.</p> <p>We expect the Git & Gitaly Operations team to go deep on one of GitLab's most critical platforms. The work requires technical depth, strong operational discipline, and the ability to solve complex reliability and scaling challenges in Git and Gitaly.</p> <h1><br><br></h1><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. technical and business case for productizing internal fixes that prove durable, in partnership with product.</li> <li>Document reusable learnings so successful internal fixes don’t remain tribal knowledge.</li> <li>Report impact through changes in key metrics and progress on turning internal fixes into products, including a clear account of what didn’t work.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll an internal tool toward an external, customer-facing product is advantageous.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Nonlinear Productivity team improves how GitLab engineers, and increasingly agents, build, review, and ship code. Your work will affect core components that customers, users, and GitLab teams rely on.</p> <p>Some of our projects include:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Building GATE as the centralized service for token issuance and validation</li> <li value="2">Consolidating tokens and migrating authentication paths out of the Rails monolith</li> <li value="3">Building passkeys and passwordless authentication</li> <li value="4">Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI</li> <li value="5">Improving service accounts and secure automation</li> <li value="6">Enhancing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) capabilities for automated user provisioning and single sign-on (SSO)</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab's authentication services with the team.</li> <li value="2">Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation.</li> <li value="3">Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models.</li> <li value="4">Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation.</li> <li value="5">Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.</li> <li value="6">Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review.</li> <li value="7">Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab's values in these communications.</li> <li value="8">Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE.</li> <li value="9">Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products.</li> <li value="2">Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM).</li> <li value="3">Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management.</li> <li value="4">Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution.</li> <li value="5">Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.</li> <li value="6">Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems.</li> <li value="7">Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Our mission is to empower GitLab system administrators with the toolkit they need to create their desired balance of security and accessibility for their GitLab experience.</p> <p>Authentication is the first impression a new customer has when they configure a new GitLab instance. We aim to make it as seamless as possible, from that first login to onboarding users and managing security rules for their instance in a secure, flexible, and scalable way.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. supply-chain problem.</li> <li><strong>Own What You Build in Production:</strong> Take part in on-call and incident response for the systems your teams own, act as a technical escalation point during complex incidents, and turn what you learn into architectural and operational improvements that prevent recurrence.</li> <li><strong>Influence and Partner:</strong> Shape technical direction across teams without formal authority, and partner with Product and Engineering leadership on platform-level roadmap decisions and investment trade-offs.</li> <li><strong>Grow Engineers:</strong> Mentor Adoption:</strong> Lead team-level adoption of AI-assisted and agentic workflows, including the quality, security, privacy, and operational guardrails, and help engineers direct, validate, reject, and course-correct agent output.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Cross-Team Technical Leadership:</strong> A sustained record of technical leadership across more than one team or a broad product area.</li> <li><strong>Deep Architecture Experience:</strong> Deep backend architecture and production experience in complex applications, services, or platforms, including scaling or governing APIs, service platforms, data systems, modular monoliths, or shared backend components.</li> <li><strong>Modularization in Production:</strong> Experience modernizing a monolith or legacy backend architecture in production, and with modular architecture such as bounded contexts, package encapsulation, ports and adapters, service extraction, event-driven boundaries, or an equivalent approach.</li> <li><strong>Influence Without Authority:</strong> A strong ability to create alignment through clear written proposals and decision records, so decisions are documented, understood, and adopted without constant escalation.</li> <li><strong>Product Judgment:</strong> The ability to balance customer outcomes, delivery speed, technical health, reliability, and long-term platform investment.</li> <li><strong>Mentorship:</strong> Experience mentoring engineers and shaping standards through code review, documentation, and example.</li> <li><strong>Agentic AI Leadership:</strong> Production experience with AI-assisted or agentic engineering workflows, including the ability to evaluate and improve how a team adopts them.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Helpful readiness.</li> <li>Rust adoption or production ownership for systems, security, performance, or platform components.</li> <li>Ruby/Rails modularization and large-monolith modernization.</li> More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>The Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations team manages observability, monitoring, and detection for systems that support customer purchasing and use of GitLab. As a Staff Backend Engineer on the Fulfillment Workflow Monitoring (Catch All) team, you'll set the technical direction for the telemetry, detection, and reconciliation tooling that identifies billing, data, and event anomalies across CustomersDot, Salesforce, and Zuora before they can affect revenue or the customer experience.</p> <p>This is a greenfield team. You'll help build it from the ground up, shaping its operating rhythm, incident response model, and quality bar. You'll use telemetry and machine learning to identify issues early and help resolve them. Because Monetization changes can directly affect revenue and often involve confidential or financial information, you'll use strong judgment, careful rollout practices, and a high bar for reliability. This role is opening at the Staff Backend Engineer level (grade 8).</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design, build, and operate observability across the Monetization stack, including metrics, logs, and traces, using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.</li> <li value="2">Implement automated detection for billing, data, and event anomalies, and route alerts to the responsible feature teams.</li> <li value="3">Develop reconciliation and data integrity checks across usage and billing pipelines.</li> <li value="4">Define and track service level objectives and service level indicators, write runbooks, and take part in incident response to measure and improve Monetization system reliability.</li> <li value="5">Explore artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques to predict system anomalies and accelerate resolution.</li> <li value="6">Review and offer feedback on merge requests from other Monetization engineers.</li> <li value="7">Collaborate with Product, Finance, Support, and other partners to turn operational needs into reliable tooling.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience with Ruby on Rails, including building and operating applications such as CustomersDot.</li> <li value="2">Experience in site reliability or observability engineering, including monitoring, alerting, service level objectives and indicators, runbooks, and incident response.</li> <li value="3">Experience setting technical direction for observability, reliability, or detection work and bringing other engineers along.</li> <li value="4">Experience building anomaly detection, monitoring, or risk management tooling.</li> <li value="5">Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.</li> <li value="6">Exposure to analytical data stores such as ClickHouse and the change data capture and event-streaming pipelines that feed them, including NATS JetStream.</li> <li value="7">Experience owning projects from concept through production, communicating clearly about complex technical and organizational problems, and proposing iterative solutions.</li> <li value="8">Working knowledge of Python for anomaly detection and data work, or experience with billing, financial, or other business-critical systems, including Zuora or Salesforce, is a plus.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations team is part of GitLab's Monetization section, a highly cross-functional group that partners with Sales, Finance, IT, and Support to deliver secure and reliable purchasing, billing, provisioning, and utilization workflows. The Monetization section includes the Purchase, Subscription Lifecycle, Billing Engine, Platform and Infrastructure, Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations, and Compliance teams.</p> <p>This role is on the Fulfillment Workflow Monitoring (Catch All) team and reports to the Engineering Manager, Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations. We work asynchronously, plan and reflect regularly, and share responsibility for deployments, incident management, testing, and safe rollouts. We're increasingly focused on how artificial intelligence and machine learning can improve our Monetization infrastructure and provide predictive insights.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Credit Risk Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">📍Dublin | 💶 €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</span></p> <p><strong>⭐ About the team:</strong></p> <p>Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and the planned launch of new initiatives. We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and are looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Credit Risk Manager to help drive the credit and growth strategy for our consumer lending products as we grow our business in Ireland. Our credit teams are part of our Credit Discipline which drives a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. We’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives analysts the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</p> <p>Join a team where your ideas can rapidly transform into reality, leveraging our cutting-edge technology and agile ways of working. Our credit analysts and managers are fully embedded into a product squad alongside Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Marketers, Customer Researchers, Data Scientists etc. This enables us to solve customer problems in a fast paced and innovative way.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You'll play a key role by:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working closely with Borrowing squad leadership to develop and execute an ambitious growth strategy </li> <li>Collaborating with people from engineering, marketing, product, risk and control to design and deliver new products and customer journeys</li> <li>Leading the development and maintenance of the NPV models and affordability strategies that underpin the Borrowing underwriting decisions</li> <li>Monthly monitoring and reporting on Borrowing performance to stakeholders up to executive level</li> <li>Collaborating with the Decision Science team to maximise value from our internal and external data through cutting-edge ML models</li> <li>Promoting a culture of proactive, high quality analysis and ensure we have the right credit capabilities, infrastructure and talent in place to scale safely</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> <li>You have extensive experience in unsecured lending in Ireland</li> <li>You have a deep understanding of lending economics and have experience developing and deploying underwriting strategies and credit models</li> <li>You have strong analytical and data capabilities, backed up by technical coding skills. SQL, Python and Looker experience is a plus</li> <li>You have experience with the development and maintenance of NPV models</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of the regulations that apply to lending in Ireland</li> <li>You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are keen for the chance to improve our products and help ship changes to our customers</li> <li>You are a strong communicator, able to cut through complex problems and articulate decision points, particularly to senior leadership</li> <li>You have experience in project management and coordination across teams</li> <li>You work well collaborating in a team with diverse skill-sets and personality types</li> <li>You are highly motivated and energised by the idea of bringing a positive impact to our customers and Monzo</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, case study & behavioural interviews</li> <li>A final call with senior leadership</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.</p> <p>#LI-MOS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get it there. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go, and we are looking for experienced software engineers who understand performance at scale, networking, storage and usability.</p> <p>Applicants should be passionate about the future of Ubuntu and be able to show technical leadership with a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion. This position requires international travel several times a year.</p> <p><strong>This role entails</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop MAAS core components and features to make MAAS the #1 bare metal cloud system.</li> <li>Shape the architecture of MAAS to make it simpler, faster and easier to use.</li> <li>Collaborate with other teams to ensure MAAS works well with other tools and is released on time.</li> <li>Contribute your improvements to our continuous integration environment, tests and practices, to maintain fast feedback and good test coverage.</li> <li>Contribute to documentation of current and existing features, making it world-class resource for Data Centre operators and users.</li> <li>Provide technical communication and collaboration with other teams where appropriate.</li> <li>Take personal ownership of problems and drive them to solutions.</li> <li><a href="https://canonical.com/careers/travel" target="_blank">Travel internationally</a> a few times a year to meet and collaborate with your and other teams. </li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Passionate about open source software, Linux, and Data Centre automation</li> <li>Solid track record of professional software development experience in Python, Go for back-end roles, or TypeScript, React for front-end roles.</li> <li>Capacity to learn quickly about new systems and techniques</li> <li>Excellent logic, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills</li> <li>Strong English language communication skills - both written and verbal</li> <li>Experience with Linux server technologies, including but not limited to Virtualization (KVM), Containers (LXC), etc.</li> <li>You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree</li> <li>Knowledge of network technologies, including PXE, DHCP, TFTP, DNS, NTP</li> <li>Some experience with Baseboard Management Controllers and Protocols (Redfish, IPMI, AMT and others)</li> <li>Strong experience with networking, storage technologies and Cloud hosting and infrastructure.</li> <li>Ideally, experience of large-scale physical server provisioning and automation, including rapid deployment, configuration, management and service orchestration.</li> <li>Familiarity with some of the open source development tools and methodologies used in creation of several Ubuntu projects (MAAS, Juju, Ubuntu Server, LXD, Ubuntu Core), such as Launchpad, Debian packaging tools (APT, dpkg) and snapcraft.</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university.</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. You will need to oversee our outsourced partners, holding them accountable for SLAs and performance. This position requires in-depth data analysis expertise and a strong commitment to data-driven decision making, alongside a solid understanding of day-to-day fincrime operations and deep knowledge of transaction monitoring, AML/CTF, screening, and onboarding rules and models implementation. You will work across different areas and products including our current and business accounts and partner with our group data science, data engineering, product, and technology teams.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Driving strategic partners oversight: Ensuring that our outsourcing partners for FinCrime Operations are operating effectively.</li> <li>Monitoring our FinCrime metrics and driving action delivery with our product teams to address the trends.</li> <li>Combining hands-on execution with strategic thinking to align cross-functional teams with our FinCrime, AML/ CTF vision and strategy.</li> <li>Helping to build and oversee solutions with technology at the heart of our screening, onboarding and transaction monitoring mitigation strategies to oversight of change implementation, making prioritisation calls of those initiatives. </li> <li>Working closely with the second line of defence and our Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) to complete assurance activity, identification and remediation of any actions. </li> <li>Collaborating across the company to remove roadblocks and solve complex challenges relating to Monzo's EU expansion.</li> <li>Supporting 3rd line of defence with auditing activities. </li> <li>Being an excellent partner to our third party vendors, unblocking and empowering their teams for high delivery and high performance. </li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You excel at leveraging robust data insights and analytics to drive strategic decision-making.</li> <li>You are a problem solver who takes initiative to create a high impact for stakeholders.</li> <li>Excel at stakeholder management and coordination across multiple teams.</li> <li>You have previous
